job.title: Remote Family Reunification Caseworker
job.description:
We have a contract opportunity for a Remote Family Reunification Caseworker. This position is approved  through June 15th 2027 and could be extended.
Pay Rate: $25.00 to $30.00/Hr.

About the Opportunity We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and mission-driven Family Reunification Case Manager to support individuals and families who have been separated due to migration, detention, conflict, natural disasters, or other humanitarian circumstances.
In this role, you will provide case management services that help reconnect family members through research, documentation, advocacy, communication, and coordination with partner organizations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing sensitive information, and committed to delivering professional, client-centered support to diverse populations.
This is a fully remote position offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of vulnerable individuals and families.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage a caseload of family reunification and family tracing requests from intake through case resolution.
  • Conduct case assessments, reviews, and follow-up activities to support reunification efforts.
  • Research and verify information needed to locate family members and advance active cases.
  • Assist with family messaging services, detention-related inquiries, emergency travel documentation, and other reunification support services.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely case records, correspondence, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate professionally and effectively with clients, partner agencies, government entities, service providers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare case summaries, reports, and program documentation in accordance with organizational standards.
  • Perform data entry, record maintenance, and other administrative tasks related to case management and service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy requirements, confidentiality standards, and program guidelines.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism, discretion, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Contribute to special projects and additional program activities as assigned.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in case management, social services, human services, behavioral health, refugee services, immigration services, family services, nonprofit programs, healthcare coordination, community outreach, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing client cases, maintaining documentation, and coordinating services.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote work environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience serving vulnerable, underserved, or culturally diverse populations.
  • Experience working within nonprofit, humanitarian, refugee, immigration, or community-service programs.
  • Familiarity with case management software, client databases, or customer relationship management (CRM) systems.
  • Knowledge of family tracing, reunification, crisis response, or related support services.
  • Bilingual or multilingual language skills strongly preferred.
What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
Successful candidates are compassionate professionals who combine strong case management skills with exceptional attention to detail. They are able to balance client advocacy with accurate documentation, maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and communicate effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds and life experiences.

Work Environment
  • Fully remote position.
  • Standard business hours with occasional flexibility required to address urgent client or program needs.
  • Regular use of computers, databases, and virtual communication platforms.
  • Significant documentation, case tracking, and record-management responsibilities.
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are committed to creating an inclusive environment and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Technical Vehicle Services (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
job.description:
Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, CAD navigation, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates with experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply.

Scope:
• Write and maintain service manuals, service SOPs, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical reports.
• Convert engineering requirements and test results into clear, repeatable service procedures.
• Document test results, repairs, defects, system configurations, and corrective actions.
• Test, inspect, troubleshoot, and validate electrical and electromechanical vehicle systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, and system documentation.
• Navigate and review existing CAD models, assemblies, drawings, and model trees.
• Locate components, dimensions, notes, features, and design information within CAD files.
• Use basic CAD functions such as view controls, section views, measurements, layers, and assembly navigation.
• Use diagnostic, logging, flashing, and network analysis tools to identify and resolve issues.
• Support root-cause analysis and collaborate with engineering, validation, service, and operations teams.
• Maintain organized lab, shop, vehicle, tool, and inventory areas.

Required:
• Automotive experience required.
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields.
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment, including multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Ability to navigate and interpret existing CAD files; CAD design or modeling experience is not required.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.
• Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or similar platforms.

job.title: Utilities Program Manager-Client Management (HYBRID)
job.description:
Utilities Program Manager-Client Management (HYBRID) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $38-42/hr
  • HYBRID-onsite 3 days, 2 days remote
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Provide intermediate level program management for generation interconnection and transfer requests as well as client management to member companies and other stakeholders. Relying on broad knowledge of the energy industry with expertise in generation transfers and interconnections, the client manager responds to customer inquiries, utilizing various research methodologies and internal support mechanisms.
  • Facilitate the processing of Interconnection Agreements, Interconnection Service Agreements and Wholesale Market Participant Agreements and a variety of customer inquiries, duties that include interconnection or transfer application delivery, facilitation, milestone and risk tracking and general stakeholder/customer management. General client management duties as required.
  • Assist in the managing and processing of generator transfer and interconnection application processes and related tasks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and timelines.
  • Ability to proactively ask probing and qualifying questions and use information to anticipate problems and obstacles and offer recommended solutions.
  • Possess a broad knowledge of company’s mission, structure, vision, values, operating principles and procedures including knowledge of existing and planned markets, major business functions, products and services and related strategies.
  • Possess general knowledge of the US energy industry with a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Relate well to all kinds of people; work effectively with individuals and groups at various levels in a constructive and collaborative manner; build and utilize effective working relationships in a matrix environment and across functional, departmental and divisional reporting lines.

Required:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills required.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills and the ability to digest and comprehend complex legal documents related to the energy industry.
  • Ability to interface with members and customers, internal members of the legal teams, operations teams and various levels of leadership when required.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality work products with extreme attention to detail.
  • College graduate with bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or experienced professional with High School Diploma and 7+ years’ work experience or associate’s degree and a minimum of five years’ experience in a client management or program management related position.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality work products with extreme diligence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and critical thinking skills.
  • Must be proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Paralegal Training
  • Generation and Interconnection Training
  • Salesforce or CRM proficiency
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest utility companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: VP, Software Engineering and Technology Transformation
job.description:
Job Title:VP Software Engineering and Technology Transformation
Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full Time
Salary: $170000- $20000/yr


In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:
Define and own the engineering vision and architectural roadmap for the transformation program
•Lead adoption of Applied AI / Generative AI capabilities into enterprise service delivery
•Drive API-first design strategy, governance, and integration patterns across internal and external systems
•Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations aligned to business transformation goals
Program Delivery & Execution
•Own end-to-end engineering accountability for the 2-year transformation roadmap across all phases
•Establish delivery governance including sprint cadences, release planning, milestone tracking, and risk management
•Partner within engineering, operations, and enterprise architecture to align engineering output to business outcomes
•Ensure program delivery velocity, quality, and reliability meet stakeholder expectations
Team Building & People Leadership
•Build a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, psychological safety, and continuous improvement
•Provide mentorship and career development for engineers
•Manage capacity planning, and workforce strategy for the program
Executive Stakeholder Engagement
•Collaborate with senior leadership and business stakeholders to shape and protect program scope
 
To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:
Applied AI & Intelligent Systems
•Demonstrated experience leading the integration of Applied AI / Generative AI solutions into enterprise products or services
•Familiarity with LLM-based architectures, AI/ML pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and conversational AI platforms
•Ability to evaluate and govern AI tool selection, responsible AI practices, and model operationalization
Java Spring Boot Ecosystem
•Deep expertise in Java Spring Boot microservices development, architecture, and governance
•Strong understanding of Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, and reactive programming patterns
•Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker)
API Integration & Design
•Expert-level knowledge of RESTful API design, API gateway patterns, and integration standards
•Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and API security best practices
•Track record of building and governing API ecosystems across internal teams and third-party partners
Leadership & Executive Presence
•10+ years of progressive software engineering experience with 5+ years in  engineering leadership
•Proven track record leading large-scale technology transformation programs in complex enterprise environments
•Experience managing engineering organizations  across multiple teams or workstreams
•Demonstrated ability to drive results in Agile model

job.title: Engineering Drafter- Driving Required - 1 yr contract role Austin, TX - on site only $26-28/hr
job.description:
Monday through Friday
8 am to 5 pm
$27/hr 
Benefits Offered including health insurance
Contract role through Yoh Services at a client site
This job requires strong REVIT skills.  
Must have a valid driver's license.
Background check required


Job Description: Entry-Level Drafter / Engineering Support General Overview The Entry-Level Drafter performs drafting and basic engineering support activities under close supervision. This position develops foundational competencies through structured work assignments and receives instruction, guidance, and direction from supervisors, managers, and experienced colleagues.
The role may focus on drafting, engineering support, or a combination of both.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Perform field observations as assigned.
  • Prepare and update as‑built drawings based on field edits.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, construction drawings, and other technical documentation.
  • Use computer‑aided design (CAD) software to prepare detailed engineering drawings, maps, and graphs from provided materials, including previous drawings, sketches, layouts, and standard references.
  • Clearly document revisions and file drawings according to standard procedures.
  • Assist in drafting solicitation documents using established procedures, formats, and templates to support procurement and contract activities.
  • Support field and office research related to:
    • Field measurements
    • Historical engineering drawings
    • Equipment databases
    • Microfilm
    • Inventory records
    • Electronic document management system (EDMS) records
    • Other technical documentation
  • Contribute to the design of equipment and layouts and support development of equipment ratings and facility statistics.
  • Prepare basic specifications, materials lists, and fixed capital unit (FCU) lists.
  • Assist with creating work orders and requisition entries.
  • Perform data entry in the departmental engineering database.
  • Prepare basic reports related to projects, work plans, equipment, assets, and budgets; assist with more complex reporting as needed.
  • Operate office and drafting equipment such as plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Collect engineering information by traveling independently to various company locations (such as substations, facilities, or plants).
The responsibilities above represent essential job functions but are not an exhaustive list. Employees may be required to perform additional job‑related duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications
  • One or more years of experience interpreting technical drawings/documents and performing technical analysis or CAD drafting.
  • A degree in computer‑aided design or a related field may substitute for equivalent experience, per company guidelines.
  • A valid driver’s license is required for travel to various company locations.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of general engineering principles.
  • Knowledge of CAD principles, standards, and techniques.
  • Knowledge of electronic document management systems (EDMS).
  • Knowledge of work management systems.
  • Basic proficiency in CAD software.
  • Ability to read and interpret diagrams, prints, and technical information.
  • Basic proficiency in office productivity software (email, word processing, spreadsheets).
  • Skill in analyzing and solving technical problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Ability to perform accurate data entry.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Work Environment
  • Work may be performed in an office, industrial setting, electrical substation, or plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise may occur.
  • Outdoor work may involve exposure to various or extreme weather conditions.
Physical Demands
  • Frequent finger/hand manipulation when using a keyboard and mouse.
  • Occasional climbing, crawling, crouching, or other non‑sitting positions for field duties (less than 20% of the time).
  • Occasional standing or walking during field work (less than 20% of the time).

job.title: Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
job.description:
Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
Seeking a Junior to Entry/Mid-Level Python Network Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to support automated testing of routers, access points, extenders, gateways, and other CPE devices.

Scope:
• Develop Python and Pytest automation for CPE validation.
• Automate device interactions using SSH, REST APIs, cURL, and CLI tools.
• Generate and analyze traffic using iPerf3, Scapy, Wireshark, and Tshark.
• Test throughput, packet loss, latency, roaming, and connectivity.
• Configure Linux test hosts, switches, VLANs, and testbed infrastructure.
• Automate provisioning, firmware flashing, reboots, and configuration changes.
• Integrate tests into Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
• Analyze results, troubleshoot failures, capture packet traces, and document defects.

Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in Python, test automation, network automation, or a related field.
• Proficiency with Python 3, Pytest or unittest, and Bash scripting.
• Working knowledge of Linux administration.
• Familiarity with Paramiko, Netmiko, Requests, Pexpect, or similar libraries.
• Understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, DHCP, DNS, NAT, VLANs, and routing.
• Basic knowledge of WiFi standards, SSIDs, authentication, and performance metrics.
• Experience with Wireshark or tcpdump.
• Experience using Git.
• Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Pluses:
• Experience with TR-069, TR-369/USP, OpenSync, or EasyMesh.
• Experience with ByteBlower, OctoScope, Candela, or LANforge.
• Experience testing routers, access points, extenders, or gateways.
• Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field.
• Experience with Pytest fixtures, test parameterization, logging, and subprocess management.

job.title: Preclinical Study Manager, Research and Early Development, Hybrid Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Preclinical Study Manager, Research and Early Development, Hybrid Cambridge, MA
  The Opportunity We are seeking a Preclinical Study Manager to oversee externally contracted in vivo and in vitro studies supporting research and early development programs. This role will collaborate with internal research and development teams to design, manage, track, and report preclinical studies conducted through external Contract Research Organizations (CROs).

The Study Manager will help assess CRO capabilities, prepare requests for proposals, evaluate bids and timelines, coordinate study awards, and ensure outsourced studies remain aligned with approved budgets and development plans. The role will also support protocol development, study monitoring, data reporting, documentation, and long-term financial forecasting.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple studies, vendors, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and submit study concepts and requests for proposals to qualified CROs
  • Obtain and evaluate CRO proposals, budgets, and timelines
  • Negotiate study scope, costs, and timelines as appropriate
  • Coordinate with Toxicology, DMPK, Bioanalysis, Biology, Pathology, CMC, Program Management, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Sample Management teams
  • Prepare statements of work and support CRO contract review and processing
  • Assist with protocol development, amendments, animal orders, test article projections, and shipments
  • Maintain complete and organized study files, including schedules, contracts, protocols, correspondence, and reports
  • Track internal and external report timelines and study deliverables
  • Coordinate test article supplies, orders, characterization, stability testing, and retesting
  • Conduct CRO site visits at key study milestones
  • Participate in pre-study, operational, progress, and pre-reporting meetings with CRO partners
  • Support budget forecasting, contract awards, invoice review, and financial tracking
  • Manage outsourced GLP and non-GLP preclinical studies, including pharmacokinetic, toxicology, and biodistribution studies
  • Serve as a primary contact for CRO partners and provide ongoing study oversight
  • Troubleshoot issues, communicate changes, and track study activities across vendors and project teams
  • Participate in CRO selection and qualification activities
  • Maintain integrated schedules for internal and external preclinical studies
  • Help coordinate meetings, resources, workloads, and study priorities
  • Support process improvement initiatives
  • Ensure studies are conducted in accordance with applicable global regulatory guidelines
  • Take on additional projects as needed
Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Biology, Toxicology, or a related field preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Toxicology, or a related discipline with at least six years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or a CRO environment
  • Previous study direction or study coordination experience within a CRO is highly preferred
  • Experience managing outsourced preclinical studies, preferably in a GLP environment
  • Knowledge of global regulatory guidelines, including ICH, GLP, and OECD standards
  • Experience with laboratory animal research studies is a plus
  • Working knowledge of invoicing, accounting, budgeting, or contract management
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to critically review study documentation
  • Excellent organizational, multitasking, time-management, and program-management skills
  • Experience with project scheduling and study-tracking tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and cross-functional project teams
  • Ability to manage changing priorities, timelines, and deliverables in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to travel periodically for CRO site visits and study-related meetings
Additional Information This role may require onsite work and periodic domestic travel, with occasional international travel depending on business needs. The position involves managing multiple preclinical studies and CRO relationships across research and early development programs.

job.title: Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Bay Area
job.description:
Materials Program Manager (MPM) - SF Bay Area

Looking for a solid Materials Program Manager to support an autonomous vehicle companies Supply Chain department. This person should have a background in materials planning and understand the key vendors involved in electronics components, mechanical components, automotive components, etc.

 

The key responsibility for this job will be manual demand planning (Manual MRP experience). There is no SAP, ERP, or SW suite that will be utilized, this is all manual production planning/Manual MRP’s through Excel/GSheets, so advanced Excel or GSheet’s experience is a must have.

 

Scope:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. This is the MPM's primary task which will be focused on. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Degree in Supply Chain or similar is ideal.

• Analyze manufacturing build plans against inventory/supply chain data in order to determine demand for materials replenishment.

• Retrieve quotes from suppliers & submit PO’s.

• Manage delivery schedules in order to ensure materials arrive ahead of required dates.

• Track/Mitigate Excess and Obsolescence.

 

Required:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Advanced spreadsheet / Excel skills; Ability to generate complex dashboards, tools, and reports. Experience with excel formulas like - VLOOKUP, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, MIN, etc.

• Solid experience working as a Materials PM, Buyer/Planner, Materials Planners, or similar.

• Understand how to read and understand bill of materials (BOM’s) and manage inventory accuracy.

• Strong knowledge of MRP (Materials Requirements Planning) system functionality.

Title: Z/OS Systems Programmer
Type: Full Time
Location: Nashville, TN - Hybrid

Our client is world's largest custodian bank and securities services company. 


In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Oversee a broad range of delivery projects to fulfill both hardware and software Lifecycle Management. Responsible for managing the teams that administer multiple Mainframes running on z/OS systems using various technologies like JCL, DB2, IMS, CICS, Source code management, SDLC practices and Security mechanisms such as ACF2, RACF and TSS.
  • Responsible for rethinking the assumptions behind how traditional services are built and thinking about how to modernize, enhance and continuously improve capabilities through innovation and automation.
  • Leverage your breadth of experience to lead the organization through cross-functional and collaborative efforts. Partner with solutioning Data center services, Production Services Application Developers to shape new opportunities. 
  • An engaged and motivated contributor, you will see the value in our team. Coach, mentor and leverage our talent management processes to effectively lead managers, build your talent and create a highly engaged team.
     
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: 

  • **EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS: ** - bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. - Advanced certifications in infrastructure engineering or related disciplines preferred.
  • **EXPERIENCE: ** Typically 6-10 years of experience. 
  • **SKILLS: ** - Expertise in infrastructure design and implementation. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Effective collaboration and communication abilities.
  • 10+ years of diverse experience in multiple areas of information technology required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.
  • Experienced in diverse mainframe technical environments. Experienced in one or more mainframe infrastructure, hardware, system programming technologies and/or application development. Alternative experiences must include high learning agility to acquire mainframe technology knowledge and apply previous experiences to achieve operational outcomes.
  • Direct Mainframe experience is a necessity as is the ability to lead a technical team, build relationships, and possess a strategic mindset to drive the team to successful outcomes.
  • Possess communication skills to appropriately lead at the client/team/Business unit levels.
  • Experienced leading complex projects and programs.
  • Experience in tooling, utilities, and data transport,
  • Experience in Architecture and design principles
  • Skilled communicator that can influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels and be able to navigate complex technical topics and communicate them with clarity, brevity, and impact. Able to manage up, down and across organizations, clients and/or functions.
Preferred

  • Knowledge in one or more areas of mainframe discipline.
  • ITIL or ITSM oversight or expertise in Release, Change and CMDB
  • Installation knowledge of ISV SW and IBM Operating systems
  • Knowledge of z/OS, PARMLIB, Unix SYSTEMS services, HCD
  • Knowledge of SMP/E or maintenance routines if applicable
  • Knowledge in JCL
  • Knowledge system IPL processes
  • Knowledge of ISPF/TSO
  • Framework experience in building and maintaining a mainframe platform

job.title: Director of Analytical Sciences
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Director of Analytical Services to lead analytical development and QC capabilities supporting an oncology pipeline from early development through commercialization.

The ideal candidate will have a Ph.D. and 8–15 years of industry experience, with expertise in analytical method development, validation, troubleshooting, stability programs, CMC strategy, and GMP compliance. Experience with HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, SEC, DLS, sterile injectables, lyophilized products, or novel excipients is highly valued. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring CRO/CMO oversight, regulatory filing support, team building, and the ability to work directly at the bench in a fast-moving biotech environment.

Industry: Clinical Diagnostics / Genetics / Molecular Cytogenetics
Location: Dover, DE
Type: Direct Hire

The Director of Analytical Services is a hands on CMC analytical leader responsible for running analytical development and QC capabilities to support our oncology pipeline from early development through clinical stages and eventual commercialization. This role combines strategic ownership of analytical control strategy with direct laboratory execution, vendor oversight, and cross functional leadership typical of a small, fast moving biotech environment.

The Director will establish analytical methods, systems, and workflows, ensuring phase appropriate rigor, regulatory compliance, and efficient use of internal and external resources. This position is ideal for a leader who thrives in a startup style environment, enjoys solving multidisciplinary problems, and is comfortable switching between high level CMC strategy and bench level execution.

Key Job Elements

Analytical Strategy & Execution
  • Own the analytical control strategy for drug products and novel excipients across all phases.
  • Develop, qualify, validate, and troubleshoot analytical methods (HPLC/UHPLC, LC?MS/MS, GC, SEC, DLS, solid state, microbiological, etc.).
  • Design and execute forced degradation, stability indicating method development, and characterization studies.
  • Establish practical, phase appropriate specifications and update them as programs mature.

Hands?On Laboratory Leadership
  • Work directly at the bench (10–30% depending on phase) to develop methods, generate data, and mentor scientists.
  • Oversee day to day lab operations, instrument strategy, qualification, and troubleshooting.

CRO/CMO Oversight
  • Lead method transfers, qualifications, and ongoing oversight of CROs and CMOs.
  • Ensure data integrity, technical alignment, and timely delivery of outsourced analytical work.
  • Participate in vendor audits and selection.

Regulatory & CMC Ownership
  • Serve as analytical lead for IND/IMPD filings and contribute to NDA/DMF content.
  • Draft and review analytical sections of Module 3.
  • Support responses to FDA/EMA information requests and inspection readiness.

Quality, Compliance & Data Integrity
  • Ensure adherence to GMP, ICH, and FDA expectations appropriate for clinical stage biotech.
  • Implement practical data integrity controls, documentation standards, and 21 CFR Part 11 practices.
  • Lead OOS/OOT investigations, CAPA and analytical improvements.

Stability & Specifications
  • Own stability program design, execution, and trending.
  • Manage reference standard qualification and lifecycle.
  • Establish and maintain phase appropriate specifications.

Team Building & Leadership
  • Build and mentor a small, high impact analytical team.
  • Provide hands on training, technical guidance, and career development.
  • Create a culture of scientific rigor, urgency, and accountability.

Safety & Lab Infrastructure
  • Ensure safe operation of analytical labs and compliance with chemical/biological safety requirements.
  • Support safety committee activities and continuous improvement of safety practices.
Qualifications
Knowledge/Experience
 
  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field with 8–15 years of industry experiences.
  • Demonstrated success in leading analytical development.
  • Expert in method development, validation, and troubleshooting across major analytical platforms.
  • Strong understanding of sterile injectable and/or nanoformulation analytical challenges a plus.
  • Experience supporting IND/DMF/NDA filings and interacting with regulatory agencies.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast changing environment.
  • Hands on leader comfortable working at the bench while driving strategy.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and crossfunctional collaboration skills.

Preferred
  • Experience with oncology injectables, lyophilized products, and novel excipients.
  • Experience building analytical labs, systems, or teams.
  • Familiarity with QbD principles and analytical lifecycle management.
  • Ability to manage multiple programs and shifting priorities typical of small biotech.

job.description:
Entry Level Engineering Process Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.

job.title: Architect - Data Center Migration
job.description:
Senior Infrastructure Architect

Position Summary:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Infrastructure Architect to help lead enterprise-wide data center transformation and infrastructure modernization efforts. This individual will provide architectural oversight and technical direction for a large-scale migration involving compute, storage, networking, database, virtualization, and disaster recovery environments.
A major component of this initiative involves transitioning infrastructure from existing legacy data center locations, including Charlotte, into Equinix facilities in Ashburn. The architect will help define the future-state infrastructure design, establish migration strategies, and ensure the organization's technology environment is positioned for long-term scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
This is a senior-level architecture role centered on solution design, infrastructure planning, and technical coordination. The individual will assess current-state environments, evaluate architectural alternatives, identify dependencies and risks, and develop actionable migration approaches in partnership with specialized engineering teams. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise infrastructure knowledge and the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical architectural solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Define and oversee enterprise infrastructure architecture supporting large-scale data center consolidation, migration, and modernization programs.
  • Establish end-to-end transition strategies covering server and compute environments, storage, network infrastructure, databases, virtualization, and disaster recovery.
  • Create comprehensive migration blueprints that account for system dependencies, resource allocation, equipment requirements, sequencing, capacity, and execution schedules.
  • Architect the relocation of virtualized workloads and physical infrastructure from legacy facilities into Equinix data center environments.
  • Review existing infrastructure designs and configurations, assess technical constraints, and recommend appropriate migration solutions based on risk, performance, and scalability.
  • Drive the evolution of disaster recovery architecture from traditional data center-based recovery toward application-specific recovery strategies.
  • Define repeatable disaster recovery standards and architectural patterns, with an initial emphasis on active-passive configurations and opportunities for future enhancement.
  • Work alongside infrastructure engineering teams to implement consistent architecture standards, reusable technology patterns, and automation practices.
  • Lead infrastructure forecasting and capacity assessments across compute, storage, networking, and physical data center resources.
  • Evaluate physical data center requirements, including cage space, equipment density, infrastructure footprint, and projected growth.
  • Establish ongoing capacity management practices to ensure available resources support business expansion and migration timelines.
  • Assess current network designs and develop modernization recommendations involving network isolation, traffic segmentation, and inter-data-center connectivity.
  • Define target-state network architecture to replace existing legacy blue/green/yellow segmentation models.
  • Partner with network engineering teams to improve segmentation across production, development/non-production, database, and shared infrastructure environments.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure transitions through automation, orchestration, provisioning, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Coordinate architectural efforts across server, storage, network, database, and infrastructure engineering groups to maintain alignment throughout implementation.
  • Create and maintain technical architecture diagrams, migration strategies, capacity forecasts, roadmaps, and solution recommendations.
Required Experience & Qualifications
  • 15+ years of professional experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering, infrastructure architecture, or data center architecture.
  • Extensive background designing, supporting, and modernizing complex enterprise data center environments.
  • Demonstrated success developing architecture and migration strategies for large-scale infrastructure relocation or transformation initiatives.
  • Broad technical understanding across enterprise infrastructure disciplines, including:
    • Compute, server, and hardware architecture.
    • Enterprise storage technologies and platforms.
    • Network architecture, connectivity, and segmentation.
    • Virtualization and virtual machine environments.
    • Database infrastructure and enterprise appliances.
    • Disaster recovery, resiliency, and business continuity.
  • Strong architectural expertise with VMware and enterprise virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with Cisco infrastructure, including UCS platforms, routers, and switches.
  • Knowledge of enterprise storage solutions, ideally including Pure Storage and/or Dell PowerScale/PowerMax. Specific platform experience should be confirmed.
  • Experience working with Palo Alto firewalls and enterprise network security architectures.
  • Proven ability to perform infrastructure capacity assessments, resource forecasting, and long-term planning.
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery design, including application-level recovery approaches and active-passive configurations.
  • Ability to assess complex existing environments, identify design limitations, and develop scalable future-state architecture.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical stakeholders and coordinate across multiple engineering organizations.
Preferred Background
  • Previous experience working within Equinix data center facilities.
  • Involvement in multi-location or geographically distributed data center migration initiatives.
  • Experience relocating physical server infrastructure and enterprise database appliances.
  • Background developing infrastructure automation, orchestration, and provisioning strategies.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience redesigning legacy network environments and implementing modern segmentation strategies.
  • Success establishing enterprise architecture standards and repeatable disaster recovery frameworks across engineering teams.
  • Experience in financial services or another highly regulated enterprise environment.
Technology LandscapeThe environment includes a combination of established enterprise infrastructure technologies and modern data center platforms:
  • Virtualization: VMware
  • Compute Infrastructure: Cisco UCS
  • Networking: Cisco routers and switches
  • Storage: Pure Storage, Dell PowerScale / PowerMax
  • Network Security: Palo Alto firewalls
  • Data Center Facilities: Equinix
  • Disaster Recovery: Legacy VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM), with a strategic shift toward application-level recovery architectures
  • Core Initiatives: Data center migration, infrastructure modernization, network segmentation, capacity management, automation, and orchestration

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

job.description:
Manufacturing Technician  $1000 Bonus after 100 days worked

PAY RANGE: $23.00 - $25.00 PER HOUR Why This Opportunity? Applied Materials is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is your opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps build the equipment used to manufacture the world's most advanced semiconductor devices. If you enjoy working with your hands, troubleshooting equipment, and supporting cutting-edge technology, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Why Applied Materials? • World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
• Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
• Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
• Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and engineering operations.
• Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
• Gain valuable experience working on advanced semiconductor equipment used around the world.
• Opportunity to expand your skills in electrical, mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic systems.

First Shift

job.title: GPU Infrastructure Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Infrastructure Support Engineer
Location: New York, NY
Type - Hybrid 4 days Onsite
Terms; Full Time
Salary- $150000/yr - $190000/yr


Our client provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Deliver operational support and drive issue resolution for AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, and associated production services.
  • Support the deployment, orchestration, and monitoring of AI/ML workloads across distributed environments using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Apply hands-on expertise with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including A100, H100, and B200 nodes, to support provisioning, utilization, performance tuning, and ongoing platform operations.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize automation scripts and tooling using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and change activity through enterprise workflow and ticketing platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, platform, and operations to implement DevOps best practices, including CI/CD using GitLab, containerized deployment models, and secure access management through Azure AD.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, support guides, and infrastructure architecture artifacts.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking, storage, and system performance issues affecting AI infrastructure and high-performance compute workloads.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support model, including occasional weekend coverage, to help maintain high availability and operational excellence.
 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience supporting AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, or high-performance compute environments in enterprise or production settings.
  • Hands-on experience working with NVIDIA GPU nodes, including A100, H100, and B200 systems.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and Docker for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting distributed workloads.
  • Proficiency in Ansible,  Python and Shell scripting for automation, tooling, and operational support tasks.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and container-based delivery models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise ticketing and service management platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Good knowledge of networking, storage, Linux systems administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting in complex technical environments.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including secure access controls such as Azure AD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional weekend support as needed.

ELECTRO MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER OR Manufacturing Technician
Gloucester, MA

Schedule: 
  • Competitive pay ranging from $23.00 to $28.00 per hour, plus shift differentials
  • First Shift:  from 5 am to 3:30 pm Monday through Thursday
  • Second Shift:  from 3 on to 11:30 pm Monday through Thursday has an additional 10% differential 
  • Mid Shift:  from 11 am to 7 pm 
  • Third Shift:  from 7:30 pm to  6 am Monday through Thursday has an additional 13% differential 
  • Fourth Shift:  from 6 am to 6:30 pm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday with an additional 11% differential 
Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting-edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies
Working from work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal or written instructions
Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors
Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies
Entering production data, labor details, and work progress into computer systems
Receiving and auditing parts to ensure build readiness; inspecting components for defects
Troubleshooting issues and contributing to process improvements
Documenting completed work clearly and accurately
Safety & Work Environment
Properly use PPE, tools, equipment, and materials
Proactively report hazards, incidents, or injuries
This position may involve working in a cleanroom environment, requiring PPE such as coveralls, hoods, booties, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Physical & Environmental Requirements
This is an active, hands-on role that may include:
Standing for extended periods, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in tight spaces
Lifting and handling components and tools
Operating hand and power tools
Working in environments with moderate to high noise levels
Driving or operating heavy machinery, including forklifts
Ability to distinguish between colors

What We’re Looking For
Experience in manufacturing, assembly, or production environments
Strong ability to follow technical instructions and schematics
Hands-on skills with electro-mechanical assemblies and tools
Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
Interest in or experience within semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing (highly valued)

Why Join Us
4 day workweek with Fridays off
Day shift schedule for better work-life balance
Entry point or growth opportunity into the semiconductor industry
Work with advanced manufacturing technology
A role where your technical skills truly matter

Working With Yoh
Benefits
Medical, dental, vision insurance
401(k), life & disability coverage
Weekly pay, employee discounts
Ready to Build the Future

If you’re a driven Manufacturing Technician who enjoys hands-on work and wants to be part of a high-impact industry, we want to hear from you.
Apply today and take your next step in semiconductor manufacturing!

Patty Vogel]

job.title: Transmission Engineer
job.description:
Transmission Engineer - Transmission & Distribution

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of energy infrastructure development as a Transmission Engineer specializing in Transmission & Distribution. This vital role offers the opportunity to design and deliver cutting-edge projects across high voltage transmission lines—both underground and overhead—in regions like Minneapolis and Duluth. Be part of a collaborative environment that shapes the future of power delivery, working through all project phases from conception to construction, ensuring reliable, efficient, and innovative transmission solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in transmission engineering, with 5+ years preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of civil/structural engineering techniques, codes (NESC, NERC, FERC), and standards.
  • Proficiency with design software such as CAD and PLS-CADD.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze, problem-solve, and apply critical thinking in complex environments.
  • Experience in preparing specifications, technical bid summaries, and reports.
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior consulting experience in transmission or civil engineering projects.
  • Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam or EIT certification.
  • Experience performing economic conductor selection, grounding calculations, and lightning performance studies.
  • Knowledge of project management and client communication.
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or related Engineering Technology; a Master’s in Civil Engineering is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of relevant transmission engineering experience, with a preference for 5+ years.
  • Hands-on experience with project design, field inspections, and technical report compilation.
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10% for project site visits.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to work in both office and field environments.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Step into a transformative role where your expertise guides the development of essential energy infrastructure. Bring your skills to a team that values innovation and dedication—apply now and help shape the future of transmission systems!

job.title: Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
job.description:
Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
Direct Hire (Base + Bonus)
Work Location (Hybrid): 3 days/week onsite — New York, NY, Holmdel, NJ, or Bethlehem, PA
 
We’re prioritizing candidates with:
  • Insurance industry architecture leadership experience
  • Architecture & technology alignment at portfolio scale (not just solution design)
  • Strong governance mindset that enables speed, not blocks it
  • Executive presence and proven ability to influence investment/roadmaps
 
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Architecture Leadership
  • Drive cohesive architecture across multiple value streams, ensuring end-to-end design consistency across platforms, products, and capabilities.
  • Own the Corporate Functions target-state architecture, portfolio roadmap, architecture priorities, and investment influence.
  • Advance modern platform architecture across cloud, data, integration, and AI capabilities.
  • Improve engineering productivity and delivery speed by defining architecture patterns, guardrails, and operating models that scale.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to establish scalable patterns and with enterprise architecture leadership for cross-portfolio alignment and trade-offs.
  • Serve as the primary architecture advisor to the Corporate Functions digital/technology leadership team, shaping strategy, priorities, and transformation sequencing.
  • Manage and develop a team of Solution Architects; raise architecture maturity across the portfolio.
  • Be available for high-impact production incidents affecting business operations.
 
Investment & Roadmap Influence
  • Shape and influence strategic investments across Corporate Functions (HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments).
  • Guide architecture across core enterprise platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and ServiceNow, plus integration/API ecosystem enablement.
  • Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, increase reuse, and accelerate time-to-market—driving simplification across business units, not just within the portfolio.
 
End-to-End Enterprise / Insurance Architecture Ownership
  • Drive holistic architecture across:
    • Business processes and operating value streams
    • Core and surrounding application ecosystems
    • Integration and event-driven architectures
    • AI/ML use cases (e.g., underwriting/claims automation, fraud, personalization)
    • Digital experiences for customers, distribution partners (agents/brokers), and internal users
  • Ensure solutions meet regulatory, risk, security, privacy, and resiliency requirements (e.g., SOX/SOC expectations, data privacy).
  • Promote cloud-native, API-first, data-centric, and AI-enabled patterns where appropriate.
 
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Define/enforce architecture principles and guardrails aligned to enterprise standards and insurance regulatory expectations.
  • Lead or participate in architecture review and governance forums; ensure decisions are auditable and practical.
  • Partner with security, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to support operational resilience and auditability.
 
Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Corporate Functions leaders and senior technology leadership.
  • Represent architecture trade-offs in enterprise forums and influence outcomes across business units.
  • Communicate architectural direction, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor and develop architects across the portfolio.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years in technology/architecture roles, with significant experience in the insurance industry (or similarly regulated financial services with deep insurance exposure).
  • Proven experience as a Portfolio / Domain / Product / Enterprise Architect in a large, regulated environment.
  • Deep understanding of insurance operations and systems (policy, underwriting, claims, billing, distribution) and how they connect to enterprise platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Corporate Functions ecosystems: HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments.
  • Expertise across enterprise architecture domains: business, application, data, integration, AI, and digital.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders on technology strategy and investment decisions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, modern integration patterns, data platforms, and applied AI capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of regulatory, risk, compliance, and resiliency expectations in regulated environments.

job.title: Histotechnician (ASCP)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Histotechnologist II in Austin, TX. This role will support a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory focused on thyroid FNA specimens and requires strong hands-on histology experience, microtomy skills, and the ability to work independently in a collaborative lab environment. HT/HTL certification is strongly preferred, along with 3–4+ years of histology experience. The Histology Technician II performs routine and non-routine activities involved in the preparation of slides for microscopic examination by pathologists. Core duties include sample management specific to site operations, performing staining procedures, equipment maintenance, sample capture, and/or supporting digital pathology. The role requires proficiency in all aspects of microtomy, ensuring compliance with state and national regulatory standards, and effective collaboration with laboratory teams, pre-analytical staff, and pathologists. Flexibility in scheduling and section assignments is essential to meet laboratory needs.

Title: Histotechnologist II
Location: Austin, TX
Pay Range: $41–$44/hr
Shift: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:30 PM

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Prepares microscopic slides for diagnostic purposes, including processing, embedding, microtomy, and/or mounting of paraffin-embedded samples.
  • Assists in training new personnel and may perform competency assessment.
  • Responsible for specimen reconciling, sample return, sample capture, and ensuring quality throughout the pre-analytical processes; other duties as assigned, (if performed at the specific laboratory location).
  • Performs and quality review of routine H&E staining.
  • Recut blocks as requested by the Pathologist in a manner that meets TAT and quality expectations.
  • Maintains histology equipment per laboratory Standard Operating Procedures and manufacturer recommendations.
  • Files paraffin blocks and microscope slides; pulls slides/ blocks from storage, as requested.
  • Prepares and monitors solutions and reagents for the automated stainers.
  • Participates in projects, research, and validation activities as assigned.
  • Restocks the laboratory to ensure appropriate inventory levels as maintained to meet workload.
  • Maintains equipment and quality records in a manner that meets laboratory and compliance standards; ensures records are accurate and available for audits and review.
  • Must be able to troubleshoot areas of processing, microtomy, staining and equipment.
  • Performs and documents scheduled preventative maintenance.
  • Understands and follows all safety guidelines.
  • Participates in all continuing education programs required to keep certification current, if applicable.
  • Must be able to flex schedule to accommodate workload, including weekend coverage.
  • Respects and maintains the confidentiality of information relative to clients and patients.
  • Compliant with company policies, procedures, safety requirements quality systems, and regulations.
  • May perform other assigned duties as directed by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor's degree preferred
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in a histology laboratory required, including microtomy and H&E staining
  • Knowledge of CLIA, New York, CAP and OSHA regulatory requirements
  • HT(ASCP) or HTL(ASCP) certification
#IND-SPG

job.title: Solution Architect – Corporate Functions Finance, Risk, Investments
job.description:
Solutions Architect – Corporate Functions (Finance, Risk, Investments)
Direct Hire
Hybrid (NY/NJ/CT/PA)
 
Overview
We’re seeking a Solutions Architect to drive solution design and delivery architecture across a portfolio supporting corporate functions including Finance, Risk, and Investments. This role requires a strong blend of enterprise architecture + hands-on engineering mindset, with the ability to partner directly with business stakeholders and present technical direction to senior leaders.
This is a highly visible role where you will influence solution strategy, guide delivery teams, and ensure designs align to architecture standards, security requirements, and modern engineering practices.
 
Work Location / Schedule
Hybrid (3 days onsite per week) — candidates must be able to work onsite in one of the following locations:
  • New Jersey (Holmdel area)
  • New York, NY
  • Stamford, CT
  • Bethlehem, PA
 
What You’ll Do
  • Own product/team-level solution architecture and delivery design within a value stream.
  • Design and document end-to-end architectures across application, integration, data, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with product owners and technical leads to align roadmaps, MVP scope, and trade-offs.
  • Ensure solutions align to architecture standards, security requirements, and established patterns/guardrails.
  • Collaborate with enterprise/platform teams to reuse shared capabilities and reduce duplication.
  • Identify and help remove technical dependencies and delivery impediments.
  • Provide hands-on guidance on design quality, code structure, and technical approaches.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and help evaluate emerging tools and frameworks (including GenAI where applicable).
  • Mentor engineers on architecture principles and decision-making.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to reduce technical debt, simplify designs, and improve delivery efficiency.
  • Participate as needed during major production incidents affecting business operations.
 
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, data integration, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience designing hybrid architectures (mix of on-prem + public cloud).
  • Experience working in Agile / product-based delivery models.
  • Strong communication skills—able to translate technical concepts for business partners and delivery stakeholders.
  • Experience producing technical design documentation at product/team level.
  • Background supporting business-critical systems in regulated environments; insurance domain experience is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with GenAI frameworks/tools/best practices is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle strategic conversations, challenging discussions, and executive-facing presentations.
 
Work Authorization
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. No sponsorship available.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer – Product Development & Reliability
job.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Product Development & Reliability

Location: Marietta, OH
Salary: $70,000–$100,000 annually
Employment Type: Direct Hire | Full-Time
Work Location: Onsite

Yoh is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join our client's engineering team in Marietta, Ohio. This opportunity focuses on the design, development, and validation of mechanical systems used in ultra-low-temperature (ULT) freezers and laboratory cold-storage equipment.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on mechanical product development experience, a strong understanding of engineering analysis and design validation, and the ability to apply reliability engineering principles to improve product performance.

Candidates with backgrounds in mechanical product design, electromechanical systems, HVAC/R, refrigeration, or industrial equipment development are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop mechanical systems, assemblies, and components for cold-storage and temperature-controlled equipment.
  • Develop system-level, subsystem, and component performance specifications.
  • Create and execute engineering test plans to evaluate mechanical performance, durability, and reliability.
  • Apply design-for-reliability principles, engineering analysis, and performance sensitivity assessments to improve product designs.
  • Utilize CAD and computer-aided engineering (CAE) tools, including structural analysis and finite element analysis (FEA), to evaluate mechanical designs.
  • Analyze test results, identify performance limitations, and implement design improvements.
  • Develop scalable, modular, and reusable mechanical solutions across multiple product platforms.
  • Collaborate with refrigeration, electrical, controls, and manufacturing engineering teams throughout the new product development (NPD) process.
  • Incorporate Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles to support cost-effective production.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, design specifications, and technical reports.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing mechanical systems or products.
  • Experience with mechanical CAD design, structural modeling, and/or finite element analysis (FEA).
  • Experience developing or executing engineering validation tests and analyzing empirical performance data.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate engineering requirements and test findings into mechanical design decisions.
  • Understanding of mechanical systems, component interactions, and engineering design principles.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's degree in a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience with refrigeration, HVAC/R, cold-storage equipment, or other temperature-controlled systems.
  • Experience designing with sheet metal, engineered plastics, and foam materials.
  • Familiarity with design-for-reliability methodologies, failure analysis, or DFMEA.
  • Experience with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, or Practical Process Improvement (PPI).

Compensation

Annual Base Salary: $70,000–$100,000, depending on qualifications and experience.

This is a direct-hire opportunity supporting the development of mechanical systems for laboratory and scientific equipment.

job.title: Paralegal Administrator (HYBRID)
job.description:
Paralegal Administrator (HYBRID) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $28-31/hr
  • HYBRID-onsite 1 day per week, mostly remote
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Law Department is comprised of nearly twenty-five attorneys, paralegals, and support staff.  The Department is a fast-paced environment with a dedicated and dynamic team of legal professionals who work on cutting edge questions of electricity law and regulation.  In light of our team-based environment, we seek a collegial and personable individual to support our Paralegal staff and who is comfortable with and capable of independent work responsibities with the collaboration that is essential to our mission. 
  • The Legal Administrator will work with legal support staff and attorneys to provide a broad range of clerical, administrative, workflow, and project management duties to support the Law and Compliance Division.
  • The responsibilities will include conducting legal and factual research; preparing documents, exhibits, reports and filings; completing filings; activities related to drafting, processing, updating and filing tariff and tariff related agreements; assistance with drafting and processing service agreements and other legal documents; promoting tariff and regulatory compliance; and supporting legal proceedings.
  • Additional responsibilities will include file management (primarily electronic documents and email management), data entry and database management (Excel and litigation tracking software), report generation, expense and procurement coordination, logistics (meeting planning, Outlook calendar manager, travel arrangements), managing the workflow for particular attorney teams (logging receipt of an assignment, assigning attorney and paralegal support, monitoring progress), management of important public postings for external parties, formatting of pleadings, correspondence, and PowerPoint presentations, and other similar functions.  No two days are necessarily alike, and any one day may require the candidate to perform many of these different functions.
  • Assist attorneys in the preparation and electronic filing of letters, pleadings, discovery and subpoena responses, motions, and summaries of filings and orders. 
  • Conduct research and analysis on legal and regulatory matters, prepare memos, reports, summaries, charts, and other legal documents as directed.
  • Assist and support attorneys and paralegals in the preparation of filings and other steps in the filing process
  • Provide administrative support as needed to the Department, including(a) demonstrate proficiency in the use of company issued automated tools including In-house Conference Room Reservation System, SAP and Microsoft Office (b) prepare and process invoices, time sheets, expense reports, purchase requisitions, check requests as required; (c) establish, coordinate, and maintain calendars; (d) coordinate and schedule appointments, and meetings including making travel arrangements and reservations; (e) draft, organize and distribute departmental meeting minutes.
  • Legal Document Review and Analysis Duties: (a) support the administration, processing and maintenance of Service Agreements including the tracking of effective and expiration dates, and coordinate with both internal and external stakeholders to maintain overall regulatory compliance; (b) review pro forma documents and agreements for conformity; and (c) prepare and/or support the preparation of draft filings for legal counsel indicating reason for non-conformity, and oversee any service requirements for filing.

Required:
  • Experience as a legal administrative assistant, law clerk or paralegal in a law firm, corporate legal department, or governmental agency.
  • Must be local and able to work onsite 1 day per week to complete mailings and other in-office tasks
  • Bachelor’s degree in legal studies / related field (or associate’s degree with at least 2 years of relevant professional legal experience)
  • Experience working in an office or team environment having administrative and workflow management experience
  • The successful candidate will be meticulous and have a thorough knowledge of legal formalities, computer and technical knowledge as well as strong analytical, communication and organizational skills; and?should work well in fast-paced collaborative environments with competing demands. 
  • A motivated candidate who is interested in pursuing a career in the energy/electricity industry.
  • Must be comfortable working in a digital environment; strong ability to utilize technology and e-filing tools
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest utility companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.
