job.title: Senior Quality Engineer – Medical Device Manufacturing
job.description:
Senior Quality Engineer – Medical Device Manufacturing

Location: St. Paul, MN (100% Onsite)
Employment Type: Direct Hire | Full-Time
Salary: $100,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience
Schedule: Monday–Friday

Position Overview

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer for a direct-hire opportunity with an established manufacturing organization in St. Paul, Minnesota.

This position will serve as a primary Quality Engineering resource at the Minnesota manufacturing site, providing technical leadership across manufacturing operations, process validation, investigations, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in regulated manufacturing environments, demonstrates the ability to independently resolve complex quality challenges, and has the communication and leadership skills to influence cross-functional teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned Quality Engineer interested in taking ownership of site-level quality initiatives and developing toward future quality management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as a primary site-level Quality Engineering resource, providing independent technical guidance and quality oversight for manufacturing operations.
  • Lead complex nonconformance investigations, CAPA activities, complaint investigations, root cause analysis, and effectiveness verification through closure.
  • Independently develop, execute, and review manufacturing process and equipment validation activities, including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ).
  • Establish validation strategies, acceptance criteria, sampling plans, statistical rationales, and challenge conditions to demonstrate process capability and compliance.
  • Apply statistical quality engineering methods, including SPC, Cp/Cpk, Gage R&R, Design of Experiments (DOE), ANOVA, hypothesis testing, and process capability analysis.
  • Lead risk assessments, including FMEA/PFMEA, and implement appropriate risk mitigation and process controls.
  • Evaluate nonconforming materials, support risk-based disposition decisions, and ensure appropriate containment and corrective actions.
  • Support manufacturing process improvements, equipment changes, engineering change control, and implementation of quality-related initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality Control to troubleshoot production issues and improve product quality, process reliability, and manufacturing performance.
  • Develop and maintain validation protocols, reports, investigations, technical justifications, and other quality documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements.
  • Support internal, customer, and supplier audits, providing technical explanations and defending quality decisions when necessary.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Quality Control personnel and other cross-functional team members.
  • Identify and escalate significant quality risks while independently managing competing priorities and driving timely resolution.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive Quality Engineering or Quality Assurance experience in medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex manufacturing quality investigations, CAPA, nonconformance resolution, and validation activities.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing manufacturing process and equipment validation protocols, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485, applicable FDA 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR requirements, and risk-based quality management principles.
  • Advanced understanding and practical application of statistical quality engineering tools and methodologies, including Minitab or equivalent software, SPC, Cp/Cpk, Gage R&R, DOE, and statistical sampling.
  • Experience applying root cause analysis, risk management, process FMEA, and corrective/preventive action methodologies in manufacturing environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and manage complex quality initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and communicate effectively with manufacturing leadership.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities through technical project ownership, cross-functional initiatives, mentoring, or similar responsibilities.
  • Ability to work onsite in St. Paul, Minnesota.

Preferred Qualifications
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience with medical device manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and manufacturing process controls.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14971 risk management principles and PFMEA/control plan development.
  • Experience with electronic quality management systems such as uniPoint, TrackWise, or Arena.
  • Experience with sterilization processes, including ethylene oxide (EO) or gamma sterilization.
  • Familiarity with cleanroom manufacturing, sealing equipment, environmental controls, DI water systems, or HVAC qualification.
  • Experience mentoring quality personnel or preparing for increased site-level quality leadership responsibilities.

Compensation & Opportunity
  • Annual base salary: $100,000–$120,000, depending on qualifications and experience.
  • Direct-hire, full-time opportunity.
  • Onsite position in St. Paul, Minnesota.
  • Opportunity to serve as a key technical Quality Engineering resource with potential for future advancement into quality management.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. The employer is unable to provide immigration sponsorship or related work authorization support.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Quality Engineer with a strong background in regulated manufacturing, independent process validation, statistical quality engineering, and technical leadership, we encourage you to apply.

Yoh Life Sciences is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Senior Separation Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Sr. Separations Scientist in Bristol, PA.  The individual will serve as a technical expert in separations-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities. The Sr. Separations Scientist will develop and implement advanced chromatographic workflows for structural characterization, impurity analysis, linker-payload assessment, DAR determination, and comparability studies to support clinical development programs.

Position:  Sr. Separations Scientist
Duration: Contract to Perm
Pay: $40-$50/hr DOE
Shift: M-F 8-5pm


Key Responsibilities
• Lead development, optimization, and transfer of chromatographic analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.
• Design and execute chromatographic studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.
• Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, aggregation, fragmentation and charge variant assessment, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.
• Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.
• Collaborate closely with process development, bioassay, formulation, and quality teams to establish analytical control strategies and critical quality attributes (CQAs).
• Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for chromatographic analyses.
• Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.

Required Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; M.S. with 2+ years or B.S. with 4+ years of relevant experience.
• Extensive hands-on experience with LCUV characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.
• Experience with analytical characterization techniques including RPLC/UV, SEC-UV, IEX-UV, non-reduced/reduced cIEF.
• Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.
• Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Empower or equivalent platforms.

job.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer
Durham, NC

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and operate scalable backend systems and cloud native services. This role is primarily focused on backend development, cloud operations, DevOps practices, and the delivery of secure, reliable services.

The ideal candidate will come from the development side of DevOps and have strong hands on experience developing in Go, along with experience in Java, Python, or another comparable language. The candidate should be able to develop Go services from scratch and support the full service lifecycle from design and development through deployment and operations.

• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain highly scalable backend services using Go

• Build high throughput APIs and cloud native services

• Own services throughout the full development and operations lifecycle

• Collaborate with product managers, architects, and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Improve engineering processes, tooling, automation, and CI/CD pipelines

• Apply DevOps practices to improve delivery speed, reliability, and operational efficiency

• Analyze complex engineering challenges and develop effective solutions

• Support secure authentication, authorization, and access management systems

• Contribute to systems designed for high availability, reliability, and fault tolerance

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated ability to develop Go applications and services from scratch

• Strong backend development experience with high throughput APIs

• Experience with cloud providers such as AWS or Azure

• Strong CI/CD, automation, and DevOps experience

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience supporting service deployment and operations

• Strong problem solving, written, and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Envoy proxy configuration, service meshes, routing, or load balancing systems

• Familiarity with observability tools, including logging, metrics, and tracing

• Prior experience leading medium to large technical initiatives

job.title: Identity & Access Engineer
job.description:
Identity & Access Engineer
6-12 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

Must have experience migrating Duo to Okta experience!

Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Identity & Access Engineer to support enterprise identity and access management initiatives, including platform modernization, application integrations, authentication migrations, and identity lifecycle automation.
This hands-on role focuses on enterprise identity platforms, directory services, single sign-on (SSO), multifactor authentication (MFA), application federation, and hybrid identity environments. The engineer will help strengthen security, streamline authentication, improve identity administration, and deliver reliable identity services across complex enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to independently execute identity engineering projects, troubleshoot complex authentication issues, automate identity processes, and coordinate integrations across multiple technical teams.

Responsibilities
  • Identity Platform Engineering: Configure, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise identity platforms, including Okta, Duo, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • SSO & MFA Migration: Support migrations from legacy authentication and MFA solutions to modern identity platforms. Configure authentication policies, validate application functionality, and coordinate production cutovers.
  • Application Federation: Implement and troubleshoot authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and related protocols.
  • Directory Services Integration: Configure virtual directory services and LDAP integrations to support authentication for legacy applications and enterprise resources.
  • Identity Lifecycle Automation: Integrate identity platforms with HR systems and other enterprise applications to automate user provisioning, profile updates, and deprovisioning.
  • Hybrid Identity Management: Configure and troubleshoot directory synchronization, identity mapping, authentication, and access across multiple Active Directory domains and identity platforms.
  • Identity Integration & Migration: Execute identity integration and migration initiatives associated with organizational changes, acquisitions, and consolidation of identity environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell scripts, REST API integrations, and automated workflows to improve identity administration, reduce manual effort, and increase provisioning accuracy.
  • Technical Project Delivery: Independently manage engineering activities from requirements gathering and dependency analysis through implementation, testing, cutover, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Security & Troubleshooting: Diagnose complex authentication and authorization issues, implement secure configurations, and support least-privilege access practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with identity, security, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve technical dependencies and deliver successful integrations.

job.title: Social Media Analyst
job.description:
Social Media Analyst

Position Overview
Our client is seeking a Social Media Analyst to support its global social media team by ensuring content is properly organized, tracked, and evaluated to generate meaningful performance insights. This individual will oversee social media reporting, content tagging, campaign tracking, platform monitoring, and the administration of social media tools and workflows.
The role will help maintain accurate reporting and consistent processes across global markets while identifying emerging trends and opportunities across social platforms. The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to translate performance data into actionable insights. Success in this position requires strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the ability to work across social, creative, legal, IT/InfoSec, and other internal teams.

Qualifications & Experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in social media analytics, performance reporting, or marketing operations.
  • Strong Excel skills and experience developing dashboards, analyzing performance metrics, and monitoring KPIs. Familiarity with Power BI is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with social media management and monitoring platforms such as Dash Social and Meltwater, as well as native analytics tools including Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
  • Working knowledge of UTM tracking, content categorization, campaign tagging, and standardized naming conventions.
  • Familiarity with major social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, with an understanding of their features, trends, and evolving platform policies.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities, including experience maintaining content calendars, coordinating approval workflows, and managing multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Key Responsibilities
Social Media Reporting & Performance Analysis
  • Develop and distribute weekly social media performance reports while ensuring campaign data is accurate and properly maintained.
  • Analyze content and campaign results to identify trends, successes, areas for improvement, and opportunities for future optimization.
  • Build and maintain campaign dashboards that provide ongoing visibility into performance metrics and results.
  • Assist with quarterly reporting and campaign recaps by compiling, organizing, and validating performance data.
Content Tracking & Data Management
  • Ensure published social content is consistently labeled using UTM parameters, Dash Social tags, and established campaign tracking structures.
  • Maintain standardized tagging practices and naming conventions across global social media teams and markets.
  • Conduct routine audits of content tags and campaign data to identify inconsistencies and maintain reporting accuracy.
Social Trends & Platform Insights
  • Conduct weekly research across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and LinkedIn to identify relevant trends and potential content opportunities.
  • Stay informed on new platform capabilities, algorithm updates, and policy changes, communicating relevant developments to the appropriate teams.
  • Utilize social listening and trend research platforms, including Meltwater and WGSN, to monitor emerging industry conversations, audience interests, and competitor activity.
Social Media Tools & Platform Administration
  • Manage administrative functions within social media platforms and tools, including Dash Social and Meltwater, overseeing user accounts, access levels, and permissions.
  • Coordinate platform access and Business Manager permissions for internal stakeholders, agency partners, and international markets.
  • Partner with IT, InfoSec, and procurement teams to support software reviews, renewals, security requirements, and vendor-related processes.
Content Calendars & Approval Coordination
  • Maintain and update social media publishing calendars, ensuring content schedules and key deadlines remain on track.
  • Coordinate content submissions through legal and internal stakeholder review processes, monitoring progress and securing necessary approvals before publication.
Internal Support & Issue Resolution
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal requests involving social media platform access, reporting data, content tagging, and tool-related questions.
  • Direct strategic or content-focused requests to the appropriate Social Strategy and Toolkits & Content team members.
  • Troubleshoot platform, publishing, access, and reporting issues, engaging vendor or platform support when additional assistance is required.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
  • Collaborate with social strategy, creative, and content teams to support consistent execution of the company's global social media initiatives.
  • Share weekly performance findings and emerging social trends with the Social Strategy lead and Toolkits & Content Specialist to help inform future content briefs, strategies, and toolkits.
  • Coordinate with legal, IT/InfoSec, and international market teams to support standardized workflows and compliance requirements.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, operating guidelines, and instructional resources to ensure teams have clear direction and consistent procedures.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience supporting international, global, or multi-market social media teams.
  • Familiarity with social media account governance, including Meta Business Manager, business accounts, and advertising account permissions.
  • Interest in or enthusiasm for the beauty and cosmetics industry is a plus.

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Laboratory Automation Engineer – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics to support a client in the South Bay Area, CA. This is a hands-on technical opportunity focused on developing, implementing, and optimizing automated laboratory workflows for cell-free DNA (cfDNA), low-input DNA, and next-generation sequencing applications.

The successful candidate will combine strong robotic liquid-handler programming skills with practical molecular biology and NGS experience. You will translate complex laboratory protocols into reliable automated methods, integrate laboratory instruments and software, troubleshoot workflow performance, and help establish scalable automation processes suitable for molecular diagnostic development.

This role is well suited for an automation specialist who can independently own projects from early method development through qualification, documentation, and transfer into routine laboratory operations. 

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA

Responsibilities:
 Development
  • Evaluate, configure, and implement laboratory automation platforms such as Hamilton Microlab STAR, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable liquid-handling systems.
  • Assess automation platform capabilities against assay requirements, throughput needs, workflow complexity, and future scalability.
  • Design robotic deck layouts, labware configurations, liquid classes, transfer parameters, and integrated workflows.
  • Coordinate instrument setup, commissioning, vendor support, and operational readiness.
  • Develop automation strategies that improve throughput, reproducibility, reagent utilization, and hands-on time.
Robotic Programming and Instrument Integration
  • Independently develop, debug, optimize, and maintain custom robotic methods using software such as Hamilton VENUS, Agilent VWorks, Beckman Biomek software, or equivalent programming environments.
  • Translate manual molecular biology protocols into reliable and executable automated workflows.
  • Develop custom routines for liquid transfers, reagent dispensing, magnetic-bead handling, incubation, thermal cycling, plate movement, and workflow-control logic.
  • Implement barcode-based sample identification, reagent tracking, operator alerts, error detection, and safe recovery procedures.
  • Integrate liquid handlers with supporting laboratory systems, including thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode scanners, and laboratory information management systems.
  • Maintain version-controlled scripts, technical documentation, method specifications, and change histories.
  • Work with equipment vendors and internal technical teams to resolve complex automation, programming, and integration issues.
cfDNA and NGS Workflow Automation
  • Automate and optimize cfDNA, low-input DNA, and NGS library-preparation workflows.
  • Develop automated methods for processes such as magnetic-bead purification, DNA cleanup, end repair, adapter ligation, unique molecular identifier incorporation, amplification, target enrichment, and library normalization, as applicable.
  • Optimize liquid handling to minimize sample loss, improve transfer consistency, and control contamination and carryover.
  • Support samples with variable DNA concentrations and fragment-size distributions.
  • Work closely with assay development scientists and other technical partners to assess library quality, sequencing metrics, and overall workflow performance.
  • Investigate workflow failures and implement corrective actions that improve assay robustness, recovery, and reproducibility.
Method Development, Qualification, and Validation
  • Design and execute experiments comparing automated workflows with established manual or reference methods.
  • Establish and evaluate acceptance criteria for pipetting accuracy and precision, sample recovery, library yield, fragment-size distribution, contamination, carryover, and reproducibility.
  • Develop and execute instrument qualification, method verification, and performance-testing protocols.
  • Support analytical validation, method transfer, and process scale-up in collaboration with assay development, quality, laboratory operations, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear records of development experiments, deviations, corrective actions, and method changes.
  • Develop and maintain automation workflows in alignment with applicable laboratory quality systems and regulatory requirements.
Troubleshooting and Operational Support
  • Perform root-cause analysis of robotic errors, liquid-handling failures, assay variability, and instrument-integration issues.
  • Optimize liquid classes, mixing parameters, aspiration and dispense settings, deck configurations, and error-handling logic.
  • Develop operating, preventive-maintenance, and troubleshooting procedures in partnership with equipment vendors.
  • Train laboratory personnel on routine operation, workflow execution, and error recovery.
  • Prepare technical documentation and provide ongoing support during transfer into routine laboratory use.
Requirments:
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in automation engineering, robotics, biomedical engineering, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, biotechnology, molecular biology, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3–5 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience programming and debugging liquid-handling robots, preferably using Hamilton, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable platforms.
  • Proven ability to write custom automation scripts and translate laboratory protocols into automated methods.
  • Experience with NGS library preparation, molecular biology workflows, DNA purification, or related sample-preparation processes.
  • Strong understanding of liquid handling, magnetic-bead purification, reaction setup, thermal cycling, and multistep plate-based workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting automation methods, liquid transfers, laboratory instruments, and integrated workflows.
  • Ability to independently drive automation projects from development through implementation.
  • Strong technical documentation, experimental-design, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with scientists, engineers, laboratory operations personnel, quality teams, software or LIMS partners, and equipment vendors.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with cfDNA, circulating tumor DNA, liquid biopsy, or other low-input DNA workflows.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing panels, hybrid-capture methods, UMI-based sequencing, or other highly sensitive molecular diagnostic applications.
  • Familiarity with Illumina-compatible library-preparation chemistry and sequencing workflows.
  • Experience with automation in clinical diagnostics, regulated laboratories, assay validation, or design-control environments.
  • Programming experience with Python, SQL, APIs, or related tools used for instrument integration, data processing, and LIMS connectivity.
  • Experience with low-volume liquid handling, liquid-class optimization, automated sample tracking, and contamination control.
  • Experience integrating laboratory automation with thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode systems, robotic plate movement, or other supporting instrumentation.

#IND-SPG

You’ll help to manage program schedules, facilitate design reviews, track progress across cross-functional teams, and ensure alignment between engineering, construction, and operations. job.title: RF Test Engineer
job.description:
RF Test Engineer
We are seeking an RF Test Engineer to support RF validation, design verification, and system-level testing of wireless devices. This hands-on role focuses on OTA and conducted RF testing, test setup and automation, data analysis, lab operations, and hardware rework within an RF development environment.

Scope:
• Perform RF system testing for design verification and system validation, including conducted and radiated testing for RF performance, interference, noise floor (RSSI), coexistence, throughput, and related wireless performance metrics.
• Execute OTA testing, including TRP, TIS, and aGPS measurements in both signaling and non-signaling modes using RF test chambers and call box equipment.
• Configure, operate, and troubleshoot RF test equipment, including anechoic chambers, call boxes, and internally developed test tools.
• Collect, analyze, and document test data using spreadsheets, databases, and Python scripts to generate reports and communicate results.
• Set up and maintain RF test environments, calibration schedules, laboratory equipment, and hardware development workspaces.
• Perform hardware rework, prototype modifications, and mock-up assembly to support RF validation and testing activities.
• Support debugging and root cause analysis of RF performance issues in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.

Required:
• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electronic Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 8+ years of experience with electrical troubleshooting, electrical assembly, and mechanical assembly.
• Experience operating OTA chambers from R&S, BlueTest, or GTS.
• Experience using RF call boxes from R&S, Keysight, or Anritsu.
• Experience working with RF passive and active components, including splitters, filters, amplifiers, and related hardware.
• Proficiency with Windows or ChromeOS environments.
• Experience using Google Docs, Google Sheets, or equivalent documentation and spreadsheet tools.
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and communication abilities.

Pluses:
• Experience performing RF desense testing, including noise profile, interference, and coexistence measurements.
• Experience developing RF hardware test setups for conducted measurements.
• Strong soldering and fine-pitch rework skills (0201 components).
• Experience building prototype hardware, mockups, or custom test fixtures.
• Experience with Python or other scripting languages for test automation and data analysis.
• Strong electrical debugging and troubleshooting skills.
• Advanced hardware rework experience.

job.title: Lateral Flow Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lateral Flow Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Lateral Flow Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. This candidate must have knowledge of BioDot, Zeta, or Imagene Isoflow reel to reel systems.

Responsibilities
  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.
  • Utilizing BioDot, Zeta, or Imagene Isoflow reel to reel systems.
  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.
  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.
  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 
  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.
  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.
  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.
  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.
  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.
  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).
  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.
Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience with BioDot, Zeta, or Imagene Isoflow reel to reel systems.
  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.
  • Experience in a regulated environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.
  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.
  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

job.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Onsite - Southlake, TX, W2 Only
job.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer
Onsite - Southlake, TX, W2 Only

Role Summary

Seeking Senior Full Stack Engineers with experience across Java, Angular, Node.js, Spring, and AWS.

The team is targeting a balanced full stack skill set, ideally with approximately 50% front end and 50% back end experience. Because there are two openings, the manager is open to hiring one engineer who is stronger on the front end and another who is stronger on the back end, provided the two hires collectively provide balanced coverage.

Responsibilities
  • Design and build enterprise software applications
  • Contribute across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, technical teams, and business stakeholders
  • Deliver prioritized features and scalable technology solutions
  • Participate in architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Troubleshoot production issues from analysis through resolution
  • Contribute to a strong engineering and quality focused culture
Expertise and Skills
  • 5 to 10 years of hands on experience designing and building software applications
  • Full stack engineering experience with Java, Angular, Node.js, and JavaScript
  • Experience developing REST services using Express, Node.js, Spring Boot, and Dropwizard
  • Strong knowledge of microservices and distributed application architectures
  • Experience with AWS services such as VPC, ECS, S3, Lambda, RDS, Glue, Elastic Load Balancing, SQS, and SNS
  • Experience deploying applications using Docker containers
  • Knowledge of mocking frameworks and service virtualization
  • Experience with static code analysis tools such as Sonar
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests
  • Experience designing and building RESTful services
  • GraphQL experience is a plus
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving production issues
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Interest in learning new technologies and contributing beyond assigned responsibilities

job.description:

  • Triage and management of work-related injuries and illnesses
  • Occupational health assessments: pre-placement/annual, return-to-work (occ & non-occ), fitness-for-duty, respirator medical evaluations (29 CFR 1910.134).

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
The Opportunity Yoh is partnering with a growing molecular diagnostics company focused on advancing blood-based cancer screening and early detection. The organization is entering an important stage of clinical development and growth and is seeking a hands-on Chief Financial Officer to lead its finance function through its next phase.

This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial finance leader who can combine strategic CFO-level thinking with hands-on financial and accounting oversight.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable building a financial model, reviewing the underlying accounting, and presenting the financial story to executives, investors, and external stakeholders.

Working closely with executive and scientific leadership, the CFO will help align capital, financial planning, and operating decisions with key clinical and business milestones.

What You'll Do
  • Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and financial reporting.
  • Build and maintain financial models supporting an FDA-regulated study, operating plans, and future growth.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into cash requirements, runway, spending, and financial scenarios.
  • Maintain hands-on ownership of accounting and financial reporting.
  • Ensure appropriate financial controls and GAAP-compliant financial reporting.
  • Support private financing activities, including financial modeling, due diligence, and investor reporting.
  • Translate financial results, forecasts, and operating plans into a clear and compelling financial story for investors and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with executive and scientific leadership on capital allocation, operating investments, and key business decisions.
  • Build scalable financial processes and infrastructure to support continued organizational growth.
What We're Looking For
  • Significant finance and accounting experience within a privately held or growth-stage organization.
  • Strong financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and accounting capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting private financing, venture-backed organizations, or capital-raising activities.
  • Finance leadership experience within biotechnology, molecular diagnostics, or another regulated life sciences company strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting an FDA-regulated product, clinical study, or related development program is particularly valuable.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, and GAAP-compliant reporting.
  • Ability to move seamlessly between strategic financial leadership and hands-on execution.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial information for executives, investors, and external stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial and proactive approach, with a willingness to take ownership and operate effectively within a growing organization.
We welcome candidates currently serving in hands-on CFO or senior finance leadership positions, as well as accomplished VP Finance or Controller-level leaders ready to step into their first CFO role.

Compensation Base Salary: $260,000–$320,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

The total compensation package includes a stock-option equity component, providing an opportunity to participate in the company's long-term growth and value creation.

Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to join a science-driven organization at an important point in its evolution and take meaningful ownership of the financial infrastructure supporting its next stage.

For a finance leader who wants to build rather than simply manage, this role provides the opportunity to influence financial strategy, capital deployment, clinical development, and long-term company growth while supporting a mission focused on improving cancer screening and prevention.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.

Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $200000 + 15% bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX. This is a hands-on, floor-oriented engineering position supporting day-to-day pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D to troubleshoot equipment and process issues, improve manufacturing performance, support new product and equipment initiatives, and ensure compliance with FDA and cGMP requirements.

The ideal candidate will have direct pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, particularly with liquid and/or semi-solid products, and be comfortable spending significant time on the manufacturing floor.


Title: Manufacturing Engineer 
Location: Rosenberg, TX
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing and packaging equipment issues to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.
  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation activities.
  • Develop and execute engineering and validation documentation, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Support process validation and cleaning validation activities.
  • Investigate manufacturing deviations and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Develop and implement CAPA and change controls.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
  • Support manufacturing process improvements and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D teams.
  • Develop and revise SOPs, manufacturing procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Ensure engineering and manufacturing activities comply with applicable FDA, cGMP, safety, and quality requirements.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, with preference for candidates with 5+ years.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA requirements, cGMP, and regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.
  • Direct experience manufacturing semi-solid products, such as creams, ointments, and suppositories, and/or liquid products, including solutions and suspensions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing and packaging equipment.
  • Experience with equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation.
  • Working knowledge of IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, and cleaning validation.
  • Experience with deviations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and change control.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing floor supporting daily operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI), process scale-up, and technology transfer.
  • Experience developing User Requirement Specifications (URS).
  • Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
  • Proven success improving throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and OEE.
  • Demonstrated ability to reduce downtime and optimize manufacturing costs.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies.
  • Experience developing and revising SOPs and manufacturing work instructions.
  • Experience supporting regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system.

job.title: Geneticists
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Geneticists for our clinical diagnostics laboratory client. In this leadership role, you will oversee the overall operations, strategic direction, and scientific integrity of the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with all applicable clinical laboratory regulations and quality standards. The Geneticists will provide scientific and operational leadership for cytogenetics and molecular cytogenetics testing, including oncology genetics, FISH, and advanced genetic testing technologies. This position will be responsible for laboratory performance, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, staff development, and the implementation of new technologies and services. The ideal candidate will bring extensive clinical laboratory leadership experience, strong expertise in cancer cytogenetics, and the ability to drive operational excellence while supporting organizational growth.

Industry: Clinical Diagnostics / Genetics / Molecular Cytogenetics
Location: Alpharetta, GA
Compensation: 160k - 180k annual
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Provide strategic, scientific, and operational leadership for the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with applicable clinical laboratory regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.

  • Direct and oversee daily laboratory operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable genetic testing and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain an effective departmental structure to support uninterrupted laboratory operations, regulatory compliance, and scientific integrity.

  • Oversee patient report sign-out activities in collaboration with the Pathology team, ensuring accuracy and validity of test results.

  • Direct the development, implementation, and maintenance of laboratory procedures, testing methods, and Quality Control processes.

  • Assume responsibility for the review and approval of laboratory activities, including internal and external Quality Control and validation of new equipment, methods, and testing procedures.

  • Support strategic planning, business development, and implementation of new genetic testing technologies, laboratory services, and diagnostic assays.

  • Lead initiatives involving microarray testing strategies and technical-only Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) services.

  • Provide scientific and technical expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, oncology genetics, and related diagnostic testing.

  • Collaborate with internal departments and external customers to address scientific, medical, laboratory, and patient-reporting inquiries.

  • Review and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Genetics Department.

  • Maintain laboratory accreditation and Quality Assurance programs in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Serve as the primary departmental representative during laboratory inspections, regulatory audits, and accreditation assessments.

  • Ensure timely investigation and implementation of corrective actions related to audit findings, laboratory deficiencies, and Quality System issues.

  • Develop and deliver scientific presentations and technical training for employees, customers, and professional meetings.

  • Provide scientific guidance and consultation on complex laboratory testing and technical issues.

  • Oversee departmental training programs and ensure personnel competency, procedural compliance, and adherence to laboratory policies.

  • Mentor, train, and develop Associate Genetics Directors and other laboratory personnel.

  • Monitor developments in clinical laboratory medicine, oncology genetics, cytogenetics, and emerging diagnostic technologies.

  • Maintain required professional licensure, certifications, and continuing education to ensure compliance with applicable standards.

  • Foster a collaborative departmental culture that promotes teamwork, knowledge sharing, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • Support long-term laboratory planning, growth strategies, and organizational performance initiatives.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • MD or PhD in Genetics or a closely related scientific discipline required.

  • Completion of a two-year American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG)-approved training program required.

  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant clinical laboratory experience.

  • Extensive knowledge and demonstrated expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, and Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH).

  • Strong experience in cancer cytogenetics, including complex cancer karyotyping using microscopy and molecular approaches.

  • Experience with constitutional and prenatal cytogenetics, including Products of Conception (POC) testing.

  • Familiarity with advanced genetic and diagnostic testing technologies, including microarray testing.

  • Demonstrated experience overseeing clinical laboratory operations, Quality Control, method validation, and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience developing, reviewing, and approving laboratory SOPs, testing procedures, and Quality Assurance documentation.

  • Strong understanding of clinical laboratory accreditation requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  • Experience supporting laboratory inspections, audits, and corrective action initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide scientific and technical leadership in a clinical diagnostics environment.

  • Experience mentoring, training, and developing scientific and laboratory personnel.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical information to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Pathology, laboratory operations, executive leadership, and external customers.

  • Strong strategic planning and operational leadership skills with the ability to support laboratory growth and new testing initiatives.

Required Certifications

  • Certification by the American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG) or equivalent qualifications and certifications acceptable for a CLIA laboratory director.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Clinical diagnostics laboratory and professional office environment.

  • Regular use of computers and laboratory information systems for reviewing patient reports, laboratory documentation, and scientific data.

  • May require standing, walking, or sitting for extended periods while overseeing laboratory operations and administrative responsibilities.

  • Ability to review detailed microscopic images, cytogenetic results, laboratory reports, and technical documentation.

  • May require working within clinical laboratory environments while following established safety, infection control, and regulatory procedures.

  • Must maintain compliance with laboratory safety requirements and applicable policies.

job.title: Dynatrace Momnitoring and Observability Engineer
job.description:
This is FT role in Bridgewater NJ, Hybrid. 
Unable to sponsor now or in the future. About the Role We are seeking a Staff Engineer to own the technical strategy for observability across the global network, infrastructure, and cloud estate. This is the most senior individual contributor role in the monitoring discipline. You will set the multi-year observability roadmap, act as the final technical authority on Dynatrace architecture and drive adoption of monitoring standards across Network, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps and Application teams.  Dynatrace is our primary platform, but this is not a single-tool role. You will own the wider telemetry ecosystem, including ThousandEyes for service health and native cloud monitoring services and decide where each tool belongs.  The role carries enterprise-wide influence without direct reports. Success depends on your ability to build consensus, mentor other engineers and make architectural decisions that hold up over years rather than sprints. What You'll Do In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to own the enterprise observability strategy and multi-year roadmap, covering platform architecture, tool rationalization, data retention, and a substantial focus on AI-driven operations.

You’ll also:

  • Serve as the technical authority for Dynatrace architecture; tenant and management zone design, ActiveGate topology, OneAgent deployment patterns, Grail data ingestion and multi-environment scaling.
  • Define the reference architecture for full-stack observability across metrics, logs, traces and events; spanning infrastructure, APM, RUM and synthetic monitoring and hold teams to it through design review.
  • Define the observability architecture for multi-cloud workloads, integrating GCP Cloud Monitoring and Logging, AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor with Dynatrace.
  • Evaluate emerging capabilities with the likes of OpenTelemetry, eBPF-based instrumentation, AIOps and make build-versus-buy recommendations to IT leadership.
  • Automate the full monitoring lifecycle through Dynatrace APIs, Monitoring as Code (Dynatrace Configuration as Code / Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • Build advanced queries, dashboards, and Notebooks that translate telemetry into decisions for engineering and executive audiences.
  • Lead architecture and technical design reviews for monitoring changes affecting production or GxP-relevant systems.
  • Design SLAs, SLOs, onboarding paths, self-service tooling, and documented consumption patterns for tenant teams.
  • Act as the senior escalation point during major incidents, using telemetry to isolate root cause across the network, infrastructure, and application layers.
  • Mentor engineers across Network, Infrastructure, Cloud, and DevOps, raising the monitoring standard through review and enablement rather than mandate.
Who You Are You have a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field as well as a minimum of 10+ years in IT infrastructure, monitoring, observability or network engineering.

You are or also have:

  • At least 6 years of hands-on experience with Dynatrace, including OneAgent and ActiveGate deployment at scale, Smartscape, Davis AI, SLO configuration, DQL and API-driven automation.
  • A minimum of 4 years designing and operating monitoring for public cloud environments (GCP and/or AWS).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one complementary observability platform (Grafana, Splunk, or equivalent) and clear judgment about where each tool belongs.
  • Demonstrated experience with Dynatrace: OneAgent, ActiveGate, Smartscape, Davis AI, Grail, DQL, SLOs, Workflows, Configuration as Code, REST APIs.
  • Proven experience with complementary platforms such as Grafana dashboarding and data sources; Splunk search and log analytics; native cloud monitoring services.
  • Proven Networking (Cisco) experience with Catalyst switching, ISR routers, Meraki, DNA Center, OSPF, BGP, IPSec VPN, RADIUS/NPS, NetFlow and streaming telemetry.
  • Mult-cloud platform experience with GCP (Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, VPC, IAM, Compute Engine, GKE); AWS (CloudWatch, Config, CloudTrail, VPC, EC2, EKS, IAM).
  • Knowledge of Containers such as Kubernetes, Docker, and OpenShift monitoring and instrumentation.
  • Automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or Bash; Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling; CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • Knowledge of ITSM and DevOps toolchain: ServiceNow integration and workflow automation; pipeline-embedded quality and monitoring gates.  Solid understanding of Frameworks: ITIL, change management, SRE practice (SLI/SLO/error budgets), Agile delivery.
Nice to have (but not a must)
  • Azure Monitor exposure.
  • Experience delivering monitoring in a regulated or GxP environment.

job.title: Refrigeration Engineering Manager
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineering Manager for our Research and Development client in Marietta, Ohio. Willing to relocate qualified candidates!

Job Functions:
  • Lead and manage a global refrigeration engineering organization responsible for cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Own refrigeration system architecture and strategy aligned with product roadmaps and platform reuse initiatives.
  • Provide technical oversight for sealed-system design, including compressors, heat exchangers, refrigerants, controls interfaces, and safety devices.
  • Lead the use of thermal modeling, system simulation, and analytical tools to predict performance, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to ensure robust design transfer and global production readiness.
  • Develop budgets, resource plans, and schedules in partnership with NPD project managers and leadership.
  • Balance internal resources, global engineering contractors, and third-party support.
  • Coach engineers and technicians to build technical capability and leadership depth.
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams in the design and evaluation of refrigeration or thermal systems
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Strong foundation in vapor-compression and cascade refrigeration systems

job.title: Senior / Lead Full Stack Engineer - Onsite, Southlake, TX - W2 Only
job.description:
Senior / Lead Full Stack Engineer 
Onsite, Southlake, TX - W2 Only


The Role The team is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support hands on application development and delivery. This role requires strong technical expertise and active participation in architecture, design, analysis, and implementation activities.

Responsibilities
  • Provide senior technical leadership in the delivery of enterprise platforms
  • Mentor developers on sound development practices, RESTful APIs, microservices, and UI development using HTML5, JavaScript, and Angular
  • Provide leadership on development policies, procedures, standards, and strategies
  • Improve the productivity and quality of the overall development process
  • Own end to end engineering delivery from backlog refinement and sprint planning through release management and production deployment
  • Remove organizational blockers and dependencies that affect engineering execution
  • Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and operational stability improvements
  • Manage technology lifecycles and ensure applications and platform components remain current and aligned with established standards and best practices
The Expertise and Skills You Bring
  • 10+ years of leadership and software development experience, with expertise in APIs and microservices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Proven experience developing REST APIs using Node.js, Spring, and Spring Boot
  • Strong experience using Node.js as a user interface backend
  • Hands on experience building user interfaces with HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular
  • Strong understanding of REST API implementation, including enterprise authentication and authorization models
  • Excellent understanding of Java 17 or Java 21
  • Experience with Spring modules including IoC, Spring MVC, Spring Batch, Spring Boot, OAuth2, and Spring Security
  • Experience with YugabyteDB, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Experience designing and developing ETL pipelines using enterprise integration tools, preferably SnapLogic
  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as JUnit, Jasmine, Cypress, Playwright, Jest, and Storybook
  • Experience designing and implementing container based solutions, preferably Kubernetes on EKS or AKS
  • Experience with data monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog and Splunk
  • Proven experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle, DevOps, and continuous integration and continuous delivery within an Agile environment

job.description:

job.title: QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC) to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Experience with every analytical technique is not required, as training will be provided.
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Perform analytical testing utilizing techniques such as AEX, SEC, and purity-based assays.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC and/or UPLC.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
#IND-SPG

Location: San Mateo or surrounding San Francisco Bay Area
Job Type: Contract
Work Arrangement: Hybrid with regular onsite presence required
Estimated Compensation: $90–$110/hour, depending on experience

Responsibilities Systems Engineering
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for complex infrastructure requirements and technical challenges.
  • Design, deploy, administer, and optimize Microsoft Active Directory and core identity infrastructure, including domain services, Group Policy, DNS, authentication, replication, and cloud identity integrations.
  • Engineer and operate enterprise compute, virtualization, and storage infrastructure supporting business, engineering, and mission-critical workloads.
  • Design, administer, and optimize enterprise storage platforms, including capacity planning, performance, availability, data protection, replication, and lifecycle management.
  • Support compute platforms across data centers, colocation facilities, corporate offices, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Support virtualization, GPU-accelerated infrastructure, VDI, and specialized engineering workloads.
  • Engineer and maintain Windows and Linux server infrastructure.
  • Perform capacity planning and infrastructure sizing for new workloads, engineering environments, site expansions, and data center deployments.
  • Design, deploy, and maintain data center and colocation infrastructure, including server and storage platforms, rack-level deployments, hardware lifecycle management, resiliency, and coordination with external providers.
Resiliency, Operations, and Automation
  • Design and continuously improve backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure-resiliency solutions.
  • Define and support recovery architecture, replication strategies, recovery objectives, testing, documentation, and disaster-recovery exercises.
  • Implement monitoring and observability for infrastructure availability, capacity, performance, and reliability.
  • Identify opportunities for proactive improvement before they become operational issues.
  • Develop infrastructure automation and repeatable deployment patterns using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Support integration between on-premises infrastructure and AWS or Azure environments.
  • Support containerized or Kubernetes-based infrastructure where appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure incidents.
  • Serve as an escalation point for critical production issues.
  • Participate in on-call, emergency-response, and planned-maintenance activities as required.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams on infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with network engineering teams on infrastructure connectivity and technical dependencies while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.
  • Lead infrastructure projects and technical initiatives from design through implementation.
  • Develop architecture standards, operational documentation, and handoff procedures.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance while remaining hands-on with infrastructure engineering and implementation.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, operating procedures, and engineering best practices.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Eight or more years of experience engineering and supporting enterprise infrastructure in production environments.
  • Advanced experience administering and engineering Microsoft Active Directory, including AD DS, Group Policy, DNS, authentication, and replication.
  • Strong experience with enterprise compute, virtualization, and storage platforms, including VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, NetApp, Pure Storage, Dell EMC, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong Windows Server administration experience.
  • Working proficiency with Linux systems such as RHEL or Ubuntu.
  • Experience designing and implementing backup, replication, disaster recovery, and business-continuity solutions.
  • Experience with RTO/RPO planning, disaster-recovery testing, and recovery exercises.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure across on-premises environments and AWS and/or Azure.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, troubleshoot ambiguous problems, and mentor other engineers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a structured, process-driven environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting infrastructure in high-availability, mission-critical, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or engineering environments.
  • Deep experience with enterprise storage and data-protection ecosystems, including NetApp, Pure Storage, Dell EMC, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing infrastructure across multiple offices, engineering sites, laboratories, data centers, or colocation environments.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or containerized workloads and the underlying compute, storage, and infrastructure requirements.
  • Experience supporting GPU compute, high-performance computing, or other accelerated engineering workloads.
  • Experience with VDI platforms such as VMware Horizon, Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs, and firewalls.
  • Experience operating in security-conscious or regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure controls aligned with frameworks such as NIST or CMMC.
  • Relevant technical certifications, such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, NetApp, AWS, Azure, or equivalent certifications.
Additional Requirements
  • Must be located in or able to commute to the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Must be able to work onsite regularly in the San Mateo area.
  • Must be available to participate in on-call, emergency-response, and scheduled-maintenance activities.
  • Must comply with applicable workplace, security, confidentiality, and access requirements.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check conducted after a conditional offer, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law.
