job.title: Letter of Credit / Client Processing Specialist
job.description:
Job Description
 
Position Summary:
 
The Senior Specialist, Client Processing will be responsible for handling Complex Letter of Credit structuring and manage the Letter of Credit life cycle for High-priority Trade clients by providing timely and quality support to the clients in facilitating their transactions and processes.  This role may also involve working with various stakeholders like Clients, FIs and NBFIs, simultaneously. 
 
Responsibilities: 
  • Ensure transactions and inquiries of High-priority clients are handled timely and accurately.
  • Applies in-depth knowledge and expertise on service offerings, proactive assessment and resolution of complex transaction issues. 
  • Assist Product and Relationship team with Operational/ transactional insights to manage client expectations. 
  • Participate in the risk review sessions conducted by the Team to identify mitigate inherent and residual risk of the processes.
  • As a documentary credit specialist, support the Team in crafting solutions and methods to resolve issues at hand and similar issues in the future.
  • Responsible for structuring Letter of Credit & Guarantees vetting by collaborating with the Clients, Legal, Product, Risk & Compliance.
  • Contribute to workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.
  • Provides expert guidance on service offerings and resolves complex transaction issues.
 
Required Qualification:
  • 5-7 years of total work experience with at least 5+ years in Trade Finance domain (Letter of Credit, Document Examination, Guarantees/ Standby Letter of Credit) is required.  Well versed with UCP, URDG and ISP guidelines are preferred. Applicable local / regional licenses or certifications as required by the business.  Trade Certifications (example: CDCS, CSDG etc.) is added advantage.
  • A strong knowledge of Sanctions, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Boycott guidelines, as well as their relevance to Trade Finance, is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Advanced/Post graduation degree preferred.

job.title: Zscaler Analyst/Engineer
job.description:
Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer
6 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
McKinney, TX (Hybrid 3 days a week, Must be local to Dallas)

We are seeking a hands-on Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer to support the rollout, administration, and ongoing operations of an enterprise Zscaler environment.
This individual will take ownership of the operational side of the Zscaler suite, including implementation support, day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and break/fix activities. A key focus will be supporting the rollout of Zscaler for branch application connectivity, including App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
The ideal candidate will come from a strong network engineering or network operations background and have hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day operational support of the Zscaler platform.
  • Support the rollout of Zscaler across branch locations and branch application connectivity.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Zscaler App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
  • Provide hands-on break/fix support for Zscaler-related connectivity and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application access, connectivity, routing, DNS, and network-related issues involving Zscaler.
  • Support configuration changes, platform updates, testing, and ongoing optimization of the Zscaler environment.
  • Monitor the environment and investigate issues impacting users, branch locations, applications, or network connectivity.
  • Work closely with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to troubleshoot cross-functional issues.
  • Help establish an internal Zscaler operational knowledge base, including configurations, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and resolutions.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for ongoing Zscaler operational support.
  • Coordinate with Zscaler support and other vendors as needed to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support the organization's broader network environment, which currently utilizes HPE/HP networking technology and is expected to transition toward Cisco Meraki.

Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler App Connector deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Zscaler Branch Connector or comparable branch connectivity implementations.
  • Strong network engineering or network operations background.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network and application connectivity issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • Routing
    • Network security
    • Firewalls
    • Application connectivity
    • SSL/TLS
    • Zero Trust networking concepts
  • Experience providing operational support and resolving production incidents.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Strong documentation skills with the ability to build technical procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with multiple components of the Zscaler product suite.
  • Experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and/or Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
  • Hands-on experience with HPE/HP networking technologies.
  • Cisco Meraki experience, especially supporting enterprise or branch networking environments.
  • Experience working within a Zero Trust or SASE architecture.
  • Experience supporting large, distributed environments with multiple branch locations.
  • Previous experience helping an organization establish operational processes around a newly implemented network/security platform.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer – Instrumentation (NPI + Sustaining)
job.description:
Yoh is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our biotech instrumentation client, supporting new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining engineering efforts for their state-of-the-art platforms. The ideal individual will have strong competency in SolidWorks and expert knowledge of GD&T, with experience supporting mechanical design development, troubleshooting, and documentation for complex instrumentation.

Industry: Biotech / Instrumentation
Location: Pleasanton, CA

Responsibilities 
  • Support mechanical design efforts for NPI and sustaining engineering projects, including development, verification, validation, and production transfer.
  • Work with R&D, manufacturing, and service teams to bring new instrument platforms from prototype to production.
  • Assist in design updates by analyzing field issues, reviewing return material data, and driving improvements to reliability and manufacturability.
  • Support root cause analysis activities and help implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with internal teams and contract manufacturers.
  • Perform hands-on troubleshooting and evaluation of mechanical, optical, and electromechanical subsystems.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, including BOMs, ECOs, risk assessments, and updates in PLM/ERP systems.
  • Prepare technical reports and documentation to communicate findings across cross-functional teams.
Required Skills (Must-Haves)
  • Solidworks, expert knowledge of GD&T
  • Machine shop or hands-on fabrication experience.
  • Manufacturing or production support experience.
  • Experience with NPI processes, pilot builds, or design transfer.
  • Familiarity with optics, motion systems, or electromechanical assemblies.
  • Experience troubleshooting liquid handling or automation systems.
  • Exposure to DFM/DFA, ISO 13485, FDA-regulated environments.
  • Experience with reliability testing (MTBF/MTTR) and FMEA.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Jira, Confluence, Oracle ERP, or Arena PLM.
  • Strong collaboration skills across R&D, operations, supply chain, and service teams.

job.title: Staff Data & Analytics Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Staff Data & Analytics Engineer. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced data engineering professional with expertise in enterprise data platforms, analytics architecture, and data integration across Supply Chain and Manufacturing environments.

This position is based in San Diego, CA, with remote work eligibility.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Staff Data & Analytics Engineer
Compensation: $80-95/hour
Type: Contract
Location: Remote Eligible
 

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions supporting enterprise Supply Chain and Manufacturing operations.

  • Lead data discovery, integration, and transformation efforts across complex business systems and data sources.

  • Develop and maintain enterprise data models, curated datasets, and reusable data products to support reporting and analytics.

  • Build and enhance lakehouse architectures using Databricks, Delta Lake, and Bronze/Silver/Gold data layers.

  • Integrate data from enterprise platforms such as ERP, PLM, MES, and MRP systems.

  • Establish data modeling, governance, and quality standards to improve consistency, accessibility, and reliability.

  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable data solutions.

  • Support the development of standardized metrics, semantic models, and analytics frameworks across business functions.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, or Data Architecture.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, SQL, Python/PySpark, and Delta Lake.

  • Expertise in dimensional data modeling, semantic modeling, and modern lakehouse architectures.

  • Experience designing and implementing Bronze/Silver/Gold data pipelines and transformation frameworks.

  • Experience integrating enterprise systems such as ERP, PLM, MES, or MRP.

  • Strong understanding of Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Procurement business processes and associated data.

  • Experience developing reliable, scalable, and well-governed enterprise data solutions.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience developing enterprise data products for Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Procurement analytics.

  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, and enterprise data architecture best practices.

job.title: Chemical Operator/Material Handler (1st shift)
job.description:
Chemical Operator/Material Handler (1st shift) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Marlborough, MA.
  • Pay Rate: $22-24.50/hr
  • Day shift: 7am-330pm M-F
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Perform manufacturing batch processing tasks as specified in written procedures to support the production, packaging, and handling of materials.
  • The position requires a focus on safety, strong communication skills, and a resiliency to attention to detail.
  • As a Material Handling Specialist, you will produce package batches produced in manufacturing areas for the semiconductor industry.
  • Maintain a safe working environment and participate in all required safety programs, training, and activities.
  • Follow Operating Discipline principles, procedures and practices to ensure safe and efficient operation of assigned plant areas.
  • Handling hazardous raw materials and products with appropriate care and precautions.
  • Operate and field check process equipment. Monitor process conditions, equipment, and DCS/Delta V control systems.
  • Receive direction from area leads/supervisor and complete assigned tasks.
  • Complete routine and repetitive activities such as labeling, forming and filling boxes, moving materials and equipment.
Required:
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment and/or clean room is preferred.
  • Fork Truck operation experience a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Exceptional Attention to Detail.
  • Self-motivating and hard working.
  • Light to moderate physical effort required.
  • Standing/Walking for the majority of the 8-hour shift.
  • Lifting required occasionally of up to 40 pounds.
  • Bending, pushing and pulling required on a daily basis.
  • Ability to occasionally work at table level and/or overhead level as necessary.
  • Required to wear appropriate PPE.
  • Required to work in a RESTRICTED electrically classified area for use of flammable and combustible materials.
Work Environment:
  • Work performed in a plant environment.
  • Exposure to elements such as odor, noise, dust, heat, cold, chemical and other elements.
  • Required to wear appropriate and designated PPE within certain areas of the plant (e.g. hard-hat, goggles, gloves, respirator, cleanroom garment).
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest manufacturing companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Senior Specialist Clinical Supply Chain - Hybrid, Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Senior Specialist, Clinical Supply Chain Operations

Overview:

This role supports the reliable and compliant execution of clinical supply activities across multiple studies. The position focuses on day to day operational execution, ensuring clinical materials are packaged, labeled, distributed, and available to sites and patients on time. The role works closely with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and external vendors to maintain supply continuity and visibility.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead clinical supply activities across packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory management, and study closeout
• Execute supply activities according to study timelines, including site readiness, patient supply, and resupply management
• Monitor inventory levels and supply availability across assigned studies
• Partner with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, and external vendors to support clinical supply plans
• Support IRT systems used for supply tracking and resupply execution
• Identify and escalate risks such as delays, supply constraints, and deviations
• Support the investigation and documentation of temperature excursions and supply deviations
• Ensure activities are compliant, properly documented, and inspection ready
• Contribute to process improvements and the adoption of new tools and procedures
• Maintain accurate supply plans, trackers, and other required clinical supply documentation

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Supply Chain Management, or a related field
• Three or more years of relevant clinical supply chain experience
• Understanding of end to end clinical supply chain activities
• Experience with IRT systems
• Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations
• Knowledge of GxP requirements
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project
• Ability to adapt to changing conditions and develop practical solutions
• Strong attention to detail
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment

job.description:
Vice President, Cash Processing/Funds Transfer Manager

Our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, COMPANY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Cash Processing/Funds Transfer Manager to join our Treasury Services Platform Ops team. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Experienced in business analysis activities such as requirements gathering, detailed data analysis, data mapping and coordinate with development team while collaborating with business teams.
  • Formulates and defines system's scope and objectives based on both user needs and a good understanding of the application, business, operational and/or industry requirements.
  • Create detailed documentation of current state assessments, future state models, gap analyses, and proposed solutions. Prepare and present reports to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Develops business requirements and functional specifications for medium to large sized projects.
  • Collects and defines requirements, translates into functional design, test planning, and user documentation processes.
  • Provides advice to internal business groups on process improvement projects by analyzing business process flows and identifying changes.
  • Act as the go between the product/business and technology team
  • Exposure to Agile methodologies & practices including Jira and confluence
  • Preferred certifications include CBAP and CSM
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. - Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CFA, CPA) is preferred.
  • Typically 4-7 years of experience.
  • 8+ ; years of total work experience in Trade Finance domain.
  • Preferred experience in trade finance operations, including letters of credit, documentary collections, Standby LC and trade loans.
  • Strong knowledge of international trade regulations and compliance requirements
  • Strong knowledge of SWIFT messaging standards and protocols.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Job title: Senior Project Manager
Location: Parsippany, NJ- 4 days onsite
Type: Contract- W2 only
Duration: 12 Months


Our client is seeking a strong, senior-level Project Manager to join its PMO and manage a portfolio of approximately 2–3 projects. The initial is around ancillary revenue and digital sales; the sponsor is a Senior VP
This is a true project management role. Engineering and Product teams operate in an Agile environment, but the Project Manager will not be responsible for running sprints or writing user stories. Instead, this person will own the overall budget, schedule, risks, stakeholder management, communications, dependencies, and project health.

Key Responsibilities
•    Manage 2–3 complex enterprise projects from planning through delivery.
•    Own project budgets, actuals, committed costs, forecasts, and variances.
•    Manage schedules, milestones, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
•    Create and maintain risk logs, mitigation plans, and escalation strategies.
•    Develop stakeholder and communication plans.
•    Present project status, financials, risks, and issues to senior and executive stakeholders.
•    Partner closely with dedicated Engineering and Product leaders.
•    Identify issues proactively and hold teams accountable for successful delivery.
•    Communicate difficult news regarding budget, scope, schedule, or risk in a professional and effective manner.
•    Bring strong PMBOK practices, discipline, and structure to the broader PMO.

Must-Have Qualifications
•    7+ years of project management experience within large and complex organizations.
•    Strong practical knowledge of PMBOK disciplines.
•    Deep cost management experience, including actuals, committed costs, forecasts, variances, and identifying potential overruns.
•    Strong risk management capabilities, including risk identification, logging, impact assessment, mitigation planning, ownership, and escalation.
•    Proven stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
•    Experience managing project schedules and cross-functional dependencies.
•    Experience partnering with Engineering and Product teams in Agile or hybrid environments.
•    Strong executive presence and ability to influence without direct authority.
•    Comfortable independently driving projects, not simply coordinating meetings and status updates.
•    Ability to work at least four days per week onsite in Parsippany, NJ.

Note: The client emphasized that practical application of project management disciplines is more important than simply holding a PMP certification.

Preferred Qualifications
•    Experience managing customer-facing websites or digital portal initiatives.
•    Experience in hospitality, travel, rental, mobility, or transportation industries.
The client operates in a hybrid PMBOK/Agile environment. Product and Engineering teams follow Agile methodologies, while the Project Manager provides traditional project governance and oversight.
•    Primary PM Tool: Clarity
•    Financial Management: Excel

job.title: Cosmetic Manufacturing Buyer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Cosmetic Manufacturing Buyer for our beauty and personal care manufacturing client. Candidates must have prior experience within the cosmetics or beauty industry to be considered for this opportunity. In this role, you will support day-to-day purchasing and procurement activities for raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other products essential to manufacturing operations.

Working closely with the Purchasing Director, suppliers, inventory team, and internal departments, the Cosmetic Manufacturing Buyer will assist with purchase order processing, supplier communications, inventory tracking, purchasing documentation, and procurement data management. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career purchasing professional with cosmetics industry experience looking to further develop their procurement and supply chain expertise within the beauty and personal care manufacturing industry.

Industry: Beauty / Personal Care Manufacturing
Location: Carson, CA

Job Functions
  • Assist with creating, processing, and tracking purchase orders for materials, supplies, packaging, and other products required for company operations.
  • Maintain accurate records of open purchase orders, supplier information, pricing, and purchasing activity.
  • Communicate with suppliers regarding order status, pricing, product availability, and expected delivery dates.
  • Follow up with suppliers regarding delayed, incomplete, damaged, or incorrect shipments and assist with resolving discrepancies.
  • Support inventory tracking activities and help identify potential material shortages or excess inventory.
  • Assist with maintaining appropriate inventory levels based on production and operational requirements.
  • Enter, maintain, and update purchasing and supplier information within company systems and spreadsheets.
  • Review purchase orders, invoices, receiving documentation, and related records for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare basic reports related to purchasing activity, inventory, supplier performance, and expenses.
  • Collect and organize purchasing and supplier data to support cost analysis and procurement decision-making.
  • Assist with identifying potential suppliers and obtaining pricing, availability, and product information.
  • Support supplier communication and maintain positive working relationships with vendors.
  • Maintain organized and accurate purchasing files, records, and supporting documentation.
  • Collaborate with Purchasing, Inventory, and other internal departments to support timely material availability.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the procurement team.
  • Perform additional purchasing and procurement responsibilities as assigned by the Purchasing Director.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field 
  • Entry level to two (2) years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory, operations, or administrative support.
  • Previous experience or demonstrated interest in the cosmetics, beauty, or personal care.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate purchasing and inventory records.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with suppliers and internal departments.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.
  • Dependable and responsible with a willingness to learn and develop within purchasing and procurement.
  • Ability to follow direction while also working independently when appropriate.
  • Strong interest in developing a career in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management.

job.title: Senior Thermal Systems Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Thermal Systems Engineer for our Research and Development Client in Marietta, Ohio. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team, and we're willing to relocate qualified candidates!

Job Functions:
  • Design and develop cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Develop specifications for system-level, subsystem and component performance.
  • Execute test plans to validate the performance of newly developed refrigeration systems by utilizing design for reliability tools and performance sensitivity analysis.
  • Design refrigeration systems that meet customer requirements, time to market commitments and that are within the target cost of the projects.
  • Analyze the thermal behavior of the refrigeration system with thermo-physical tools for component selection and overall refrigeration system design.
  • Ensure refrigeration designs are Designed for Compliance to meet regulatory and certification requirements (e.g., UL, IEC, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star).
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs.
  •  Thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing
  •  Analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration system testing methods and equipment

job.description:
Certified Medical Assistant needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Elgin, IL.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Certified Medical Assistant
  • Primary care experience preferred.
  • Bilingual candidates are a plus.
Hours: Shift: Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (1-hour lunch: 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM) Tuesday & Thursday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (1-hour lunch: 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM)
No weekends or on-call requirements.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Interviews patients, measures vital signs, such as pulse rate, temperature, blood pressure, weight, and height, and records information on patients' charts
  • Prepares treatment rooms and patients for examination
  • Cleans and sterilizes instruments
  • Inventories and orders medical supplies and materials
  • Operates electrocardiograph (EKG) and other equipment to administer routine diagnostic tests
  • Gives injections or treatments and performs routine laboratory tests
  • Schedules appointments and makes follow up phone calls to patients
  • Performs administrative tasks, completes appropriate client company and OSHA regulated forms, and provides assistance at front desk
  • Keys data into computer to maintain clinic and patient records
  • May require other duties as assigned
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • National certification in Medical Assisting OR Certificate/Diploma and Transcripts from an accredited Medical Assistant program with hands on externship completed and passed- total online courses are not acceptable.
  • CPR (BLS for the Healthcare Provider/Professional Rescuer - the copy must include the front and back of card as applicable) Certification must include “hands on” evaluation of skills by the trainer/instructor. Total on-line courses will not be accepted. Course must also meet the American Heart Association (AHA) standards but need not be an AHA certificate

job.title: Document Control Specialist – Engineering / Oil & Gas
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Document Control Specialist for a contract-to-hire opportunity in Houston, TX. This position supports engineering and capital projects within the energy industry, working closely with engineering, procurement, vendors, fabricators, and international clients.

The ideal candidate brings at least 3 years of hands-on document control experience in oil & gas, EPC, engineering, fabrication, or similar project-driven environments, with strong knowledge of SDRLs, MDRs, electronic document management systems (EDMS), technical documentation, revision control, and formal transmittals.

Position Details
  • Location: Houston, TX 77092
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
  • Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire
  • Pay Rate: $29–$35/hour, depending on experience

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and maintain controlled engineering and project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Prepare, maintain, and track Supplier Document Requirements Lists (SDRLs), Master Document Registers (MDRs), and other project documentation registers.
  • Administer electronic document management systems (EDMS), ensuring accurate document numbering, revision control, distribution, and retention.
  • Coordinate document submissions, review cycles, approvals, and formal transmittals between engineering teams, vendors, fabricators, and clients.
  • Track engineering drawings, specifications, vendor data, equipment documentation, certificates, and technical deliverables.
  • Support procurement and vendor documentation, including purchase orders, bid packages, inspection and testing documentation (FAT/ITP), and supplier deliverables.
  • Monitor outstanding documentation, overdue reviews, rejected submissions, and required revisions to maintain project schedules.
  • Ensure documentation complies with client-specific numbering, formatting, revision, and submission requirements.
  • Coordinate documentation requirements with domestic and international project stakeholders.
  • Prepare and reconcile final project documentation, including as-built drawings, O&M manuals, vendor data books, and client close-out packages.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support document retrieval for audits, client requests, and project reviews.

Required Qualifications
  • 3+ years of hands-on document control experience within oil & gas, engineering, EPC, energy, fabrication, manufacturing, or similar project-based environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineering drawings, technical documentation, vendor deliverables, and revision-controlled records.
  • Experience maintaining document registers, tracking submissions, coordinating approvals, and managing formal document workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with electronic document management systems such as Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint, Livelink, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong understanding of document numbering, revision control, transmittals, document distribution, and records management.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and document tracking systems.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage multiple project deadlines.
  • Effective communication skills for coordinating with engineering teams, vendors, and clients.

Preferred Qualifications
  • 5+ years of engineering or EPC document control experience.
  • Direct experience managing SDRLs, MDRs, vendor document registers, and client transmittals.
  • Experience supporting large-scale or international engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with procurement documentation, purchase orders, bid packages, FAT/ITP records, and project close-out packages.
  • Experience working within ISO 9001 quality management environments.
  • Associate degree, technical certification, or bachelor's degree in a related field.

Additional Information
This position initially focuses on dedicated document control support across multiple engineering projects. As the organization grows, there may be opportunities to expand into broader project coordination responsibilities.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law.

job.title: Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
We are seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to support materials intake, document printing, filing, and delivery activities. This role will organize incoming vehicle compliance materials, maintain accurate records, prepare documents for distribution, and coordinate deliveries to Waymo depots and offices, FedEx, and other locations as needed.
 
Scope:
• Receive, inspect, and organize incoming materials and documentation.
• Print, prepare, label, and file documents according to established procedures.
• Maintain accurate physical and digital filing systems.
• Track materials, documents, shipments, and delivery status.
• Update electronic trackers and share communications to reflect the latest materials status.
• Prepare packages and materials for depot delivery, including locations such as Waymo's depots.
• Coordinate FedEx shipments and other deliveries as required.
• Deliver or distribute materials to depots and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized work area and ensure materials are stored appropriately.
• Identify missing, damaged, or incorrect materials and escalate issues.
• Support general administrative and materials coordination tasks.
 
Required:
• Experience with materials intake, document control, filing, shipping, or logistics support.
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to accurately print, label, sort, and maintain records.
• Familiarity with FedEx or similar shipping platforms.
• Ability to follow procedures and manage multiple requests.
• Basic computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, printing, and document management.
• Reliable transportation or ability to support local deliveries, if required.
 
Pluses:
• Experience supporting depot, warehouse, laboratory, or operations environments.
• Familiarity with inventory or document-tracking systems.

job.title: Senior Buyer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Senior Buyer to join our client’s team in Rancho Cordova, CA. This is an excellent opportunity for a procurement professional to leverage their sourcing expertise, negotiation skills, and independent judgment in a role focused on driving purchasing efficiency and cost savings.

In this position, you will oversee moderately complex purchasing activities for supplies, equipment, and services, while building strong supplier relationships, negotiating favorable terms, and identifying opportunities to improve procurement processes. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy, represent Purchasing on cross-functional projects, and provide guidance and mentorship to junior buyers.


Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
Location: On-site in Rancho Cordova, CA
Pay: $51-58/hr
Type: 6 months with possibility of extension 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
  • Lead procurement operations and sourcing activities that improve efficiency and deliver cost savings.
  • Represent Purchasing on assigned cross-functional teams, including capital projects, Integrated Project Teams (IPTs), and software implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing purchasing policies and procedures, and recommend practical ways to increase efficiency.
  • Help develop procurement plans and recommend processes and methods for implementation.
  • Negotiate vendor contracts and service agreements to maximize cost savings, and identify new suppliers and sourcing opportunities.
  • Partner with management to review ongoing initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.
  • Mentor and train staff, sharing procurement knowledge and supporting junior buyers.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with AFC policies.
  • Lead business reviews with key suppliers as needed.
  • Support a safe, healthy, and environmentally responsible workplace by following all company SHE policies and procedures, participating in hazard identification and environmental risk reduction, and reporting incidents, nonconformities, and potential hazards to management.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  • 9-13 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree, 7-11 years of related experience with a master's degree, or equivalent experience.

SKILLS YOU WILL BRING
  • Strong negotiation skills for vendor contracts and services.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address purchasing challenges and identify process improvements.
  • Ability to mentor junior buyers and share practical procurement expertise.

Employment Type: 18-Month Contract with Potential for Direct Hire
Compensation: $24.00 - $30.00 per Hour

  • $1,000 upon successful completion of 100 days of employment
Rate Range is based on experience and expertise.
There are 3 levels: Entry Level - Intermediate (2 plus years) and Advanced (4 plus years and Semiconductor experience)

This role supports the testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and qualification of advanced semiconductor equipment in both research and production environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical troubleshooting skills, a commitment to safety, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting.

  • 2 to 4 years of relevant technical or engineering support experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety and operational excellence
  • Flexibility to support varying schedules or shifts as business needs require

job.title: Intermediate Assembly Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Entry Level is not eligible for Bonus

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22.50/Hr.
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28.00/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
Senior Network Engineer – Cloud & Infrastructure Overview Yoh is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support a mission-critical enterprise and development infrastructure environment. This role will design, deploy, maintain, and secure network systems across data centers, on-premises locations, remote offices, and public cloud environments.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with routing, switching, firewalls, hybrid cloud connectivity, network automation, and enterprise security infrastructure.

Location: San Mateo or surrounding San Francisco Bay Area
Job Type: Contract
Work Arrangement: Hybrid/onsite, as required
Estimated Compensation: $80–$95/hour, depending on experience

Responsibilities Network Engineering
  • Design, architect, deploy, and maintain routing, switching, WLAN, and firewall infrastructure across data centers, corporate offices, remote sites, and cloud environments.
  • Support public cloud networking in AWS and Azure, including secure connectivity solutions such as ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, and Azure Virtual WAN.
  • Deploy and manage WAN and VPN connectivity to ensure secure and reliable access for enterprise and mission-critical environments.
  • Develop and apply network automation to streamline provisioning, monitoring, configuration management, and operational processes.
  • Partner with cloud, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to develop standardized network architectures.
  • Recommend and implement scalable, automated approaches to network operations and vulnerability remediation.
  • Participate in Agile delivery cycles while managing assigned network projects and deliverables.
  • Conduct network capacity planning and provide recommendations for growth, resiliency, and optimization.
Operations and Support
  • Plan and execute network and firewall changes in accordance with change-management and security-governance procedures.
  • Monitor, analyze, and improve network performance, availability, resiliency, and security.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting for network hardware, software, connectivity, and application-related issues.
  • Configure and maintain secure connectivity services, including VPN, ZTNA, HTTPS, and SFTP.
  • Create and maintain accurate operational, configuration, and network documentation.
  • Mentor operational teams on network processes, procedures, and troubleshooting practices.
  • Engage vendors and strategic partners for escalated troubleshooting, lifecycle planning, and technology evaluations.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance activities.
Maintenance and Security
  • Lead or support network upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities within defined maintenance windows.
  • Maintain network device software, hardware, and license compliance.
  • Identify and remediate network security vulnerabilities in coordination with IT security teams.
  • Support network segmentation, access control, firewall policy enforcement, and secure connectivity initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • Six or more years of experience supporting and administering complex network systems in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in network routing, switching, and security architecture.
  • Experience with at least one network operating system, such as NX-OS, JunOS, or Arista EOS.
  • Experience with at least one network security operating system, such as PAN-OS or FortiOS.
  • Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Python.
  • Strong understanding of firewall management, network segmentation, VPN technologies, and secure remote access.
  • Experience building and managing scalable hybrid infrastructure connectivity between on-premises systems and cloud networks.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work independently and deliver results in a structured, process-driven environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, or six or more years of relevant experience combined with a professional certification such as CCNP, JNCIS, VCP-NV, or equivalent.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Juniper and Palo Alto networking solutions.
  • Familiarity with centralized firewall-management platforms, including Panorama.
  • Experience with WLAN technologies and wireless authentication, including 802.1X and RADIUS.
  • Experience with network-access control solutions and network-access policy enforcement.
  • Experience with ZTNA or SASE solutions, such as Prisma Access, Zscaler, or Cato.
  • Working knowledge of virtualization or operating-system administration, including VMware, Windows, or Linux.
  • Demonstrated project-management and technical leadership experience.
  • Ability to coach peers and present technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative, solution-oriented approach in a fast-paced, change-controlled environment.
Additional Requirements
  • Must be able to work in the San Francisco Bay Area and report onsite as required.
  • Must be comfortable participating in scheduled maintenance activities and an on-call rotation.
  • Must comply with all applicable workplace, security, confidentiality, and access requirements.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check conducted after a conditional offer, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law.

job.title: Technical Program Manager - HW
job.description:
Technical Program Manager - HW
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) with experience managing hardware module programs from prototype through DVT/PVT, including supplier and contract manufacturer management.

Scope:
• Own end-to-end hardware module schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
• Coordinate suppliers and contract manufacturers across timelines, logistics, quality, cost, and delivery.
• Organize design validation across internal teams and suppliers, including HW DVP dashboards.
• Facilitate requirements, verification, and software alignment for key perception milestones requiring vehicle-level testing.
• Manage component change control, including CCB activities.
• Track prototype, engineering vehicle testing, and production configurations throughout the development lifecycle.
• Document issues, track them to closure, and maintain clear technical reports and Buganizer/Jira tickets.
• Support trade studies, identify subsystem gaps, and ensure requirements are covered by testing.
• Coordinate purchasing, purchase orders, BOMs, and hardware readiness.
• Monitor supplier performance and maintain supplier scorecards.
• Collaborate with engineering, supply chain, and cross-functional teams to track schedules and resolve blockers.
• Use tools such as Jira, spreadsheets, and bug-tracking systems to manage workflows and action items.

Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience in engineering program management.
• Experience managing hardware modules from prototype through PVT.
• Strong understanding of product development processes and complex schedule management.
• Experience managing suppliers and contract manufacturers.
• Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Experience with Jira, spreadsheets, Buganizer, or similar project-tracking tools.
• Exposure to supplier evaluation, OEM selection, and contract manufacturing models.

Pluses:
• Experience with automotive Tier 1 suppliers, OEMs, or component evaluation facilities.
• Understanding of automotive manufacturing processes, including Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly.
• Experience with hardware validation, dashboarding, requirements, and verification.
• Experience with configuration and change management throughout the vehicle development lifecycle.
• Experience supporting trade studies, subsystem integration, and vehicle-level testing.
• Experience with purchasing, PO tracking, BOM coordination, and hardware readiness.
• Experience monitoring supplier performance across quality, cost, and delivery metrics.

job.title: Intermediate Assembly Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Entry Level is not eligible for Bonus

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22.50/Hr.
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28.00/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Site Administrator - Barker
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Barker, NY (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: Intermediate Semiconductor Technical Product Support Engineer
job.description:
Intermediate Semiconductor Technical Product Support Engineer needed for a 12-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Pay Rate: $40- $45 per hour


Shift available-8 hour day shift Monday-Friday 8Am-5PM




The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
 
  • Support reliability tests such as marathon/cycle runs, burn-in, and qualification activities, including setup, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Track and log failures, alarms, and abnormal events, and help maintain failure records in the issue tracking system.
  • Assist with root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, fishbone) by gathering evidence, logs, photos, and part history.Help prepare and update Q&R documentation, including test plans, test reports, checklists, and corrective action records.
  • Support installation, setup, and teaching robots, EFEMs, load ports, and aligners according to procedures.
  • Run automation verification tests such as wafer transfer cycles, positional repeatability, and handoff checks, and record the results.
  • Help troubleshoot automation issues by collecting alarm codes, communication logs, and sensor data, and coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Help write and maintain automation procedures, teaching records, parameter backups, and changing logs
  • Follow all safety, ESD, and cleanroom protocols during equipment work.



What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • Exp : 3- 5 Years
  • Education: Bachelor's Degree


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
Preferred :
  • Experience with semiconductor equipment
  • Familiarity with SEMI standards (e.g., E84, E87, E10) and SECS/GEM communication.
  • Scripting or automation skills for data handling (VBA, or Power BI).
  • Exposure to quality tools such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, and Pareto analysis.
  • Prior cleanroom experience in a semiconductor fab or equipment environment.
  • Experience working directly with equipment suppliers or field service teams Functional knowledge: Demonstrate depth of expertise in mechanical and electrical, and system discipline.
  • Possess general knowledge of hardware and software to perform hands on activities on equipment.
  • Problem Solving: Solve complex problems; exercise judgment based on assessment of technical analysis, risk, business impact.Interpersonal skill: Communicates difficult technical and non-technical concept with internal and external parties. Japanese or Vietnamese proficiency is helpful

job.title: Site Administrator
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Lubbock, TX (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance
job.description:
Director, Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance

Location: Sunnyvale, CA (Onsite)
Employment Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Compensation: $200,000–$275,000 annually

Yoh is seeking an experienced Director of Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance to join an innovative molecular diagnostics company developing a novel blood-based cancer screening technology.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership opportunity to drive FDA regulatory strategy, oversee premarket submissions, and build and maintain a scalable Quality Management System (QMS) as the organization advances toward FDA marketing authorization and commercialization.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated FDA submission leadership, strong quality systems expertise, and the ability to operate both strategically and tactically within a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Be Doing

Regulatory Affairs
  • Develop and execute U.S. regulatory strategies for molecular diagnostic products, including FDA premarket submissions, PMAs, supplements, and Q-Submissions.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact with the FDA and other regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory activities supporting clinical studies, including IDE requirements, IRB compliance, and informed consent.
  • Author and review regulatory submission documentation, including analytical and clinical validation summaries, labeling, risk assessments, and software-related documentation.
  • Monitor evolving IVD regulatory requirements and provide strategic guidance to leadership.

Quality Assurance & Compliance
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve a QMS compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971.
  • Oversee design controls, document control, change management, supplier qualification, internal audits, and management reviews.
  • Lead CAPA, nonconformance, complaint-handling, and quality improvement activities.
  • Prepare for and lead FDA inspections, including management of Form 483 responses and corrective actions.
  • Establish and oversee applicable post-market surveillance and reporting processes.

Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Lead and develop the Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance functions, including future team expansion.
  • Partner with scientific, clinical, and executive leadership to support product development and regulatory milestones.
  • Establish quality and regulatory priorities, processes, and performance metrics.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, quality, and regulatory compliance throughout the organization.
  • Communicate regulatory strategies, risks, and progress to senior leadership.

What You Need to Bring to the Table

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive Regulatory Affairs and/or Quality Assurance experience within the IVD or medical device industry.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on leadership of at least one successful FDA premarket submission (PMA, De Novo, or 510(k)); PMA experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience building, implementing, or remediating quality management systems compliant with 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971.
  • Direct experience hosting FDA inspections and managing Form 483 responses.
  • Working knowledge of FDA regulations, including 21 CFR Parts 803, 806, 809, and 812.
  • Strong understanding of design controls and regulatory compliance for IVDs or medical devices.
  • Excellent communication skills, including direct interactions with FDA reviewers and executive leadership.
  • Ability to work onsite in Sunnyvale, CA.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, PharmD) in a relevant discipline.
  • Regulatory or quality leadership experience in molecular diagnostics, oncology, liquid biopsy, NGS, or cancer screening.
  • Experience with FDA Breakthrough Devices Program and Q-Submissions.
  • Familiarity with software/algorithm validation and medical device cybersecurity requirements.
  • RAC, ASQ CQA, or CMQ/OE certification.
  • Experience in an early-stage, venture-backed, or rapidly growing life sciences organization.

What's In It for You?
  • Opportunity to lead regulatory and quality strategy for an innovative cancer-screening technology.
  • Direct impact on critical FDA milestones and future commercialization.
  • High-visibility leadership role working closely with scientific and executive teams.
  • Opportunity to build and shape the RA/QA function as the organization grows.
  • Entrepreneurial environment with meaningful ownership and long-term growth potential.

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range is $200,000–$275,000 annually, depending on qualifications, experience, and relevant expertise.

Additional compensation and benefits may be available and will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Apply Now

If you have successfully led FDA premarket submissions, built or improved regulated quality systems, and are interested in a hands-on leadership opportunity within molecular diagnostics, we encourage you to apply.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable law.

job.title: Prototype Development Engineer-Labcar Development, Configuration, Commissioning, Test Readines
job.description:
Prototype Development Engineer - Labcar Development, Configuration, Commissioning, and Test Readiness
 
As a Prototype Development Engineer, you will support the development, configuration, commissioning, maintenance, and test readiness of advanced Labcars, HIL benches, and related prototype electrical test assets. You will combine hands-on hardware and software integration with disciplined configuration management, physical-to-BOM correlation, technical troubleshooting, and cross-functional build coordination to keep each asset aligned with the intended engineering configuration and ready for scheduled testing.

What You’ll Do
• Asset Bring-Up and Commissioning: Support the development, initial bring-up, commissioning, and re-commissioning of Labcars and other prototype electrical test assets following major hardware or software changes.
• Technical Execution:Oversee component installation, complex wiring, harness and module replacement, instrumentation setup, module software flashing, and network debugging across CAN, CAN FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet.
• Labcar Configuration Management: Maintain an accurate understanding of each assigned asset’s hardware architecture, electrical content, software configuration, build phase, current state, known limitations, and integration maturity.
• BOM and Physical-Asset Correlation: Compare engineering BOMs, Labcar-specific BOMs, configuration records, drawings, and the hardware physically installed on each asset. Distinguish among planned, documented, and physically verified configurations.
• Build-Phase Change Analysis: Identify newly introduced, revised, superseded, removed, or configuration-specific parts and requirements between engineering releases and build phases; determine the effect on assigned assets and define the required update work.
• System Diagnostics and Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and triage electrical, network, hardware, software-configuration, and integration issues. Collect diagnostic evidence, isolate affected systems, resolve technical roadblocks, and coordinate specialized engineering support when required.
• Testing and Regression Validation: Develop or execute formal commissioning, smoke-test, regression, and readiness procedures with clear go/no-go criteria to confirm system stability across hardware and software iterations.
• Scheduling and Test Readiness: Coordinate installation, flashing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and validation activities around shared-asset schedules. Confirm required hardware, software, prerequisite work, and known issues before releasing an asset for testing.
• Documentation and Status: Maintain traceable records of installed hardware, BOM revisions, software and flash status, configuration changes, diagnostic findings, open discrepancies, completed work, validation results, and current test-readiness status.
• Continuous Improvement and Automation: Improve repeatability through standardized checklists, configuration controls, data validation, scripting, and automation of reconciliation or readiness reporting where practical.

Minimum Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Computer, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in hardware-software integration, prototype vehicles, Labcars, HIL benches, board or system bring-up, manufacturing test, or comparable vehicle-systems engineering environments.
• Electrical Documentation: Proficiency reading electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector views, network topologies, harness documentation, PCB assemblies, and mechanical layouts.
• Vehicle Networks: 3+ years of experience with vehicle communication protocols, including CAN, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet, and familiarity with CAN FD.
• Diagnostic Tooling: 3+ years of experience using CANalyzer, CANoe, Wireshark, Vehicle Spy/VSPY3, Intrepid, Vector, or similar embedded networking and diagnostic tools.
• Flashing and Diagnostics: Experience supporting module programming, diagnostic activities, communication checks, controlled power-up, and post-flash verification.
• Test Methods: Experience writing and executing formal test plans, commissioning procedures, regression checks, or readiness checklists with clear go/no-go criteria.
• Embedded Systems: Strong understanding of embedded control modules, power distribution, grounding, I/O, network communication, and subsystem dependencies.
• Coordination and Documentation: Ability to manage competing shared-asset requirements, direct or coordinate technical work, track parts and open issues, maintain change history, and communicate readiness risks clearly.
• Physical Requirements: Ability to work hands-on around prototype vehicles and test assets, inspect components in confined locations, and safely handle typical vehicle electrical hardware.

Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced Vehicle Architecture: Knowledge of modern electrical/electronic vehicle architectures, distributed control systems, zonal architectures, power distribution, and networked embedded systems.
• Prototype Asset Ownership: Experience owning or coordinating the configuration, availability, and technical readiness of Labcars, HIL benches, prototype vehicles, mule vehicles, breadboards, or similar assets.
• Change and Pedigree Awareness: Familiarity with engineering release data, build pedigrees, part revision levels, supersession, applicability, and change-control processes.
• Test Equipment: Experience with power supplies, electronic loads, DAQ systems, oscilloscopes, meters, signal conditioning, instrumentation, and safety interlocks.
• Data and Tracking Tools: Experience using Excel, Jira, SharePoint, or comparable systems to maintain structured asset, BOM, issue, parts, or readiness data.
• Automation: Experience with Python, Power Automate, scripting, APIs, or other automation tools used for configuration reconciliation, data validation, diagnostics, or reporting.
• Technical Leadership: Experience directing technicians, coordinating multi-discipline build work, leading design or readiness reviews, and communicating technical status to stakeholders.
• Working Style: A systems-thinking mindset, attention to physical and documentation details, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to operate effectively as priorities and configurations change.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22.00/Hr. (Entry Level does not have a Sign-On Bonus)
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: HW Test Engineer
job.description:
HW Test Engineer
We are seeking a hands-on Hardware Test Engineer to support hardware testing, bring-up, debugging, failure analysis, and lab operations across multiple hardware domains.

Scope:
• Read and execute test plans covering SI/PI, RF, antenna, thermal, reliability, and compliance. Test plan creation is a plus.
• Support hardware bring-up and debugging using lab equipment and common hardware protocols.
• Conduct failure analysis across the product lifecycle, including design validation, manufacturing, reliability, and field stages.
• Manage lab operations, including hardware allocation, tracking, configuration, setup, and rework.
• Perform hardware assembly, test infrastructure setup, electrical and functional testing, and root-cause analysis.
• Analyze test results and create summaries, visualizations, conclusions, and reports.
• Develop and maintain hardware test scripts and automation tools, as applicable.

Required:
• Understanding of electrical, functional, logical, software, mechanical, and thermal aspects of computer systems.
• Hands-on hardware testing, lab setup, evaluation, and root-cause analysis experience.
• Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DC power supplies, and similar test equipment.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Familiarity with Linux.
• Ability to make minor test script modifications.
• Experience creating test plans or developing hardware test automation.
