job.title: Multi-Family Affordable Housing Program (AHP) Analyst
job.description:
Multi-Family Affordable Housing Program (AHP) Analyst
12+ month contract
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Must have experience with:
  • 15-year proformas
  • Multi-Family Rental; monitoring of multi-family real estate properties
  • Experience reviewing rent rolls including tenant files
  • Affordable Housing or LIHTC Compliance
  • Affordable Housing Ownership Experience
  • Funding requests—experience processing funding requests on a construction draw
  • Federal and state affordable housing programs

PURPOSE
Responsibilities include the evaluation, underwriting, selection and compliance of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) applications; technical assistance to member institutions and community organizations concerning the Affordable Housing Program as well as the Community Investment Program; review, analyze and process requests for grant funds from member institutions and community organizations and assist in preparation of departmental marketing materials. Ensure compliance of AHP projects to the program rules and regulations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Analyze AHP Rental and Owner-Occupied disbursement requests to ensure all required documentation is in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies and procedures. Make approval/denial recommendations for funding to AHP General Fund Manager.
  • Participates in the analysis, review, and selection of Affordable General Fund Housing program applications. 
  • Provide technical assistance to member institutions, non-profit organizations and community/government leaders on the features and uses of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Interacts with other analysts on complex issues regarding applications, modifications, fundings and monitoring.
  • Analyze complex multi-family rental project disbursements to ensure project is viable for funding, as assigned. 
  • Review and approve HELP, SNAP and AHP owner-occupied disbursements request when designated.
  • Perform the compliance review of AHP rental projects to ensure that AHP compliance requirements are being met. (Income targeting and rent compliance)
  • Provide the management team with updates and status reports on project completion/modification, as assigned. Make recommendations concerning the continued viability of said projects.
  • Analyze and review project status reports and other information to ensure that projects are in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies. 
  • Up to 10% travel required to participate in various speaking engagements and promotional appearances (local, state-wide, regional, or national).
  • Develop a working knowledge of the Bank's other products and services, especially those offered by the Community Investment Department.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of local, state, and national programs that are involved in financing affordable housing development; provide assistance and update policies and procedures to ensure effective administration of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Perform user acceptance and validation testing and maintenance of internal systems and applications.  Ensure implementation is in compliance with department internal controls, policies and procedures, FHFA regulations and Bank policy.
  • Participate in the planning and organizing of the AHP workshops and webinars.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc activities in support of the operational needs of the department. 
 
REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Public Policy, Urban Planning. A master’s in public administration preferred.
  • 4-6 years financial analysis and credit underwriting experience associated with commercial real estate/multi-family properties, housing development, commercial finance or other demonstrated affordable housing experience. 
  • Completion of major corporate bank credit training or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Acrobat and Word.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel and/or make presentations at Bank and industry functions, workshop, conferences, etc.
  • Grow America (fka the National Development Council) or other comparable professional housing certification preferred.

job.title: Test Engineer – Charging
job.description:
Test Engineer – Charging
Location: Charging test site(s), with occasional travel to new sites
We are seeking Test Engineers to execute DC fast charging (DCFC) acceptance testing, support charging-site bring-up, automate repeatable test cases, and validate charging equipment across multiple vendors.

Important: Candidates should have prior experience working with Tesla, Rivian, Lucid, ChargePoint, Electrify America, or another EV charging company.

Scope:
• Execute prioritized test cases covering functionality, power delivery and sharing, interoperability, thermal performance, efficiency, fault response, OCPP back-end functionality, and reliability.
• Coordinate vehicle availability with Operations and execute testing using fleet vehicles or EV/battery emulators.
• Collect data from power analyzers, thermal cameras, thermocouples, chargers, vehicles, and OCPP logs; document pass/fail results with supporting evidence.
• Log defects with reproduction steps and supporting data, follow vendor root-cause analysis and fixes, and perform regression testing.
• Track uptime, connectivity, and session-success KPIs against established targets.
• Develop vendor-agnostic, version-controlled scripts for OCPP sessions, power-sharing runs, endurance cycles, KPI calculations, and other repeatable test cases.
• Build data-processing tools that combine instrument and log data and calculate results against pass/fail limits.
• Support new test-site bring-up, including instrumentation installation and calibration, network and data-logging setup, and vendor commissioning.
• Maintain reusable bring-up checklists and test-setup diagrams.
• Follow high-voltage safety procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and site rules; stop testing when conditions are unsafe.
Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• 3+ years of hardware test or validation experience with power electronics, EV charging, or energy systems.
• Safe hands-on experience with high-voltage DC and 480 VAC three-phase equipment.
• Experience using power analyzers, oscilloscopes, current and voltage probes, thermal cameras, and DAQ systems.
• Proficiency with Python or similar scripting languages for test automation and data analysis.
• Experience with Git.
Pluses:
• Experience with CCS, NACS/SAE J3400, ISO 15118, DIN 70121, OCPP, UL 2202, or IEC 61851.
• Experience with EV/battery emulators or CharIN conformance testing.

Estimated Min Rate: $40.00
Estimated Max Rate: $50.00/hr+. Depends on work experience

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer (2:30PM-10:30PM)
job.description:
Supplier Quality Engineer

Scope:
• Develop and execute the vehicle Control Plan for incoming, in-process, and outgoing quality controls, to assure the finished vehicle meets all technical specifications.
• Provide on-site support to the manufacturing operation to manage sub-assembly, vehicle integration, and vehicle system bring-up, including troubleshooting of vehicle systems, end-of-line testing, sensor calibration, and drive testing.
• Work with the manufacturing team on site at their factory, providing oversight of execution of agreed processes, assuring that manufacturing and inspection processes are performed correctly using the proper tools, materials, and methods.
• Meticulously document problems and work cross-functionally to contain, root cause, and implement corrective actions. Assessment and approval of proper vehicle repairs and reworks to meet technical requirements.
• Verify each vehicle’s compliance to specification and sign-off completed vehicles prior to shipment from the manufacturing facility.
• Investigate, correct, and monitor ongoing improvement of product quality issues experienced by customers. Must enable collaborative, timely, data-driven decision making to tackle product quality related issues.

Required:
• 5+ years’ experience in a Manufacturing/Engineering/Operations Quality role in the automotive/transportation OEM or Tier supplier manufacturing arena.
• Bachelor's Engineering degree or equivalent work experience; hands-on experience in automotive manufacturing can compensate for not having an engineering degree.
• Ability to work independently, identifying and addressing problems with appropriate priority.
• Experience with a variety of light assembly and manufacturing processes.
• Understands typical automotive manufacturing, manual assembly, test, and inspection methodologies.
• Strong skills leading the 7D problem solving processes : problem definition, containment, occurrence/escape root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action planning and execution.
• Demonstrates excellent problem solving & communication skills while working alone and in large teams; interfacing with assembly operators, inspectors, production supervisors, engineers, and technical managers.

Pluses:
• Experience with interpretation of design drawings/GD&T, schematics, and cosmetic standards for creation and execution of inspection criteria.
• Demonstrated hands-on mechanical, manufacturing process and vehicle electrical troubleshooting experience.
• Strong experience with manufacturing supply chain techniques and processes such as supplier audits, new product introductions, product life cycles, manufacturing engineering, first article inspection, technical documentation, etc.
• Excellent understanding of factory-related and customer-related product quality/reliability metrics.
• Experienced in collaborating and working cross-functionally with Operations, Manufacturing, Design Engineering, and Supply Chain/Purchasing teams.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22.00/Hr. (Entry Level does not have a Sign-On Bonus)
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Site Administrator - Snyder
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Snyder, TX (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.

job.title: Vehicle Line Owner
job.description:
Vehicle Systems Fleet Engineer
We are seeking a technical engineer to support the health, reliability, and performance of vehicles operating in a production fleet. This role combines fleet data analysis, failure triage, root cause investigation, supplier coordination, and deployment of hardware and software mitigations.

Scope:
• Develop and maintain tools and dashboards that provide visibility into overall fleet health and the performance of critical systems, including propulsion, braking, steering, and low-voltage systems.
• Analyze fleet and log data to identify failure trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve vehicle reliability.
• Support and drive technical triage of failures reported across the production fleet.
• Lead root cause investigations to determine failure mechanisms and appropriate corrective actions.
• Partner with vehicle and component suppliers to investigate issues and develop potential improvements.
• Support Hardware Systems teams with the development and deployment of fleet fixes and mitigations.
• Track deployed solutions to verify effectiveness and identify when additional improvements are required.

Required:
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Technology, or another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience analyzing and visualizing data, including creating plots or dashboards from log data using Python (pandas/matplotlib), Tableau, Jira dashboards, or similar tools.
• Strong troubleshooting skills with hands-on experience in failure triage and root cause investigation.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document technical findings in Jira tickets, reports, and other engineering documentation.

Pluses:
• Experience with vehicle ECUs, including braking, steering, thermal, low-voltage, battery, gateway, or similar systems.
• Hands-on experience with complex electrical or electromechanical systems.
• Experience developing custom fleet-health tooling or dashboards using Python, SQL, or similar technologies.
• Familiarity with deploying hardware or software fixes into production environments.

Estimated Max Rate: $60.00/hr. Depends on work experience

job.title: Senior Manufacturing Technician – Cyclotron Operations
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Senior Manufacturing Technician – Cyclotron Operations for our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded individual with a background in physics, engineering, electronics, military technical operations, or complex manufacturing equipment who enjoys analytical problem-solving and working with sophisticated technology.

Prior cyclotron or radiopharmaceutical experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong technical aptitude, equipment operations experience, and demonstrated troubleshooting abilities are encouraged to apply.

Location: Noblesville, IN (Onsite)
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Salary: Up to $54,080 annually + applicable shift differential
Schedule: Overnight, 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM | Alternating 4-on/3-off and 3-on/4-off rotation, including weekends

Position Overview
The Senior Manufacturing Technician will be responsible for operating and monitoring a cyclotron used in the production of medical radioisotopes. This position requires the ability to interpret multiple operating parameters, identify equipment performance issues, and make sound technical decisions in a dynamic, time-sensitive environment.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and capable of troubleshooting complex technical systems where established procedures may not address every situation.

You will join an experienced, collaborative team that provides structured technical training and opportunities for professional development.

Key Responsibilities
  • Operate and monitor cyclotron equipment to support safe, reliable radioisotope production.
  • Analyze real-time equipment readings, operating parameters, and system performance to maintain optimal beam conditions.
  • Identify abnormal operating conditions, troubleshoot equipment issues, and make appropriate technical adjustments.
  • Exercise sound judgment when responding to equipment performance changes in time-sensitive situations.
  • Perform routine equipment startup, shutdown, inspections, and preventive maintenance.
  • Collaborate with cyclotron engineers and technical specialists to diagnose equipment issues and coordinate repairs.
  • Support maintenance activities involving electrical, mechanical, vacuum, and other cyclotron-related systems.
  • Monitor and document production data, radiation levels, equipment performance, and operational activities.
  • Follow applicable radiation safety procedures, cGMP requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate operational logs, safety records, and required documentation.
  • Collaborate with experienced operators and engineers to support continuous improvement and equipment reliability.
  • Assist with technical training and knowledge sharing as appropriate.

Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant technical experience in equipment operations, manufacturing systems, electronics, engineering support, industrial operations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor, interpret, and troubleshoot complex equipment or technical systems.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate multiple operating variables and make informed decisions.
  • Experience identifying equipment abnormalities, diagnosing problems, or making operational adjustments.
  • Mechanical and/or electrical aptitude with an understanding of technical equipment and operating systems.
  • Ability to work effectively in dynamic environments where troubleshooting may require independent judgment beyond established procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and commitment to safety.
  • Ability to work a rotating overnight schedule, including weekends and overtime as needed.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate or bachelor's degree in Physics, Engineering, Electronics, Nuclear Engineering, Nuclear Medicine Technology, Mathematics, or a related technical/STEM discipline.
  • Previous experience operating cyclotrons, particle accelerators, nuclear systems, or other sophisticated technical equipment.
  • Military technical experience, particularly in nuclear operations, electronics, instrumentation, or complex equipment operations.
  • Experience operating industrial control systems, power generation equipment, semiconductor equipment, or automated manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with electrical troubleshooting, instrumentation, PLCs, RF systems, high-voltage equipment, or vacuum systems.
  • Experience working in regulated manufacturing environments, including pharmaceutical or cGMP operations.
  • Knowledge of radiation safety principles or radiopharmaceutical manufacturing.

Training and Career Development
This position offers structured onboarding and hands-on training alongside experienced cyclotron operators and engineers.

Initial training will primarily take place on day shift before transitioning to the assigned overnight schedule.

The organization offers potential career development opportunities within cyclotron operations, technical leadership, and engineering, depending on individual performance, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation and Schedule
  • Annual Base Salary: $54,080
  • Additional Compensation: Applicable overnight shift differential
  • Employment Type: Direct Hire
  • Work Location: Noblesville, Indiana (100% onsite)
  • Schedule: 12-hour overnight shifts, 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM, alternating 4-on/3-off and 3-on/4-off rotation
Qualified candidates from scientific, industrial, military, and technical equipment operations backgrounds are encouraged to apply, even without prior cyclotron experience.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Administrative Support - Remote
job.description:
Cyber Services Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote (U.S.)
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Pay Rate: $25-$30/hour W2


Our client is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Cyber Services Operations Coordinator to support a global Cyber Services organization. This role combines executive-level administrative support, operations coordination, client onboarding, reporting, and stakeholder communication. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and exceptional client service.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with experience in executive support, operations coordination, customer-facing administration, or client onboarding who thrive in a fast-paced, global environment.
Responsibilities
  • Provide administrative and operational support to Cyber Services leadership and global team members.
  • Coordinate key initiatives and operational activities while tracking milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
  • Manage and monitor a shared customer-facing mailbox, including triaging, routing, escalating, and responding to inquiries.
  • Coordinate client onboarding activities and appointment scheduling through Microsoft Bookings.
  • Validate client eligibility and ensure requests are directed to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate customer, service, and activity records within Salesforce, SharePoint, Microsoft Bookings, and other approved systems.
  • Support Threat Intelligence Webinars and related customer communications, registrations, mailing lists, and follow-up activities.
  • Administer Cyber Services resources including shared documentation, templates, and operational materials.
  • Prepare operational reports related to onboarding activities, service requests, mailbox metrics, response times, and open action items.
  • Maintain process documentation, response templates, and operational procedures.
  • Coordinate meetings, communications, and administrative activities across multiple global time zones.
  • Track action items and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks and deliverables.
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar support role.
  • Experience working with Salesforce for data entry, reporting, or administration.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft Bookings.
  • Experience managing shared mailboxes or customer support inboxes.
  • Experience coordinating client onboarding, scheduling, service requests, or customer-facing operations.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting a global team.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience within the insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting external client onboarding programs.
  • Experience coordinating webinars, virtual events, customer programs, or training sessions.
  • Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones.

job.title: Family Nurse Practitioner
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s Primary Care located in Windsor, WI. This clinic provides care to patients ages 2+. Clinical knowledge and experience in primary care, acute care, and occupational health are expected with an ability to provide comprehensive, patient-centered care across a variety of healthcare needs. Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills as well as exceptional customer service is a top priority, with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, respectful, and positive patient experience.
 
Schedule: Mon, Tues 6:30a-4:30p, Wed, Thurs 11a-7p, Fri 8a-12p
Duration: 1/4/27-5/5/27 with training in mid December (PTO coverage)
Pay: $55-70/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Educates and coaches nursing staff on best nursing practices.
  • May require other duties as assigned.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • All nurse practitioner licenses/certificates to practice
  • Current national certification (ANCC or AANP required)
  • Master Degree in Science of Nursing (if Master Degree in Science certificate does not state Nursing on it then a copy of transcripts is required)
  • BLS certification
  • Some experience in urgent care, primary care, emergency, occupational health or related is required
What’s In It For You?

  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll
 
APPLY NOW!

job.title: Program Manager - SAFe Agile - NY, Sun Prairie, WI, or Chicago, IL. Remote
job.description:
Senior Program Manager (SAFe Agile) Pay Rate: $65-$75/hour W2
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Location: New York, NY | Chicago, IL | Sun Prairie, WI
Work Arrangement: Hybrid preferred (8-10 days per month onsite in one of the listed office locations). Remote may be considered for exceptional candidates.

Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager with strong SAFe Agile expertise to lead complex, enterprise-wide programs and projects. This role will be responsible for managing the successful delivery of business and technology initiatives, driving stakeholder engagement, overseeing project financials, and ensuring program objectives are achieved on time and within budget.
The ideal candidate will have a proven background delivering large-scale, multi-year programs, strong leadership capabilities, PMP certification, and experience partnering with business, IT, and third-party teams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead complex programs and projects to achieve strategic business objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and manage high-performing teams consisting of business, technology, and third-party stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for executive sponsors and business leaders regarding project status, budget, risks, and deliverables.
  • Apply SAFe Agile and project management best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage program and project interdependencies to ensure alignment with overall business goals.
  • Drive business engagement and stakeholder communication across all phases of delivery.
  • Oversee project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and financial management.
  • Develop and monitor project budgets, forecasts, business cases, cost estimates, and benefit realization plans.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and roadblocks.
  • Maintain detailed project documentation, status reporting, decision logs, and governance materials.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party vendors to manage schedules, dependencies, and resource demand.
  • Ensure adherence to established project management frameworks, methodologies, and approval processes.
  • Mentor project team members and promote continuous improvement across delivery teams.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 7+ years of program and project management experience.
  • Proven experience delivering and managing complex, multi-year enterprise programs.
  • Strong experience working within SAFe Agile environments.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required.
  • Experience managing project budgets, forecasts, resources, and financial performance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams across business and technology organizations.
Preferred Knowledge & Experience
  • Expert knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Understanding of technology-focused business transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of IT environments, systems, and delivery strategies.
  • Working knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Experience within the insurance industry is highly preferred.
  • Experience managing external vendors and consulting partners.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer (mixed/analog)
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer (Mixed/Analog) — On-Site (Wichita, KS) Build electronics that fly. In this role, you’ll help design avionics, power electronics, and battery system interfaces used in high-performance, safety-critical aircraft applications—working across the full product lifecycle from concept and requirements through testing and certification.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement analog front-end circuits (amplifiers, ADC/DAC interfaces, filters) for accurate signal processing.
  • Lead mixed-signal system integration, verifying reliable data conversion, filtering, and conditioning stages.
  • Research and evaluate components, technologies, and methods for new and existing designs.
  • Build, test, and troubleshoot hardware in both office and lab environments (including soldering and hands-on bench work).
  • Validate performance against stringent requirements using lab tools (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers).
  • Create high-quality engineering documentation (BOMs, ECOs, test protocols, work instructions, and component rationales).
  • Support manufacturing needs by designing/integrating tools for new products as required.
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 5+ years of analog and mixed-signal design experience (precision instrumentation, signal conditioning, integrated circuit applications).
  • Proficiency with schematic capture/design & simulation tools (PADS, LTSpice, or similar) and PCB layout software.
  • Knowledge of signal integrity, impedance matching, and EMI/EMC design practices (e.g., RTCA DO-160 or MIL-STD-810/461).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Bring your analog/mixed-signal expertise and help deliver hardware that performs when it matters most—apply today.

job.title: B2B Sales/Account Manager - Los Angeles
job.description:
B2B Sales/Account Manager - Los Angeles
Direct Hire
Los Angeles, CA
Base+Bonus+Full Benefits

A person in this role is responsible for driving new customer acquisition and incremental profitable growth within an assigned geographic market, with particular emphasis on high-density metropolitan markets and areas with significant untapped commercial opportunities.

The Market Business Development Manager is a hunter-focused outside sales position primarily accountable for identifying, prospecting, developing, and closing new B2B customers. This person builds a qualified pipeline through a combination of company-provided leads, self-generated prospecting, referrals, market intelligence, field activity, and collaboration with Territory Sales Managers (TSMs), branch teams, and Regional Sales leadership.
The Business Development Manager owns new opportunities from initial prospect identification through qualification, solution development, pricing, close, customer setup, initial activation, and successful transition to the assigned Territory Sales Manager for ongoing account management.

Experience:
  • 5+ years of progressive B2B outside sales, business development, territory development, or new-account acquisition experience preferred.
  • Experience within automotive aftermarket, heavy duty, commercial fleet, industrial, battery, parts distribution, or related B2B channels.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting and acquiring new commercial customers in a competitive B2B environment.
  • Proven ability to develop business through self-generated leads in addition to company-provided opportunities.
  • Experience managing a sales process from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, close, and customer activation.
  • Experience selling products or services where pricing, margin, inventory availability, logistics, and service capabilities influence the customer buying decision.
  • Experience working collaboratively with territory sales, branch operations, customer service, pricing, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage prospecting activity, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, and customer information.

job.description:
Talent Acquisition Associate ( Recruiting Coordinator) 

Duration: 6 months contract with potential extension
Pay rate: $20-$24 hourly
Hybrid in New York, NY 3x a week onsite ( TBD onsite days) 

About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support a fast-paced recruiting team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating a positive candidate experience, managing multiple priorities, and partnering closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR teams throughout the hiring process.

What You'll Do
• Coordinate virtual and on-site candidate interviews, managing schedules, logistics, communications, and day-of support.
• Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates, ensuring a positive, professional, and high-touch experience.
• Review offer letters and support pre-employment activities, including background checks and hiring documentation.
• Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, HR, and other stakeholders to support onboarding and new-hire readiness.
• Assist with internship and campus recruiting initiatives, including event planning, logistics, candidate communications, and high-volume hiring activities.
• Maintain accurate recruiting data, documentation, and process tracking within recruiting systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and elevate the overall Talent Acquisition experience.

• A self-starter who is proactive, accountable, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.
• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• A collaborative team player who comes prepared, asks thoughtful questions, and follows through on commitments.
• Commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.
• Experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition, HR, onboarding, or a related administrative support role preferred.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and recruiting or HR systems.

job.title: Fiber Field Technician
job.description:
We have a fulltime permanent position for a mid-level Telecom Field Technician.

Location:  Bettendorf, IA

We’re seeking a dedicated Telecom Field Technician. This critical role offers the chance to troubleshoot, install, and maintain vital communication infrastructure, ensuring seamless connectivity for our clients. If you thrive on solving problems and working hands-on with cutting-edge technology, this is the opportunity for you.

Required Skills:

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in telecommunications or equivalent technical training
  • Background in wiring, alarm systems, or related technical fields
  • Proficiency with test equipment such as OTDR, OSA, DS1/3, Ethernet tools
  • Strong PC skills and excellent oral and written communication
  • Valid state driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Ability to multi-task and remain composed in demanding environments
  • Flexibility to work day, evening, night shifts, overtime, weekends, and holidays as needed
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with private line broadband installation and maintenance
  • Knowledge of DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM, and IP/MPLS fundamentals
  • Cisco or Alcatel Lucent IP certifications
  • VOIP switching and maintenance expertise
  • Fiber optics splicing and maintenance skills
  • SS7/STP support familiarity
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • College or technical degree in a related field
  • Prior experience with telecommunications equipment installation, troubleshooting, and network restoration
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including call-ins and emergency support
  • Willingness to participate in a rotational on-call schedule for network monitoring and support
Bring your technical skillset and enthusiasm to a role where every day presents new opportunities to innovate and keep the world connected. Take the next step in your career—apply now and become a vital part of our telecommunications team!

job.title: Signal Technician / Trainer
job.description:
Join a dynamic team committed to transforming traffic management with innovative solutions! As a Traffic Signal Technician / Trainer, you’ll play a vital role in empowering our partners—distributors, agencies, and contractors—to independently install and maintain cutting-edge traffic technology across California, Arizona, and Nevada. This is your chance to make a tangible impact on public safety and traffic flow while advancing your technical expertise and leadership skills.

Overview
In this hands-on, field-centered role, you'll be the go-to expert for everything Signals —leading training sessions, troubleshooting installations, and supporting project success. Balancing on-site activities with remote collaboration, you’ll ensure our hardware and software solutions are expertly deployed and maintained, championing quality and efficiency at every step.

Key Responsibilities

  • Train and empower partners on hardware installation, system integration, and software management using tools like Download Manager and Installation Assistant.
  • Lead physical installation efforts, working directly in the field to troubleshoot, validate, and optimize deployments.
  • Support project through remote QA, ensuring installations meet standards and providing technical guidance to partners.
  • Collaborate with sales and project teams by reviewing documentation, preparing equipment, and planning installation workflows.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on traffic signal hardware, intersection cabinet architecture, and system integration.
  • Travel approximately 40% to install sites, conduct training, and troubleshoot onsite.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of traffic signal/ITS field experience.
  • IMSA Level II certification (Level III a plus, or ability to obtain within a few months).
  • Deep knowledge of intersection cabinet architecture and hardware.
  • Field girt with the ability to work calmly under pressure and handle physical installations and troubleshooting.
  • Comfortable with travel and working in diverse environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence to lead groups and technical discussions.
This opportunity offers a competitive salary of $100k, with flexibility for the right candidate. If you’re a hands-on traffic tech who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys educating others, we want to hear from you. Apply now and be part of shaping smarter, safer roads!

job.title: Spark, HDFS & Kafka Administrator/Engineer - NJ onsite
job.description:
Onsite in Jersey City

Must Haves: 
* Great Communication, able to explain everything in detail
* Linux Admin - log in and perform commands
* Hands-on 3-5 years min experience Cloudera Cluster, HDFS, Spark, Kafka
We are seeking an experienced Spark, HDFS, and Kafka Administrator/Engineer to manage, support, and optimize enterprise-grade big data platforms. Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, HDFS, and Kafka is required and will be the primary focus of this role. Experience administering these technologies within a Cloudera environment is preferred but secondary to strong expertise in the underlying technologies.

Main areas of responsibilities:
  • Spark Administration: Deploy, configure, monitor, tune, and troubleshoot Apache Spark environments and workloads. Support Spark job performance, resource management, capacity planning, and production operations.
  • HDFS Administration: Manage and support HDFS storage, including capacity, performance, availability, permissions, replication, and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of HDFS architecture and integration with distributed compute platforms is required.
  • Kafka Administration: Deploy, configure, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot Apache Kafka clusters, topics, producers, and consumers. Support performance, capacity, availability, security, and production operations.
  • Monitoring and Performance Tuning: Monitor platform connectivity, health, capacity, and performance using tools such as Grafana, Splunk, and relevant platform management tools. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across Spark, HDFS, and Kafka.
  • Security and Compliance: Implement and manage security configurations, including Kerberos, SSL/TLS, authorization policies, HDFS ACLs, and enterprise IAM/LDAP integrations.
  • Automation and Scripting: Develop and maintain automation using Python, Bash, or Perl for routine administration, configuration management, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Troubleshooting and Support: Provide expert-level troubleshooting and technical support for Spark, HDFS, Kafka, and related big data technologies, including participation in an on-call rotation.
  • Platform Administration: Support installations, patching, upgrades, migrations, and platform lifecycle activities while minimizing downtime. Cloudera Hadoop/CDP administration will be part of the role but is secondary to expertise in Spark, HDFS, and Kafka.

Requirements:
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Hybrid onsite 4 days a week.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on production experience administering and supporting Apache Spark, HDFS, and Kafka.
  • Strong, demonstrable expertise in Spark

job.description:
PC Support I (Contract) — Kansas City, MO (On-site)

Keep people productive by being the hands-on tech support that gets workstations, laptops, tablets, and peripherals set up correctly—and keeps them running. In this role, you’ll support end users in a fast-paced environment, translate technical issues into plain language, and help ensure a smooth day-to-day experience for employees.

Overview: Under general supervision, you’ll install, maintain, and upgrade workstation hardware, software, and operating systems (including tablet devices). The primary work location is on-site in downtown Kansas City. Core hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm (some flexibility), with opportunities for overtime. There may be occasional remote-work opportunities, but on-site work should be expected Monday through Friday. 

Key Responsibilities:
  • Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade end-user devices (desktops, laptops, tablets) and operating systems
  • Support Windows 10/11 environments and common desktop/networking concepts
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues using a ticketing system
  • Support productivity tools including Microsoft Office / Office 365
  • Explain technical issues and solutions in non-technical, customer-friendly terms
  • Assist with hardware/peripheral support, including laptop/PC hardware and laser printer technology
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • 2–3 years of experience working in an IT environment
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office / Office 365
  • Understanding of DNS and Active Directory (what they do and how they work)
  • Valid state-issued driver’s license and comfort driving a van or Sprinter
  • Ability to perform physical job activities including lifting/carrying/pushing/pulling up to 70 lbs
Nice-to-Have:
  • A/V experience
Apply today to help deliver reliable, high-touch technology support that keeps teams moving.

job.description:
Digital Engagement Analyst (Contract | Remote) Help shape how millions of people engage with their finances year-round. We are building connected digital experiences that connect clients to personalized experiences across tax, financial products, and future financial freedom initiatives. If you enjoy blending customer insight, messaging strategy, and hands-on execution, this role offers a chance to make measurable impact across high-volume digital journeys.

Overview: As a Digital Engagement Analyst, you’ll deliver personalized in-app engagement experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Go-To-Market, Marketing, Analytics, and Technology teams to translate business goals into engagement journeys, build in-app experiences, and measure results.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build, test, deploy, experiment, and optimize in-app campaigns using the Airship Engagement Platform
  • Develop personalized journeys supporting onboarding, adoption, retention, servicing, and customer education
  • Create and maintain in-app content (banners, cards, message center, surveys, interstitials, and more)
  • Translate business requirements into customer-facing engagement experiences with cross-functional partners
  • Manage campaign QA (audience validation, content review, rendering checks, end-to-end testing)
  • Monitor performance and build reporting tied to engagement effectiveness and business outcomes
  • Recommend future engagement strategies based on results, customer behavior, and opportunities
  • Maintain documentation, roadmaps, journey maps, and operational processes
  • Help scale consistent engagement practices, governance, and measurement approaches
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, or related field OR equivalent experience
  • 1–3 years in digital/customer engagement, marketing technology, or in-app messaging platforms
  • Experience with Airship, Braze, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, OneSignal, or similar platforms
  • Experience building/testing/deploying in-app messages, push notifications, customer journeys, or personalized digital experiences
  • Strong writing/content development skills and attention to detail
  • Experience with campaign QA, testing, and performance reporting
  • Comfortable using data/customer insights to improve outcomes
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; adaptable in a fast-paced environment
Nice-to-Have:
  • Platform certifications (Airship, Braze, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar)
  • Mobile app engagement, lifecycle management, or personalization experience
  • Background supporting fintech/financial services, consumer tech, mobile apps, or digital products
Bring your curiosity and executional strength—and help create digital experiences that keep clients connected all year long.

job.title: Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer
job.description:
Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer?

About the Role: We are seeking a highly capable and self-directed Senior Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer to lead vehicle-level software validation and development operations across embedded domains—chassis, body, thermal, and more. This role is critical in ensuring high software quality through robust in-vehicle testing and operational readiness of the development fleet.
You’ll collaborate closely with software, calibration, integration, and test engineering teams to plan, execute, and debug vehicle-level test campaigns, while driving day-to-day development activities with a high degree of autonomy. This role will also require travel to winter test proving grounds and other company test sites to support seasonal validation efforts and major release milestones.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  • Own and lead vehicle-level test planning and execution for pre-merge and post-merge software builds across multiple domains (chassis controls, body systems, thermal, etc.)
  • Drive end-to-end development fleet readiness including software flashing, configuration, instrumentation setup, and release coordination
  • Operate and evaluate vehicles in structured and exploratory test routes, validating embedded feature behavior and performance
  • Partner with technicians and garage teams to manage vehicle setup, diagnostics, and resolution of hardware/software issues
  • Lead issue triage and debugging efforts using CAN tools (e.g., CANalyzer, Canape, Vehicle Spy), log analysis, and collaboration with engineering owners
  • Document, track, and escalate software issues with clear context, reproduction steps, and logs in tools like Jira
  • Contribute to the creation and improvement of vehicle-level test processes, test plans, and validation workflows
  • Travel as needed to proving grounds (e.g., winter testing), test tracks, and company engineering sites to support vehicle testing and fleet operations
  • Afternoon, weekend, or nighttime testing may be required depending on development needs and test schedules
  • Provide mentorship to junior engineers and operators on validation best practices and vehicle test procedures

Basic Qualifications:
 
  • 5+ years of experience in vehicle-level software validation, systems integration, or embedded development
  • Strong proficiency with CAN tools, diagnostic interfaces, and log analysis for embedded systems
  • Demonstrated ability to operate development vehicles safely and confidently in a test environment
  • Hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams including SW engineers, technicians, and test operators
  • Solid understanding of automotive embedded systems, including body modules, thermal management, and chassis control ECUs
  • Proven track record of debugging complex vehicle-level issues

Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field
  • Accredited proving ground driver training
  • Experience with electric vehicle platforms and modern vehicle software architecture
  • Familiarity with software release tools and test case management systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel to remote test sites (including cold weather and high-altitude locations)
  • Experience supporting vehicle bring-up, calibration loops, or multi-domain integration testing
  • Knowledge of functional safety principles (ISO 26262) or automotive process frameworks (ASPICE)

job.title: R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE)
job.description:
R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Wilmington, DE.
  • Pay Rate: $28-31/hr
  • Shift: M-F 4:00 pm - 12:30 am (some flexibility may be available in daily start/finish times). Will be trained during daytime hours (~8:30 am - 5 pm) for the first three months.
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Operation of a focused-ion beam scanning electron microscope (FIB-SEM) in support of the Leveraged Analytical Sciences group.
  • The candidate will work under the direction of experienced scientists to provide analytical support for Research and Development (R&D), Technical Service and Development (TS&D), and Manufacturing.
  • Prepare samples for analysis, following established procedures using equipment such as mechanical polishers, plasma or sputter coaters, and FIB-SEM cross-section milling and lift-out procedures.
  • Perform FIB-SEM analyses including imaging, energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDS), and electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD), and assess basic data quality.
  • Review and organize collected data for reporting to customers.
  • Perform routine instrument maintenance, following established procedures.
  • Dispose of laboratory waste according to established protocols.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols.

Required:
  • 1+ years of experience performing FIB-SEM analyses and x-ray spectroscopy in an R&D environment
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest chemical manufacturing companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
job.description:
Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

Location: Noblesville, IN 46060
Employment Type: Direct Hire | Full-Time
Salary: $80,000–$110,000 annually
Schedule: Monday–Friday | Onsite

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Process Engineer to support a pharmaceutical manufacturing operation in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges, improving equipment reliability, optimizing production processes, and driving measurable operational improvements in a regulated environment.

What You'll Do
  • Lead manufacturing process improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability, efficiency, throughput, and operational performance.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and recurring process issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Develop, monitor, and improve process performance indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing objectives.
  • Lead root cause investigations, author deviations, and develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
  • Prepare technical documentation, including engineering protocols, reports, and process improvement documentation.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, and Validation teams to ensure compliance with cGMP requirements.
  • Support equipment qualification, process validation, change control, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of manufacturing procedures, batch records, and training materials.
  • Coordinate engineering projects, track milestones, and provide input on project costs and resource requirements.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. Mechanical Engineering preferred; Chemical, Biochemical, Biotechnology, or related engineering disciplines considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience improving manufacturing processes, equipment performance, and operational reliability.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting production equipment and resolving manufacturing issues.
  • Experience leading formal root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP, validation, quality systems, and document control.
  • Experience developing or utilizing process KPIs to measure and improve manufacturing performance.
  • Strong technical documentation, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with automated visual inspection systems or pharmaceutical packaging equipment.
  • Background supporting automated manufacturing lines, equipment optimization, or reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical devices, or other highly regulated production environments.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Direct-hire opportunity with an established pharmaceutical manufacturing organization.
  • Opportunity to lead meaningful equipment and process improvements.
  • Collaborative, cross-functional engineering environment.
  • Work on manufacturing operations where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

Interested?
Apply today to connect with Yoh Life Sciences and learn more about this Process Engineer opportunity in Noblesville, Indiana.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Field Service Engineer
job.description:
As a Field Service Engineer focused you’ll provide expert technical support for our full lineup of lithium-ion aircraft battery, power conversion and other electrical power system products. To be successful in this role, you’ll need to be able to accurately troubleshoot technical issues, while providing a top-notch customer experience.
THIS POSITION MAY BE FOR YOU IF…
•
You have a minimum of 5 years of direct aviation experience and technical support activities in a customer support environment.
•
You have extensive knowledge and understanding of aircraft electrical systems and are skilled at troubleshooting and problem-solving system installation and operation.
•
You are experienced in conducting tests and inspections of aircraft avionics and electrical systems to evaluate field function and operation.
•
You have knowledge of aviation certification requirements and disciplines such as DO-160, DO-254, DO-178, DO-311a as they relate to TSO, Type Certification or Supplemental Type Certification activities.
•
You have experience with FAR Part repair station requirements, FAR Parts 91, 23, 25 operations and current FAA and EASA requirements.
•
You are proficient with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
•
You have strong attention to detail.
•
You are organized, focused, and results oriented.
•
You are a problem-solver with critical thinking and prioritizing skills.
•
You have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
•
You are comfortable spending most of the day on the phone at your desk in an open office environment.
WE WOULD REALLY LIKE IT IF… (but it’s not a deal breaker)
•
You have a working familiarity with aircraft instruments and avionics and would be able to provide technical support for those types of products in a backup capacity.
•
You have knowledge of FAA Special Conditions.
•
You have a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
•
You hold a FAA A&P and/or pilot certification.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM ONE DAY TO THE NEXT…
Job Description

•
Diagnose customer issues and identify the action required (using company databases, customer information, and collaboration with other departments) to reach resolution
•
Serve as a primary technical interface for support of installation, configuration, operation, and management of products
•
Assist in the development of technical sales presentations to support customer meetings, trade shows, and conferences
•
Monitor field data for reliability trends and proactively coordinate with Quality and Engineering technical teams for root cause analysis and resolution
•
Track and monitor support cases to ensure timely resolution and effective follow through
•
Maintain accurate records of all service and support communications
•
Participate in industry trade shows as required
•
Travel up to 15% to meet business needs

job.title: Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (Tissue RNA Extraction & RT-qPCR)
job.description:
Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (Tissue RNA Extraction & RT-qPCR)

Location: South San Francisco, CA (100% Onsite)
Pay Rate: $35–$45/hour W2, depending on experience
Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term Contract (Potential for Permanent Conversion)

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a highly hands-on Research Associate I/II to support molecular biology and ex vivo research programs at a growing biotechnology company developing innovative therapies for age-related and chronic diseases.

We are specifically seeking candidates with direct, hands-on experience performing RNA extraction from animal tissues using TRIzol, TRI Reagent, QIAzol, or comparable phenol-chloroform methods, along with 384-well RT-qPCR for gene-expression analysis.

The ideal candidate has personally executed these workflows on a recurring basis, understands the underlying assay principles, and can independently produce accurate, reproducible results in a fast-paced laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Independently process animal tissue samples, including tissue preparation and homogenization, followed by phenol-chloroform RNA extraction.
  • Perform RNA quantification and quality assessment, cDNA synthesis, and RT-qPCR gene-expression analysis.
  • Prepare and run 384-well RT-qPCR plates using accurate pipetting, appropriate controls, reference genes, and established protocols.
  • Analyze gene-expression data, evaluate assay quality, interpret experimental results, and troubleshoot technical variability.
  • Perform molecular and biomarker assays using biological samples such as tissue lysates, serum, plasma, or cell-derived materials.
  • Maintain mammalian cell cultures using aseptic techniques, including routine passaging, counting, and culture maintenance.
  • Support ex vivo research through tissue processing and primary cell preparation or isolation.
  • Execute established laboratory protocols efficiently while managing multiple experiments and sample sets.
  • Maintain accurate experimental documentation, track samples, and communicate results to research teams.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related life science discipline.
  • Substantial, directly relevant hands-on laboratory experience in academic, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related research environments.
  • Personal experience performing phenol-chloroform RNA extraction from animal tissues using TRIzol, TRI Reagent, QIAzol, or a comparable method.
  • Personal experience performing RT-qPCR gene-expression analysis using 384-well plates.
  • Experience with RNA quality assessment, cDNA synthesis, assay setup, and gene-expression data analysis.
  • Understanding of RT-qPCR principles, assay controls, reference-gene normalization, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong pipetting skills, including accurate preparation of high-throughput, multiwell assays.
  • Hands-on mammalian cell culture experience.
  • Experience processing biological tissues and/or isolating primary cells.
  • Experience performing biomarker or protein-based assays on biological samples.
  • Ability to independently follow SOPs, manage multiple experiments, maintain accurate records, and generate reproducible results with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Western blot, ELISA, or commercial biomarker assay kits.
  • Experience processing rodent tissues or human donor-derived biological samples.
  • Recent, repeated experience with high-throughput tissue RNA extraction and RT-qPCR workflows.
  • Biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience in a fast-paced research environment.
  • Experience with automated liquid handling or high-throughput molecular assays.
  • Familiarity with GraphPad Prism, Excel, and electronic laboratory notebooks.
  • Experience supporting translational research, pharmacodynamic studies, or early-stage drug discovery.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?
The hiring team is looking for a scientist who is comfortable spending most of the day at the bench.

Successful candidates will be able to explain the molecular assays they have personally performed, including the purpose of experimental controls, how gene-expression data is normalized, and how they identify and troubleshoot assay problems.

This position requires strong technical execution, attention to detail, reliable documentation, and the ability to maintain productivity across multiple projects without extensive training.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Contribute directly to innovative drug discovery research targeting complex age-related diseases.
  • Work in a collaborative biotechnology research environment.
  • Gain exposure to ex vivo tissue studies, molecular assays, and biomarker analysis.
  • Long-term contract opportunity with potential for permanent conversion based on performance and business needs.

Additional Details
  • Fully onsite in South San Francisco, CA, five days per week.
  • Long-term W2 contract.
  • Pay range: $35–$45/hour.
  • No live animal handling required.
  • Final-stage candidates may participate in an onsite practical laboratory assessment.

Apply Today
If you have personally performed animal tissue RNA extraction using TRIzol or similar phenol-chloroform methods and have hands-on experience running 384-well RT-qPCR gene-expression assays, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit an updated resume highlighting the tissue types, RNA extraction methods, qPCR plate formats, molecular assays, and cell culture procedures you have personally performed.

Yoh, a Day & Zimmermann company, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing facility located in Essex Junction, VT. This RN will provide occupational health and needs to be able to work independently.

Schedule: M/W/F 8a-8:30p
Duration: ASAP through 12/31/26 with possible extension or permanent placement
Pay: $35-47/hr, DOE

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Provides on-site care and follow-up to occupationally injured/ill workers.
  • Responsible for maintaining OSHA records as well as following OSHA guidelines.
  • Maintains a medical record database and provides reports to management, as needed.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry)
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry) for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry) will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN

Job Functions
  • Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
  • Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
  • Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
  • Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
  • Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
  • Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
  • Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
  • Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
  • Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
  • Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
  • Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming. 
  • Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
  • Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
  • Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
  • Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
  • Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
  • Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
  • Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
  • Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.
Education
  • Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
  • 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
  • Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
  • Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
  • Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
  • Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

Software Engineering Manager (EDI/API)
Direct Hire
Allen, TX (Hybrid)

Overview
We’re hiring a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead a team building and supporting external integrations with customers, partners, and third-party service providers.   • Cloud experience (Azure preferred) with serverless, API management/gateways, and messaging/eventing
  • Familiarity with EDI standards and/or integration platforms (iPaaS/middleware/managed EDI tools)
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments and delivering to business deadlines
  • Knowledge of secure API patterns and production operations best practices
  • Experience in distribution, eCommerce, fulfillment/logistics, or B2B partner ecosystems

job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurses needed for 3rd shift contract opportunities with Yoh's manufacturing client in Arlington, TX. Two openings available!
 
  • Opening #1: Full-time, Sunday-Thursday for approximately 3 months, then transitions to per-diem
  • Opening #2: Two Fridays per month plus additional per diem coverage as needed (minimum commitment of 4 shifts/month)

This role is primarily focused on occupational health administration, compliance reporting, and case documentation, with limited direct patient care. The RN will support employee health services while managing OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, health surveillance records, and corporate reporting requirements.


3rd Shift: 10:00PM - 6:30AM (Sundays 9:00PM - 6:30AM)
* Flexibility for occasional earlier or later start/end times is required to support shift changes.
* Must be able to complete 5 days of daytime orientation prior to working independently on 3rd shift. Orientation is typically 6:00AM - 2:30PM, with EMR training from 7:00AM - 3:30PM.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Texas RN license
  • 3+ years of nursing experience in Occupational Health, Employee Health, Urgent Care, Emergency Medicine, Family Practice, Corrections, School Nursing, or similar settings
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated who can adapt to changing priorities and maintain a positive attitude in a fast-paced setting
  • Proficiency with EMR systems and electronic documentation
  • Professional, dependable, and customer-service focused

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assess, triage, treat, and educate employees with work-related or non-work-related health concerns
  • Provide first aid and episodic treatment within established standing orders
  • Manage OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, and health surveillance reporting
  • Perform occupational health screenings including drug testing, vision testing, pulmonary function testing, and biometric screenings
  • Document care and case activity in Cority EMR
  • Support employee wellness initiatives and programs
  • Assist with minor procedures and respond to workplace medical emergencies as needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current Texas RN license
  • Current CPR/BLS
  • Must be computer savvy with experience using EMR systems (Cority experience strongly preferred)
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of occupational health, injury prevention, workplace safety, and employee wellness principles
  • Comfortable stepping into a busy environment, embracing change, and contributing to a collaborative, supportive team culture

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on employee health, safety, and wellness
  • Long-term opportunity with ongoing per diem potential
