job.title: Lead Business System Analyst | Private Credit | Allvue Platform
job.description:
TThe Role
Serve as the primary technology partner to the Private Credit business, advancing the platforms, data, integrations and workflows supporting front-office and investment-accounting capabilities, with a primary focus on Allvue.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders, configure investment applications, analyze data using SQL, troubleshoot complex issues and work directly with developers and vendors on solutions. You will own workstreams from concept through implementation and stabilization, mentor analysts, establish delivery standards and help shape the multi-year Private Credit technology roadmap. You will collaborate with colleagues across the US and UK.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership and Solution Design
  • Act as the primary technology partner for Private Credit stakeholders and the business product manager.
  • Lead discovery through workshops, interviews and data analysis; translate business needs into requirements, process flows, data mappings, functional designs and user stories.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify requirement and control gaps, evaluate solution options and drive clear business and technology decisions.
  • Design end-to-end Private Credit workflows spanning deal and facility setup, trade execution, funding, interest and fee accruals, rate resets, paydowns, amendments, valuations, restructurings and reporting.
  • Translate Private Credit operating requirements into scalable platform configurations, integrations and data solutions.
Systems, Data and Delivery
  • Configure Allvue workflows, reference data, business rules and application behavior.
  • Use advanced SQL for data profiling, reconciliation, impact analysis, data lineage and root-cause investigation.
  • Trace data across front-office platforms, Security Master, IBOR, investment accounting and enterprise data platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Understand and map relationships among sponsors, borrowers/issuers, deals, facilities/assets, trades, portfolios, positions/holdings and accounting records.
  • Validate REST APIs, JSON payloads, batch/file interfaces and data pipelines; define reconciliations, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Partner with engineering teams on integration design, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Lead system, integration and user-acceptance testing with particular focus on business outcomes, accounting impact, financial calculations and data integrity.
  • Support implementation through production stabilization and ensure sustainable operational handoff.
That entity-level modeling matters in your environment. In Loan Tape process, CFO was discussed in terms of company roles such as sponsor, borrower and issuer, followed by asset creation, funding/trade activity and downstream investment-accounting integration.
Credit Data, Loan Tapes and Reporting
I would give this its own section because it is a meaningful capability rather than burying it under qualifications.
  • Design, configure and maintain Private Credit loan tapes, portfolio extracts and credit reporting datasets for operational, investor, lender and other downstream requirements.
  • Define source-to-target mappings and calculations covering borrower/issuer, facility type, commitment, funded and unfunded amounts, outstanding principal, benchmark/reference rate, spread, floor, maturity, PIK/cash-pay terms, seniority, lien, financial metrics and portfolio/holding information.
  • Build configurable templates capable of supporting different reporting requirements while maintaining consistent definitions, lineage and controls.
  • Reconcile loan-tape outputs to Allvue, investment accounting and other systems of record; investigate and resolve breaks.
  • Understand how term sheets and executed credit documentation translate into structured system attributes, transaction terms and downstream reporting.
  • Develop and maintain tear sheets or credit snapshots used for portfolio monitoring and investment review.
This separation is worthwhile because your Private_Credit_Interview_Scorecard already distinguishes a loan tape from a tear sheet: the loan tape is a structured schedule of facilities and loan attributes, while the tear sheet is a concise borrower/deal snapshot used by portfolio managers and analysts. 
Platform, Vendor and Team Leadership
  • Partner with Allvue engineering, product and support teams to troubleshoot defects and influence product enhancements.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among native configuration, custom development, integration, data solutions including Snowflake, and business-process change.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level analysts and establish standards for requirements, solution design, testing, documentation and production readiness.
  • Contribute to the Private Credit technology roadmap with an emphasis on platform simplification, automation, reduced manual processing and stronger data quality and controls.
What You Bring
Private Credit Domain
  • Strong understanding of the Private Credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, closing and funding, servicing, portfolio monitoring, valuation, amendments, restructurings and exits.
  • Knowledge of instruments including unitranche, first- and second-lien direct lending, syndicated loans, term loans, delayed-draw term loans, revolving facilities, mezzanine and PIK/PIK-toggle debt.
  • Strong understanding of loan economics, including floating-rate structures, benchmarks/reference rates, spreads, floors, rate resets, OID, upfront and commitment fees, amendment fees, accruals, paydowns and funded/unfunded commitments.
  • Understanding of facility type, lien position and seniority, and how these characteristics affect transaction processing, accounting and reporting.
  • Understanding of how Security Master, IBOR and investment accounting support transaction processing, positions, controls and downstream data consumption.
  • Experience translating credit agreements, term sheets and other deal documentation into structured application and reporting requirements.
Analysis and Technical
  • Proven experience leading complex requirements analysis and solution design across business, product, data and engineering stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex querying, reconciliation, profiling and root-cause analysis.
  • Hands-on experience configuring investment platforms; Allvue Credit Front Office and/or Investment Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, file-based interfaces, data mappings and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing data-quality controls, reconciliations and exception-management processes.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience, including system testing, UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
 
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, product technology, solution delivery or a similar role within financial services, with meaningful hands-on SQL and application configuration experience.
  • 3+ years working with private markets, leveraged finance or alternative investments, preferably Private Credit/direct lending.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Allvue Credit Front Office and Allvue Investment Accounting.
  • Experience with Private Equity, fund-of-funds or broader alternative-investment platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and enterprise reporting/data-consumption patterns.
  • Experience with Security Master and IBOR implementations.
  • Experience integrating front-office investment platforms with accounting, enterprise data and downstream reporting systems.

  • Have 0-2 years of experience



Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • Ability to work under pressure

  • Knowledge / experience with Semiconductor and SEM metrology tools is a plus

job.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
job.description:
Senior Hardware Engineer

Scope:
• Lead board bring-up, hands-on testing, and characterization of analog, digital, mixed-signal, and high-speed circuits.
• Troubleshoot hardware issues, identify root causes, and implement and verify design modifications.
• Develop and execute test plans to validate hardware performance against system requirements.
• Document test results, debug findings, and recommended design improvements.
• Build and maintain detailed schematics using Altium Designer.
• Guide PCB layout to address critical design requirements, including signal integrity, power integrity, and timing.
• Perform signal integrity and high-speed simulations as needed.
• Partner with operations and assembly teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, testable, cost-effective, and ready for volume production.

Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
• Eight or more years of hands-on board-level hardware design experience, including substantial bring-up, debugging, and validation work.
• Proficiency in Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB layout review.
• Strong foundation in analog, digital, mixed-signal, and high-speed circuit design.
• Proficiency with oscilloscopes and other laboratory instruments used for board-level testing and characterization.
• Ability to develop and execute hardware test plans and deliver repeatable, reliable results.
• Strong understanding of timing analysis and design for manufacturing principles.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate closely with hardware, systems, and manufacturing teams.

Pluses:
• Experience with HyperLynx or similar high-speed simulation tools.
• Expertise in power integrity and signal integrity analysis.
• Experience automating hardware tests using Python or similar scripting languages.
• Experience with board rework and prototype modifications.

job.title: Asset Operations Specialist
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting contract opportunity for a Vendor Contracts & Asset Operations Specialist. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced procurement or vendor management professional with a strong background in contract administration, data reconciliation, and vendor record management.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Vendor Contracts & Asset Operations Specialist
Compensation: $45-60/hr DOE
Type: Contract
Location: Remote
Eligibility: Must qualify as a U.S. Person under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) due to applicable export-control requirements.

Responsibilities
  • Review and organize historical vendor agreements, contracts, amendments, renewals, purchase records, and statements of work across multiple systems and repositories.

  • Consolidate fragmented contract documentation into accurate, searchable records, ensuring historical agreements and related documents are properly linked.

  • Review contract terms, expiration dates, renewal provisions, financial commitments, and other key details to establish reliable vendor and contract records.

  • Standardize vendor information, identify duplicate records, validate ownership, and reconcile inconsistencies across existing datasets.

  • Develop and maintain a centralized vendor and contract inventory, including associated purchasing, software, and asset information.

  • Track contractual obligations, renewal deadlines, notice periods, and outstanding follow-up items.

  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and internal stakeholders to investigate missing documentation and resolve data discrepancies.

  • Prepare recommended vendor record corrections and updates for review and approval by appropriate stakeholders.

  • Establish documentation standards, data validation procedures, and ongoing maintenance guidelines.

  • Monitor project milestones, communicate progress, and deliver organized records and processes for transition to internal teams.

Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in vendor management, contract administration, procurement operations, IT asset management, or data remediation.

  • Demonstrated experience organizing, reconciling, and maintaining large volumes of vendor or contract information across multiple systems.

  • Strong understanding of commercial agreements, contract amendments, statements of work, renewal terms, and purchasing documentation.

  • Advanced Excel or spreadsheet skills, including data validation, reconciliation, deduplication, and structured reporting.

  • Experience maintaining vendor master records, resolving duplicate entries, and standardizing supplier information.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate incomplete records, and coordinate with stakeholders to resolve outstanding issues.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage deliverables against project deadlines.

  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

  • Experience handling confidential commercial and financial information.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading contract cleanup, vendor data consolidation, or master-data improvement initiatives.

  • Familiarity with procurement, contract management, ERP, or IT asset management platforms such as Coupa, Ironclad, NetSuite, Oracle, ServiceNow, or Jira.

  • Understanding of software licensing, vendor agreements, asset tracking, and renewal management.

  • Experience developing centralized vendor databases, contract inventories, or reporting frameworks.

  • Knowledge of records retention, audit readiness, and compliance-related documentation.

  • Background supporting technology, aerospace, defense, or other rapidly growing organizations.

job.title: Lead Business System Analyst | Private Credit | Allvue Platform
job.description:
TThe Role
Serve as the primary technology partner to the Private Credit business, advancing the platforms, data, integrations and workflows supporting front-office and investment-accounting capabilities, with a primary focus on Allvue.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders, configure investment applications, analyze data using SQL, troubleshoot complex issues and work directly with developers and vendors on solutions. You will own workstreams from concept through implementation and stabilization, mentor analysts, establish delivery standards and help shape the multi-year Private Credit technology roadmap. You will collaborate with colleagues across the US and UK.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership and Solution Design
  • Act as the primary technology partner for Private Credit stakeholders and the business product manager.
  • Lead discovery through workshops, interviews and data analysis; translate business needs into requirements, process flows, data mappings, functional designs and user stories.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify requirement and control gaps, evaluate solution options and drive clear business and technology decisions.
  • Design end-to-end Private Credit workflows spanning deal and facility setup, trade execution, funding, interest and fee accruals, rate resets, paydowns, amendments, valuations, restructurings and reporting.
  • Translate Private Credit operating requirements into scalable platform configurations, integrations and data solutions.
Systems, Data and Delivery
  • Configure Allvue workflows, reference data, business rules and application behavior.
  • Use advanced SQL for data profiling, reconciliation, impact analysis, data lineage and root-cause investigation.
  • Trace data across front-office platforms, Security Master, IBOR, investment accounting and enterprise data platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Understand and map relationships among sponsors, borrowers/issuers, deals, facilities/assets, trades, portfolios, positions/holdings and accounting records.
  • Validate REST APIs, JSON payloads, batch/file interfaces and data pipelines; define reconciliations, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Partner with engineering teams on integration design, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Lead system, integration and user-acceptance testing with particular focus on business outcomes, accounting impact, financial calculations and data integrity.
  • Support implementation through production stabilization and ensure sustainable operational handoff.
That entity-level modeling matters in your environment. In Loan Tape process, CFO was discussed in terms of company roles such as sponsor, borrower and issuer, followed by asset creation, funding/trade activity and downstream investment-accounting integration.
Credit Data, Loan Tapes and Reporting
I would give this its own section because it is a meaningful capability rather than burying it under qualifications.
  • Design, configure and maintain Private Credit loan tapes, portfolio extracts and credit reporting datasets for operational, investor, lender and other downstream requirements.
  • Define source-to-target mappings and calculations covering borrower/issuer, facility type, commitment, funded and unfunded amounts, outstanding principal, benchmark/reference rate, spread, floor, maturity, PIK/cash-pay terms, seniority, lien, financial metrics and portfolio/holding information.
  • Build configurable templates capable of supporting different reporting requirements while maintaining consistent definitions, lineage and controls.
  • Reconcile loan-tape outputs to Allvue, investment accounting and other systems of record; investigate and resolve breaks.
  • Understand how term sheets and executed credit documentation translate into structured system attributes, transaction terms and downstream reporting.
  • Develop and maintain tear sheets or credit snapshots used for portfolio monitoring and investment review.
This separation is worthwhile because your Private_Credit_Interview_Scorecard already distinguishes a loan tape from a tear sheet: the loan tape is a structured schedule of facilities and loan attributes, while the tear sheet is a concise borrower/deal snapshot used by portfolio managers and analysts. 
Platform, Vendor and Team Leadership
  • Partner with Allvue engineering, product and support teams to troubleshoot defects and influence product enhancements.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among native configuration, custom development, integration, data solutions including Snowflake, and business-process change.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level analysts and establish standards for requirements, solution design, testing, documentation and production readiness.
  • Contribute to the Private Credit technology roadmap with an emphasis on platform simplification, automation, reduced manual processing and stronger data quality and controls.
What You Bring
Private Credit Domain
  • Strong understanding of the Private Credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, closing and funding, servicing, portfolio monitoring, valuation, amendments, restructurings and exits.
  • Knowledge of instruments including unitranche, first- and second-lien direct lending, syndicated loans, term loans, delayed-draw term loans, revolving facilities, mezzanine and PIK/PIK-toggle debt.
  • Strong understanding of loan economics, including floating-rate structures, benchmarks/reference rates, spreads, floors, rate resets, OID, upfront and commitment fees, amendment fees, accruals, paydowns and funded/unfunded commitments.
  • Understanding of facility type, lien position and seniority, and how these characteristics affect transaction processing, accounting and reporting.
  • Understanding of how Security Master, IBOR and investment accounting support transaction processing, positions, controls and downstream data consumption.
  • Experience translating credit agreements, term sheets and other deal documentation into structured application and reporting requirements.
Analysis and Technical
  • Proven experience leading complex requirements analysis and solution design across business, product, data and engineering stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex querying, reconciliation, profiling and root-cause analysis.
  • Hands-on experience configuring investment platforms; Allvue Credit Front Office and/or Investment Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, file-based interfaces, data mappings and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing data-quality controls, reconciliations and exception-management processes.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience, including system testing, UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
 
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, product technology, solution delivery or a similar role within financial services, with meaningful hands-on SQL and application configuration experience.
  • 3+ years working with private markets, leveraged finance or alternative investments, preferably Private Credit/direct lending.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Allvue Credit Front Office and Allvue Investment Accounting.
  • Experience with Private Equity, fund-of-funds or broader alternative-investment platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and enterprise reporting/data-consumption patterns.
  • Experience with Security Master and IBOR implementations.
  • Experience integrating front-office investment platforms with accounting, enterprise data and downstream reporting systems.

job.title: IT - Desktop Support-Level II
job.description:
Desktop Support Analyst
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Onsite)
 
Looking for someone with good attitude, self-driven, can come and work independently and hit the ground running. Culture, team fit and attitude is the biggest thing for this group!
 
Job Description:
We are seeking a qualified professional Analyst II, Home Office Tech to provide IT Support to our internal employees, resolving or escalating issues in a timely and professional manner over multiple channels of communication. Secondarily, this role will support and participate in internal IT activities such as helping rollout and drive user adoption to new technologies, ensuring new hires success with IT needs when they start, and assist in building a robust knowledge base that we be leveraged as we introduce automation and AI.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provides Tier 2 support for end-user computing devices for employees and Contingent workers in multiple offices and functions as an escalation point for Tier 1 support.
  • Responds to incidents and requests within a ticketing system, providing resolution within a complex fast-paced business environment.
  • Deploys and troubleshoots end-user computing devices including laptops, desktops, printers, MFPs, and wireless devices that are aligned with the Home Office Security Policy.
  • Reimage computers/hard drives in accordance with standards using MS Intune Autopilot. Perform Move, Add, and Change functions including installation and decommission.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows-based operating systems, Microsoft Office and Internet browsers.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot MAC/Apple-based operating systems and proprietary applications.
  • Configures and supports remote users including VPN client and connectivity.
  • Provides customer training and knowledge documentation.
  • Complies with and supports ITIL change-incident-problem management processes and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots incidents and fulfills requests within established SLAs.
  • Adheres to Desktop and End User Computing processes, procedures, policies, and job aids.
  • Provides a high touch, business-aware, personalized, world-class customer service that extends to executive and senior-level support.
  • Partner with Business Units, Active Directory (Azure), Messaging, Network, Engineering, Information Security, Service Desk and vendors.
  • Perform asset inventory activities as needed.
  • Able to work with minimal instruction on day-to-day operations and general instruction on new assignments from management.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to internal business partners by troubleshooting IT-related problems from LOB application, MS Suite and VPN for remote users, to hardware such as mobile phones, laptops, PCs and printers.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer service for all support queries and adhere to all service management principles, and standard operating procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement by thinking out of the box for potential solutions or ideas around reducing volume to the service desk and contribute to our knowledge base by writing and submitting KB articles.
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Must be able to work 100% from a corporate office 5 days a week. Role supports onsite employees so working remotely is not an option.
  • 2+ years of Tech Support experience including supporting Windows and Mac
  • Experience with workstation setup, Citrix VDI experience, conference room support, networking, and other related duties
  • Experience in management and support of Microsoft Active Directory Domains, Azure, Intune AutoPilot, ServiceNow,Microsoft Office, Office 365, corporate networks, and mobile device technology.
  • Working knowledge of various Windows OS and hardware for PC environments, principles and terminology of networking and mobile technologies.
  • Strong communication skills and collaborative attitude are key attributes for this role.
  • An associate’s degree, Certificate, or Boot Camp in Computer Science or equivalent training/experience required.

job.title: IT - Desktop Support-Level II
job.description:
Desktop Support Analyst
12 month contract/contract to hire
Austin, TX (Onsite)
 
Looking for someone with good attitude, self-driven, can come and work independently and hit the ground running. Culture, team fit and attitude is the biggest thing for this group!
 
Job Description:
We are seeking a qualified professional Analyst II, Home Office Tech to provide IT Support to our internal employees, resolving or escalating issues in a timely and professional manner over multiple channels of communication. Secondarily, this role will support and participate in internal IT activities such as helping rollout and drive user adoption to new technologies, ensuring new hires success with IT needs when they start, and assist in building a robust knowledge base that we be leveraged as we introduce automation and AI.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provides Tier 2 support for end-user computing devices for employees and Contingent workers in multiple offices and functions as an escalation point for Tier 1 support.
  • Responds to incidents and requests within a ticketing system, providing resolution within a complex fast-paced business environment.
  • Deploys and troubleshoots end-user computing devices including laptops, desktops, printers, MFPs, and wireless devices that are aligned with the Home Office Security Policy.
  • Reimage computers/hard drives in accordance with standards using MS Intune Autopilot. Perform Move, Add, and Change functions including installation and decommission.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows-based operating systems, Microsoft Office and Internet browsers.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot MAC/Apple-based operating systems and proprietary applications.
  • Configures and supports remote users including VPN client and connectivity.
  • Provides customer training and knowledge documentation.
  • Complies with and supports ITIL change-incident-problem management processes and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots incidents and fulfills requests within established SLAs.
  • Adheres to Desktop and End User Computing processes, procedures, policies, and job aids.
  • Provides a high touch, business-aware, personalized, world-class customer service that extends to executive and senior-level support.
  • Partner with Business Units, Active Directory (Azure), Messaging, Network, Engineering, Information Security, Service Desk and vendors.
  • Perform asset inventory activities as needed.
  • Able to work with minimal instruction on day-to-day operations and general instruction on new assignments from management.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to internal business partners by troubleshooting IT-related problems from LOB application, MS Suite and VPN for remote users, to hardware such as mobile phones, laptops, PCs and printers.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer service for all support queries and adhere to all service management principles, and standard operating procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement by thinking out of the box for potential solutions or ideas around reducing volume to the service desk and contribute to our knowledge base by writing and submitting KB articles.
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Must be able to work 100% from a corporate office 5 days a week. Role supports onsite employees so working remotely is not an option.
  • 2+ years of Tech Support experience including supporting Windows and Mac
  • Experience with workstation setup, Citrix VDI experience, conference room support, networking, and other related duties
  • Experience in management and support of Microsoft Active Directory Domains, Azure, Intune AutoPilot, ServiceNow,Microsoft Office, Office 365, corporate networks, and mobile device technology.
  • Working knowledge of various Windows OS and hardware for PC environments, principles and terminology of networking and mobile technologies.
  • Strong communication skills and collaborative attitude are key attributes for this role.
  • An associate’s degree, Certificate, or Boot Camp in Computer Science or equivalent training/experience required.

job.title: Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor
job.description:
Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor- needed for a full-time remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located around Saint Claire, Maryland.

Summary: Our client is seeking experienced healthcare professionals to serve as Service Delivery Healthcare Instructors.

In this role, instructor delivers Advanced Life Support (ALS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Advanced Life Support (NALS) and in some cases Basic Life Support (BLS) courses to healthcare providers nationwide.

This position offers flexible scheduling opportunities and the ability to make a meaningful impact by preparing healthcare teams to respond effectively during emergencies. Instructors represent the client with professionalism while delivering high-quality, evidence-based education that supports improved patient outcomes and healthcare readiness.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Deliver instructor-led ALS, BLS, PALS, and/or NALS courses in accordance with our client curriculum, policies, and quality standards.
  • Facilitate engaging educational experiences for healthcare professionals using classroom instruction, skills practice, and simulation-based learning.
  • Travel to training locations nationwide to conduct in-person courses and educational programs.
  • Prepare, set up, operate, and return training equipment and course materials in accordance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure accurate completion of course records, participant documentation, evaluations, and reporting requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with all administrative, instructional, and quality assurance requirements.
  • Represent the client professionally and uphold the organization's mission, values, and commitment to excellence.
  • Communicate effectively with Service Delivery regarding scheduling, travel logistics, equipment needs, and course delivery.
  • Maintain current knowledge of program updates, instructional methodologies, and healthcare resuscitation guidelines.
  • Participate in quality improvement and instructor development activities as required
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current professional licensure or certification as one of the following:
    Nationally Registered Paramedic (NRP), Registered Nurse (RN), Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM) Certified Professional Midwife (CPM), Nurse Practitioner (NP),Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA),Respiratory Therapist (RT), Physician Assistant (PA)
  • Current certification as an ALS, PALS, and/or NALS
  • Current or recent clinical experience in emergency medical services, emergency medicine, critical care, neonatal care, pediatrics, or other relevant healthcare settings.
  • Previous experience delivering healthcare education, professional training, simulation-based learning, or clinical instruction preferred.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to engage adult learners and adapt instruction to a variety of healthcare audiences.
  • Ability to travel extensively and independently throughout the United States.
  • Reliable transportation and ability to manage travel logistics.
  • Proficiency with basic technology and audiovisual equipment used in healthcare education.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain professionalism.

    Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to lift, transport, and set up training equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and instruct for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to demonstrate healthcare skills, including CPR and emergency response techniques.
  • Ability to travel frequently by air and ground transportation.

  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities

job.description:
Client Service Associate
12+ month contract
Council Bluffs, IA (Onsite)


Job Overview:
The Client Service Associate plays a crucial role in supporting financial advisors and ensuring an exceptional client experience. This position is responsible for administrative tasks, client relationship management, and operational support within the branch office. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, and able to handle multiple responsibilities while maintaining a professional and client focused approach.

Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing exceptional service and support through phone, email, and in-person interactions while addressing account inquiries and service requests.
Coordinate advisor calendars, schedule client meetings, prepare meeting materials, and manage follow-up communications to ensure a seamless client experience.
Process new account openings, transfers, beneficiary changes, RMDs, address updates, and other account maintenance activities with accuracy and attention to detail.
Maintain accurate client records within the CRM system and support compliance efforts by adhering to firm, FINRA, and SEC regulations while safeguarding confidential client information.
Collaborate with custodians, fund companies, and financial institutions to process transactions, resolve account issues, and monitor account accuracy.
Support overall office operations and client engagement initiatives through document preparation, mail management, event coordination, educational seminars, newsletters, social media updates, and administrative support.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for individuals with client service/administrative experience, preferably in financial services, who are comfortable supporting advisors, handling client requests, account maintenance, scheduling, and CRM documentation.

Requirements:
In-Office role M-F
Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Ability to learn and use CRM systems.
Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work both independently and with a team.
High level of professionalism, discretion, and ethical conduct.
Associate or bachelors degree, preferably in business, accounting or finance.

job.title: Amazon eCommerce Coordinator - onsite in NYC or Culver City
job.description:
Amazon eCommerce Coordinator – Music & Entertainment

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!


Location: New York, NY (Preferred) or Culver City, CA

Employment Type: Temporary, Full-Time

Assignment Duration: Approximately 3 months, with potential for permanent conversion

Pay Rate: $23.00–$25.00 per hour, depending on experience

Start Date: ASAP



Position Summary


An exciting opportunity is available for a detail-oriented and motivated Amazon Coordinator to support a growing e-commerce and licensed merchandise business within the music and entertainment industry!

This position will play a key role in managing day-to-day Amazon marketplace operations, supporting product launches, coordinating artist approvals, and assisting with digital merchandising and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate is passionate about music, highly organized, and comfortable working across multiple teams to bring artist brands and merchandise to life on Amazon.

This is an initial three-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time, permanent position for the right candidate.




Key Responsibilities


Amazon Marketplace Operations


  • Support daily operations of the Amazon marketplace, including product launches, listing setup, updates, and maintenance.
  • Monitor inventory tracking and ensure product information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with digital merchandising efforts to maintain engaging, high-quality product listings.
  • Provide administrative and sales support for the artist licensed merchandise and retail program.

Artist Submissions & Approvals

  • Coordinate artist merchandise and marketing submissions through established approval processes.
  • Organize submission materials, track feedback, and maintain accurate approval records.
  • Follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders to facilitate timely approvals.
  • Help ensure product launches and marketing initiatives remain on schedule.

Product Content & Digital Assets

  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of product imagery, descriptions, A+ content, and other digital assets.
  • Ensure Amazon product listings accurately reflect each artist's brand and creative direction.
  • Organize and maintain product information, artwork, and supporting content.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to ensure brand consistency across marketplace listings.

Marketing & Campaign Coordination


  • Support Amazon marketing campaigns by collecting and organizing promotional materials and creative assets.
  • Track campaign deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate the distribution of artist artwork and marketing materials to internal teams and external partners.
  • Maintain organized, accessible, and secure digital asset libraries and file-sharing links.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Partner with creative, production, sales, buying, and marketing teams to support successful product launches.

job.title: Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
job.description:
Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
Full-Time Weekday Morning Shift
Days/Shift Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8-hour shifts
8:00 AM–5:00 PM

The Materials Coordinator will support warehouse, inventory, order fulfillment, and materials operations in a fast-paced automotive environment. The role will also provide order specialist and emerging markets specialist services, including coordinating material requests, supporting new or evolving customer and market requirements, validating part information, and ensuring orders are accurately prepared and delivered.

Scope:
• Receive, unpack, inspect, and verify merchandise and products for accuracy.
• Process receiving exceptions and resolve discrepancies as needed.
• Use handheld RF tools to receive products into the warehouse management system.
• Perform stock checks, part-number verification, cycle counts, and physical inventory support.
• Coordinate material and parts requests associated with customer orders, service activities, production, and emerging market requirements.
• Review order details, confirm product availability, and help ensure orders are complete and accurate.
• Support the setup and fulfillment of new, nonstandard, or evolving order requirements.
• Communicate with internal teams to clarify material needs, priorities, delivery requirements, and documentation.
• Consolidate loads as required, including packing, repacking, wrapping, and preparing products for shipment.
• Label parts during put-away, picking, and shipping activities.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, work orders, and other material needs.
• Ensure orders and shipping materials include the appropriate documentation, including revised bills of lading, manual tags, packing slips, and delivery records.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, and material requests, and distribute materials, tools, or stock items to production workers or assembly-line personnel.
• Maintain accurate inventory records and support order tracking, reporting, and KPI documentation.
• Assist with materials research, part substitutions, availability checks, and basic market or product-line support for emerging requirements.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, quality standards, and safety guidelines.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
• Cross-train across warehouse and materials functions to support operational flexibility.
• Perform additional organization and support tasks during slower periods, including shop organization, tire stacking and disposal, delivery pickup, and related duties.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry, such as automotive parts, dealership wholesale parts, service or body shop operations, military maintenance, or large automotive manufacturing.
• Experience in roles such as Parts Advisor, Parts Specialist, Inventory Technician, Materials Handler, Materials Coordinator, Order Specialist, or similar.
• Experience using a DMS, ERP, or warehouse inventory system, such as CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, or similar. SAP experience is preferred but not required.
• Experience working with automotive technicians, production personnel, service teams, or other hands-on operational groups.
• Basic supply chain, inventory, shipping, receiving, and materials-handling knowledge.
• Ability to verify part numbers, interpret order information, and identify discrepancies.
• Experience creating and maintaining spreadsheets, tables, reports, and inventory records.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Ability to use pallet jacks safely; forklift experience is not required.
• Ability to work effectively as part of a team and adapt to changing priorities.
• Willingness to support additional operational tasks during periods of lower activity.

job.title: Software Engineer III (L4) – Backend & GCP
job.description:
Software Engineer III (L4) – Backend & GCP
We are seeking a Software Engineer III to develop Python backend services, manage GCP workloads, and support cloud-based data and deployment systems. The ideal candidate can independently execute tasks and deliver reliable production-ready solutions.

Scope:
• Develop modular Python services and HTTP endpoints using Flask or similar frameworks.
• Deploy and manage containerized applications on GCP Cloud Run.
• Configure GCP services including Load Balancing, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Scheduler, BigQuery, GCS, and Firestore.
• Build integrations with REST APIs and IoT systems.
• Develop data ingestion and synchronization pipelines.
• Build and deploy Docker/OCI images through Artifact Registry.
• Work within monorepos using Git, Piper, Blaze, or Bazel.
• Write automated tests and maintain code quality through testing, linting, and static analysis.
• Support CI/CD releases across Development, UAT, and Production environments.
• Use Terraform to provision cloud resources and configure IAM roles and service accounts.

Required:
• Strong Python development experience, including Flask or similar frameworks.
• Experience with GCP Cloud Run and related cloud services.
• Experience with containers, Artifact Registry, and REST API integrations.
• Familiarity with BigQuery, GCS, Firestore, and data pipelines.
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and multi-environment deployments.
• Experience with Terraform and least-privilege IAM practices.
• Ability to work independently and troubleshoot application, data, and infrastructure issues.

Pluses:
• Experience with Piper, Google3, Blaze, or Bazel.
• Experience with telemetry, inspection, robotics, automotive, or IoT data.
• Familiarity with serverless, event-driven, and asynchronous architectures.

job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-$28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 

Responsibilities
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control. 
  • Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.
Qualification
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

#IND-SPG

job.title: Microarray Print Process Engineer II
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Microarray Print  Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Microarray Print Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE


Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.

 

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Must have experience with Biodot equipment and microarray printing
  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

job.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
job.description:
MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
Direct Hire
Addison, TX (Hybrid)

We are seeking an experienced Techno-Functional Business Systems Analyst / Project Manager to play a key role in an upcoming Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) migration and upgrade initiative.
 
This individual will serve as a primary liaison between internal business stakeholders, IT teams, developers, and our selected implementation partner. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience supporting or leading Dynamics AX to D365 upgrade/migration projects, with the ability to evaluate, coordinate, and implement moves, adds, changes, enhancements, configurations, and customizations within the ERP environment.
This is a permanent role that will support the organization throughout the implementation lifecycle and transition into an ongoing D365 application support, administration, enhancement, and optimization role following go-live.
We are looking to bring this individual onboard prior to project kickoff so they can gain a strong understanding of our current AX environment, business processes, integrations, data, customizations, and operational requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • AX to D365 Migration & Project Delivery: Serve as an internal subject matter resource throughout the Dynamics AX to D365 F&O migration, partnering with the implementation vendor, internal IT, developers, and business stakeholders from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
  • Application Moves, Adds & Changes: Own and coordinate ongoing moves, adds, changes, enhancements, and modifications across the AX/D365 application environment. Evaluate business requests, determine system impact, document requirements, define acceptance criteria, and oversee changes through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Configuration & Customization: Evaluate whether business requirements can be addressed through standard D365 configuration, workflow changes, extensions, integrations, reporting changes, or custom development. Partner with technical resources on required customizations while helping the organization minimize unnecessary customization of the D365 platform.
  • Business & Technical Requirements: Lead requirements-gathering sessions to document current-state processes and define future-state requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and system specifications.
  • Application Enhancement Management: Manage requests for new functionality and enhancements following established change-management processes. Analyze requested changes for impacts to modules, integrations, data, security roles, workflows, reporting, and other business processes.
  • Fit-Gap & Customization Analysis: Perform fit-gap analysis between the organization's existing AX functionality and D365 capabilities. Identify which legacy AX customizations should be retained, redesigned, replaced with native D365 functionality, or retired as part of the migration.
  • Project Management & Vendor Coordination: Help manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and deliverables. Act as a knowledgeable internal advocate when working with the D365 implementation partner and challenge proposed solutions when they do not align with business or technical requirements.
  • Functional Configuration: Participate in the configuration and ongoing support of applicable D365 modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management.
  • Technical & Integration Coordination: Work closely with developers, architects, and vendors on interfaces, integrations, APIs, data entities, workflows, reports, batch processes, and custom extensions, ensuring technical solutions align with business requirements.
  • Data Migration & Mapping: Support source-to-target mapping, legacy AX data analysis, cleansing, transformation, conversion, financial reconciliation, validation, and cutover activities.
  • Testing & Release Validation: Develop and coordinate test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and post-deployment validation. Ensure moves, adds, changes, configurations, and customizations are properly tested before being introduced into production.
  • Security & Role Changes: Partner with IT and business leadership to manage changes to D365 security roles, duties, privileges, user access, workflows, and segregation-of-duties requirements as the organization evolves.
  • Cutover & Go-Live: Support release planning, cutover, go-live readiness, deployment validation, issue resolution, and post-production hypercare.
  • Documentation & Change Management: Maintain documentation for business processes, system configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, application changes, test results, and operating procedures.
  • Post-Go-Live Application Ownership: Following implementation, serve as a key resource for D365 application support, production issues, moves/adds/changes, configuration changes, enhancements, customizations, upgrades, release management, and continuous improvement.
 
Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Experience participating in or leading an AX to D365 upgrade, migration, or transformation project.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting application moves, adds, changes, configurations, enhancements, and customizations within Dynamics AX or D365.
  • Ability to determine when a business requirement should be solved through configuration versus customization or development.
  • Experience gathering and translating requirements between business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners.
  • Strong understanding of the ERP lifecycle, including requirements, fit-gap analysis, configuration, customization, development coordination, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and production validation.
  • Experience with ERP data migration, mapping, reconciliation, and legacy-system conversion.
  • Strong project management skills, including management of scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, and vendor deliverables.
  • D365 configuration and application administration
  • AX-to-D365 upgrade/migration projects
  • D365 extensions and customizations
  • Workflows and business processes
  • Integrations, interfaces, APIs, and data entities
  • Azure DevOps
  • Lifecycle Services (LCS)
  • Power Platform / Power Automate
  • Power BI and D365 reporting
  • SQL and data analysis
  • Security roles, duties, and privileges
  • SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release management

job.title: Amazon Coordinator - onsite in NYC or Culver City
job.description:
Amazon Coordinator – Music & Entertainment

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!


Location: New York, NY (Preferred) or Culver City, CA

Employment Type: Temporary, Full-Time

Assignment Duration: Approximately 3 months, with potential for permanent conversion

Pay Rate: $23.00–$25.00 per hour, depending on experience

Start Date: ASAP




Position Summary


An exciting opportunity is available for a detail-oriented and motivated Amazon Coordinator to support a growing e-commerce and licensed merchandise business within the music and entertainment industry!

This position will play a key role in managing day-to-day Amazon marketplace operations, supporting product launches, coordinating artist approvals, and assisting with digital merchandising and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate is passionate about music, highly organized, and comfortable working across multiple teams to bring artist brands and merchandise to life on Amazon.

This is an initial three-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time, permanent position for the right candidate.




Key Responsibilities


Amazon Marketplace Operations




  • Support daily operations of the Amazon marketplace, including product launches, listing setup, updates, and maintenance.
  • Monitor inventory tracking and ensure product information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with digital merchandising efforts to maintain engaging, high-quality product listings.
  • Provide administrative and sales support for the artist licensed merchandise and retail program.



Artist Submissions & Approvals




  • Coordinate artist merchandise and marketing submissions through established approval processes.
  • Organize submission materials, track feedback, and maintain accurate approval records.
  • Follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders to facilitate timely approvals.
  • Help ensure product launches and marketing initiatives remain on schedule.



Product Content & Digital Assets




  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of product imagery, descriptions, A+ content, and other digital assets.
  • Ensure Amazon product listings accurately reflect each artist's brand and creative direction.
  • Organize and maintain product information, artwork, and supporting content.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to ensure brand consistency across marketplace listings.



Marketing & Campaign Coordination




  • Support Amazon marketing campaigns by collecting and organizing promotional materials and creative assets.
  • Track campaign deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate the distribution of artist artwork and marketing materials to internal teams and external partners.
  • Maintain organized, accessible, and secure digital asset libraries and file-sharing links.



Cross-Functional Collaboration




  • Partner with creative, production, sales, buying, and marketing teams to support successful product launches.
  • Communicate marketplace needs, project updates, and timelines to relevant stakeholders.
  • Assist with troubleshooting operational challenges and coordinating solutions.
  • Help deliver a seamless customer experience across Amazon storefronts.



Qualifications


  • 1–2 years of relevant experience, preferably in e-commerce, Amazon marketplace operations, digital merchandising, retail, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Genuine interest in music, artists, merchandise, and entertainment culture.



Preferred Qualifications




  • Previous experience with Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, or other e-commerce marketplace platforms.
  • Familiarity with product listings, digital merchandising, and online retail operations.
  • Experience coordinating creative assets, marketing campaigns, or product launches.
  • Exposure to licensed merchandise, consumer products, or the music and entertainment industry.

job.title: Antenna Systems Product Manager
job.description:
Antenna Systems Product Manager We’re looking for a technically experienced Antenna Systems Product Manager to lead antenna products from working prototype through commercial introduction and delivery readiness. This person will bridge RF/antenna engineering, materials science, OEM manufacturing partners, and customers to turn advanced antenna technology into reliable, manufacturable, market-ready products that meet performance, cost, and customer requirements.

Hard Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in antenna/RF hardware, RF product development, or technical product management, with a strong understanding of antenna systems and RF principles.
  • Demonstrated experience taking complex hardware from prototype through productization, validation, manufacturing transfer, and production readiness.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, customers, and OEM/contract manufacturing partners to define product requirements, specifications, configurations, schedules, costs, and technical risks.
Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with materials scientists and mechanical engineers on enclosure/packaging, materials selection, environmental durability, and how antenna systems are configured and packaged as commercial products.
  • Experience with the commercial side of hardware productization, including BOM/product costing, supplier quotes, small-batch manufacturing, MOQs, NRE/tooling costs, lead times, and negotiating manufacturing terms.
  • Experience with defense, maritime, ruggedized RF systems, or advanced communications products, particularly in customer-facing environments.
Success in This Role Successfully transition antenna technology from the laboratory into customer-deliverable products, balancing RF performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, schedule, and customer requirements.

job.title: Shipping Associate / Order Selector
job.description:
Yoh is looking for a Shipping Associate / Order Selector to join our biotechnology client in Pleasanton, CA.

This is a hands-on warehouse role supporting order fulfillment, shipping/receiving, inventory movement, and general warehouse operations. The ideal candidate will be dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attendance are critical.

Candidates with experience in order picking, fulfillment, shipping/receiving, distribution, retail fulfillment, or general warehouse operations are encouraged to apply.

Industry: Biotechnology / Supply Chain
Location: Pleasanton, CA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, first shift. Typical start time is around 8:00 AM; training or operational needs may require a 7:30 AM start. Overtime may be available as needed.
Compensation: $22–$26/hour DOE
Type: 6-Month Contract

Responsibilities
  • Pick, pack, label, and stage orders accurately for internal and external customers
  • Verify items, quantities, and shipment information before orders are released
  • Receive incoming packages and materials, inspect quantities, and route items appropriately
  • Support inventory putaway, stocking, and material movement throughout the warehouse
  • Use RF scanners, handheld devices, and warehouse systems to process and track materials
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities
  • Support inventory counts and cycle-count activities to help maintain inventory accuracy
  • Maintain organized storage and work areas
  • Follow established warehouse, safety, and quality procedures
  • Support general warehouse and material-handling needs as required
  • Work collaboratively with warehouse and operations team members to meet daily productivity goals

Requirements
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, order picking, fulfillment, shipping/receiving, material handling, or a similar environment
  • Hands-on experience picking and packing orders preferred
  • RF scanner or handheld barcode scanner experience preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain order accuracy
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and work independently when needed
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift
  • Ability to safely lift up to 50 lbs
  • Comfortable working in cooler or cold-room environments for periods of time as needed
  • Basic computer skills
  • Experience with warehouse management or ERP systems is a plus; Oracle experience is preferred but not required
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or regulated environments is a plus but not required
  • Willingness to work occasional overtime as business needs require

Preferred Qualifications
  • Order selector, order picker, fulfillment, or pick/pack experience
  • RF scanner experience
  • Shipping and receiving experience
  • Inventory or cycle-count experience
  • Experience working in a fast-paced distribution or fulfillment environment

job.title: Senior Separation Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Sr. Separations Scientist in Bristol, PA.  The individual will serve as a technical expert in separations-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities. The Sr. Separations Scientist will develop and implement advanced chromatographic workflows for structural characterization, impurity analysis, linker-payload assessment, DAR determination, and comparability studies to support clinical development programs.

Position:  Sr. Separations Scientist
Duration: Contract to Perm
Pay: $40-$50/hr DOE
Shift: M-F 8-5pm


Key Responsibilities

• Lead development, optimization, and transfer of chromatographic analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.

• Design and execute chromatographic studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.

• Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, aggregation, fragmentation and charge variant assessment, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.

• Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.

• Collaborate closely with process development, bioassay, formulation, and quality teams to establish analytical control strategies and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for chromatographic analyses.

• Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.

Required Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; M.S. with 2+ years or B.S. with 4+ years of relevant experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience with LCUV characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.

• Experience with analytical characterization techniques including RPLC/UV, SEC-UV, IEX-UV, non-reduced/reduced cIEF.

• Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.

• Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Empower or equivalent platforms.

Estimated Max Rate: $50.00

job.title: Philanthropy, Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!
job.description:
Philanthropy Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorhsip. No C2C!!!


Location: Los Angeles, CA

Industry: Music & Entertainment

Employment Type: Temporary, Part-Time, Internship

Schedule: Approximately 30 hours per week, M-Th

Assignment Duration: January 19, 2027 – Mid April 2027

Pay Rate: $18.42/hourly



About the Opportunity


Client is seeking a passionate, creative, and detail-oriented Philanthropy & Social Impact Intern to support meaningful initiatives that drive positive change.

This is an exciting opportunity for a college student interested in philanthropy, nonprofit partnerships, social responsibility, and community engagement to gain hands-on experience within the music and entertainment industry.

Working alongside the Philanthropy & Social Impact team, this individual will help research and develop charitable initiatives, support impactful campaigns, collaborate with nonprofit partners, and contribute to projects that align with Sony Music Group's commitment to corporate giving and social impact.


About the Department


The department is dedicated to advancing humanitarian efforts, building meaningful partnerships, and expanding philanthropic programs across the company's global footprint. The team also works closely with artists, songwriters, and business partners to support charitable initiatives, raise awareness, and inspire positive change.


Key Responsibilities


Research & Social Impact Initiatives
  • Research emerging social impact opportunities, nonprofit organizations, and potential community partners.
  • Monitor news, social media, and current events related to philanthropy, social justice, civic engagement, and humanitarian issues.
  • Develop profiles and research summaries on prospective nonprofit partners.
  • Assist with evaluating charitable initiatives and identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  • Support data collection, analysis, and reporting to help measure program effectiveness and impact

Communications & Content Development
  • Assist in creating engaging written content, social media posts, and campaign materials.
  • Develop stories highlighting nonprofit partners, grant recipients, and the impact of philanthropic initiatives.
  • Support content development for Heritage Month celebrations, employee engagement initiatives, and other social impact campaigns.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and supporting materials for internal and external audiences.
Campaigns, Partnerships & Events
  • Collaborate with the team on the planning and execution of philanthropic campaigns and initiatives.
  • Participate in meetings with nonprofit organizations and external partners.
  • Attend cross-functional meetings and contribute ideas to support department projects.
  • Assist with virtual and in-person event planning, coordination, and logistics.
  • Help maintain relationships and coordinate communications with internal and external stakeholders

Administrative & Project Support
  • Maintain organized databases, project trackers, and departmental records.
  • Draft professional emails and assist with ongoing project communications.
  • Help coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and department priorities.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed

Qualifications
  • Currently enrolled in a college or university program.
  • Strong interest in philanthropy, social impact, nonprofit organizations, or corporate social responsibility.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Interest in international development, community engagement, humanitarian initiatives, or related social issues.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with or exposure to grant management systems.
  • Previous involvement in volunteer programs, nonprofit organizations, campus initiatives, or community service projects.

job.title: Zscaler Analyst
job.description:
Position OverviewWe are seeking a hands-on Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer to support the rollout, administration, and ongoing operations of an enterprise Zscaler environment.

This individual will take ownership of the operational side of the Zscaler suite, including implementation support, day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and break/fix activities. A key focus will be supporting the rollout of Zscaler for branch application connectivity, including App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
The ideal candidate will come from a strong network engineering or network operations background and have hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day operational support of the Zscaler platform.
  • Support the rollout of Zscaler across branch locations and branch application connectivity.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Zscaler App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
  • Provide hands-on break/fix support for Zscaler-related connectivity and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application access, connectivity, routing, DNS, and network-related issues involving Zscaler.
  • Support configuration changes, platform updates, testing, and ongoing optimization of the Zscaler environment.
  • Monitor the environment and investigate issues impacting users, branch locations, applications, or network connectivity.
  • Work closely with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to troubleshoot cross-functional issues.
  • Help establish an internal Zscaler operational knowledge base, including configurations, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and resolutions.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for ongoing Zscaler operational support.
  • Coordinate with Zscaler support and other vendors as needed to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support the organization's broader network environment, which currently utilizes HPE/HP networking technology and is expected to transition toward Cisco Meraki.
Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler App Connector deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Zscaler Branch Connector or comparable branch connectivity implementations.
  • Strong network engineering or network operations background.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network and application connectivity issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • Routing
    • Network security
    • Firewalls
    • Application connectivity
    • SSL/TLS
    • Zero Trust networking concepts
  • Experience providing operational support and resolving production incidents.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Strong documentation skills with the ability to build technical procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multiple components of the Zscaler product suite.
  • Experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and/or Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
  • Hands-on experience with HPE/HP networking technologies.
  • Cisco Meraki experience, especially supporting enterprise or branch networking environments.
  • Experience working within a Zero Trust or SASE architecture.
  • Experience supporting large, distributed environments with multiple branch locations.
  • Previous experience helping an organization establish operational processes around a newly implemented network/security platform.
