job.title: Mass Spectrometry Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Mass Spectrometry Scientist in Bristol, PA.   This individual will serve as a technical expert in mass spectrometry-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities.  The experienced LC-MS scientist will develop LC-MS methods for conjugate characterization activities supporting process development of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), oligonucleotide conjugates, radioconjugates, and other complex bioconjugate modalities.

Position: Mass Spec Scientist 
Duration: contract to perm 
Pay: $40-$45/DOE
Shift:  M-F 8-5pm 

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead development, optimization, and transfer of LC-MS analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.
  • Design and execute mass spectrometry studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.
  • Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, peptide mapping, PTM identification, conjugation site analysis, aggregation and fragmentation assessment, disulfide scrambling, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.
  • Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.
  • Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for LC-MS analyses.
  • Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.
  • Support regulatory submissions including IND, BLA, and IMPD analytical sections.

Required Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; or M.S. with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience with analytical characterization techniques including intact/reduced, subunit mass analysis, and peptide mapping.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.
  • Hands-on experience with high-resolution mass spectrometry techniques and interpretation of complex datasets.
  • Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.
  • Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Connect, MassLynx, or equivalent platforms

job.title: Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Redding or Fairfield, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit www.yoh.com!

job.description:
Senior Structural Engineer

Join a dynamic engineering team leading innovative structural design projects that make a real impact across diverse sectors including power, healthcare, industrial, military, and more. As a Senior Structural Engineer, you will spearhead complex projects from conception through construction, delivering world-class solutions while guiding, mentoring, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of infrastructure and develop long-lasting relationships with clients and industry partners.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Structural Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program
  • 7+ years of structural engineering experience, preferably with EPC project background
  • Proficient knowledge of structural design codes such as IBC, AISC, ACI, ASCE7
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and CAD software
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large-scale projects and guiding engineering teams
  • Ability to perform quality reviews and resolve complex engineering challenges
  • Valid travel ability (up to 15%)
  • PE License (preferred)
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience leading design for large EPC projects
  • Additional expertise in vendor coordination, technical report writing, and client engagement
  • Proven success in sales, marketing, and securing new business opportunities

  • EPC project experience highly preferred
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to work in a team environment, delegate tasks, and manage project budgets and schedules
  • Strong critical thinking, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Commitment to safety, quality assurance, and continuous improvement
Ready to leverage your expertise in a high-impact environment? Apply now and help shape the infrastructure of tomorrow!

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (AWS/Python/Scala)
job.description:
Title: Senior Data Engineer
Location: McLean, VA; NYC; Wilmington; Boston; Plano; Chicago; or Richmond
Work Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days/week onsite 
Contract: 6+ month 

We are seeking a Senior Big Data/Machine Learning Engineer to support the design, development, and implementation of scalable data engineering and machine learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Python, Scala, AWS data services, distributed processing, streaming technologies, SQL, and REST APIs.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, and support scalable data engineering solutions.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services, including EMR and Glue.
  • Develop distributed data processing applications using Python and Scala.
  • Implement real-time and event-driven data solutions using Kafka and streaming technologies.
  • Create and integrate REST APIs to support data and application workflows.
  • Write complex SQL queries for data transformation, analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, architects, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure solutions meet standards for performance, reliability, scalability, security, and data quality.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and support ongoing enhancements to data platforms.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, testing, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Apply machine learning or artificial intelligence capabilities where appropriate.
Required Qualifications
  • Senior-level experience in data engineering, big data, or machine learning engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or Scala.
  • Experience developing solutions in AWS environments.
  • Practical experience with AWS EMR and AWS Glue.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience with Kafka and streaming data architectures.
  • Strong SQL development and data manipulation skills.
  • Experience working with distributed data processing and large-scale data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with Spark, PySpark, or similar big data frameworks.
  • Familiarity with AWS data, storage, and security services.
  • Experience supporting production data pipelines and enterprise applications.
  • Prior experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments.

job.title: Electrical Engineer - PM (2-10:30PM)
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Services - PM (2-10:30PM)

Scope:
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex electrical issues on autonomous vehicles.
• Perform root-cause analysis and drive issues to resolution, including cross-team collaboration.
• Support the bring-up and validation of autonomous vehicle systems.
• Design, execute, and analyze electrical tests.
• Develop, maintain, and improve electrical documentation and test procedures.
• Collaborate with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure successful project execution.
 
Required:
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or related field.
• 3+ years of experience in electrical engineering, troubleshooting, or validation.
• Strong understanding of electrical systems, circuits, and components.
• Experience with electrical diagnostic tools (multimeter, oscilloscope, CAN diagnostics).
• Familiarity with software diagnostic tools (command line interfaces, interpreting log files).
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on root-cause analysis.
• Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
• Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
• Comfortable using standard business tools (spreadsheets, email, documentation tools).
• Willing and able to travel for medium durations as needed.
 
Pluses:
• 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.
• Automotive familiarity (wiring harnesses, module diagnostics/troubleshooting).
• Linux OS familiarity (hands on experience, programming/ coding).
• Experience working with API development, evaluation, or testing.
• Experience with autonomous or electric vehicles.
• Experience with prototype or early-stage development engineering projects.
• Experience working in manufacturing, validation, or vehicle bring-up environments.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Staff Structural Engineer  

Join our dynamic team as a Staff Structural Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transmission tower infrastructure! In this engaging position, you will lead multiple phases of structural design, analysis, and project documentation for a diverse portfolio of transmission tower projects. Your expertise will directly influence innovative solutions in the energy sector, working on everything from conceptual design to detailed construction drawings. If you’re passionate about structural engineering and eager to work on impactful infrastructure projects, this opportunity offers a perfect blend of challenge and growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Structural Engineering or related from an ABET-accredited program, with 3+ years of experience; or successful FE exam completion with 3+ years’ experience; or Master’s Degree with 2+ years’ experience
  • Proficiency in structural analysis and modeling software such as RISA-3D, ETABS, SAFE, and BIM tools like Revit and Tekla
  • Strong knowledge of design codes, specifications, and engineering techniques
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and organizational abilities
  • Ability to work methodically, analyze complex data, and collaborate effectively with teams
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Engineers in Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience with PLS-Tower modeling, FEM structure modeling, and reinforcement design
  • Knowledge of retrofit or new construction projects for transmission towers
  • Familiarity with project management and proposal development processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited institution
  • 2-3 years of relevant structural engineering experience, particularly in transmission towers or similar structures
  • Existing EIT certification is advantageous
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% for project site visits and meetings
  • Ability to obtain and maintain necessary certifications and work authorization
Ready to make an impact in a challenging and rewarding environment? Apply now to become a key contributor to innovative infrastructure projects that power our communities!

job.title: Certified Athletic Trainer
job.description:
Certified Athletic Trainer needed for a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with Yoh's occupational health clinic client located in Blue Springs, MS. Start as soon as possible. New graduates are encouraged to apply!

This position is located at a manufacturing company with an onsite clinic that provides occupational, primary, and preventive care services for employees. The Athletic Trainer will support approximately 10-15 patients through routine wellness and injury-prevention touchpoints. You will work alongside the clinical team to provide injury prevention, first aid, general wellness services, and health promotion. This role also includes non-appointment-based activities on the production floor, evaluating the physical demands of job tasks, and leading group fitness, stretching, and educational classes.

Schedule:
Monday-Friday, 2:30 PM-11:00 PM
(Second opening available: Monday-Friday 6:00AM-2:30PM)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) - BOC Certified
  • Current Mississippi Athletic Trainer License
  • Experience in occupational health and safety; knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred
  • Experience with ergonomics preferred
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement an early intervention program by performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examinations, providing first aid in accordance with OSHA standards, and educating employees on injury prevention
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies
  • Lead group and individual training sessions focused on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs
  • Collaborate with onsite medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation
  • Participate in meetings and task forces
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited Athletic Training Education Program
  • Active BLS/CPR certification (hands-on courses only)
  • Current annual TB screening (PPD or QuantiFERON Gold test)
  • Passion for promoting health and well-being in the workplace
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
What's In It for You?:
  • Excellent work-life balance with predictable hours and no weekends or holidays
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment where you can make a real difference in keeping workers safe, healthy, and productive
  • Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company that prioritizes collaboration
Know a Great Healthcare Professional Looking for Work?
Refer them today! We work with companies nationwide.
Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational and employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care organizations nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit Yoh Jobs.

job.title: Cosmetic Formulation Chemist
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Cosmetic Formulation Chemist to their team:

Industry: Cosmetics
Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims.
  • Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.
  • Be able to make decisions to troubleshoot production or compounding.
  • Improve and/or revise manufacturing/filling process if needed.
  • Work closely with our chemists to help on challenging projects or when needed.
  • Work closely with our Quality department to improve knowledge about new formulas, establishing standards.
  • Maintain the laboratory clean and organized, respecting GLP’s.
 QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor of Science or higher degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Color formulation experience.
  • Creative thinking, technical writing and organizational skills.
  • At least 6 years and more of industry experience on the bench formulating.
  • Knowledge of cosmetic/personal care raw materials, functionality, and interactions.
  • Understanding of emulsion and surfactant technology as well as general formulation techniques.
  • Must be familiar with regulation for US market and other countries for globally approved formulas, especially for the natural and organic market (NSF, USDA/NOP, NPA).

Business Analyst I/II ( Planning Analyst)

Duration: 12 months contract W2- Potential extension
Pay Rate: $41.08-$52.82 
Location: Remote

** Client is not able to do any sponsorship of visa or C2C** 

Essential Position Responsibilities 
  • Purchase Requisition Management: Prepare, submit, and track purchase requisitions for contractor resources supporting the team’s analytical activities, ensuring requests are accurate, timely, and aligned with anticipated resource needs and established procurement processes.
  • Monthly Resource and Workload Planning: Partner regularly with consultants and project leads to gather, consolidate, and maintain monthly forecasts of contractor resource assignments, including anticipated projects, responsibilities, and estimated hours required for each resource.
  • Resource Allocation and Forecast Alignment: Establish and maintain a process to monitor contractor assignments against anticipated project needs and forecasted hours, proactively identifying and communicating potential gaps, capacity constraints, or misalignment between available resources and planned work.

Ensure updates are completed in a timely manner and properly communicated to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Identify opportunities to improve resource planning, requisition management, roster maintenance, and contractor coordination processes while ensuring adherence to applicable procurement policies, procedures, and internal controls.

Required Skills and Qualifications: 
  • BS – Business Administration or similar 
  • 3+ years of experience performing a similar role 
  • Ability to produce high-quality work products with attention to detail 
  • Ability to communicate effectively in a team environment 
  • Maintains an exceptional level of customer focus, ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize tasks. 
  • Experience in quantitative and qualitative analysis  
  • Experience using verbal and written communications skills 
  • Ability to use Microsoft Office Suite (MS-Word, MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint) 
  • Preferred:  
    • Experience with Utility/Energy operations, markets, and planning functions

job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner needed for a full-time, hybrid, contract-to-hire opportunity supporting Yoh’s well-known corporate office client based in Downtown Los Angeles, CA. 
  • Work 9:00am to 5:00pm onsite 3 days/week in Downtown LA (including alternating Wednesdays & Fridays); telemedicine on non-clinic days
  • Travel required to Century City when needed, in addition to San Diego, Orange County, and San Francisco (frequency TBD - likely monthly for SoCal and quarterly for NorCal).

This is a newly created position joining an established onsite medical clinic team that already includes a Nurse Practitioner, Physical Therapists, and Mental Health Counselors. You'll serve as the highest level of medical care for a high-performing workforce of 700+ employees. Must be comfortable working autonomously as you will likely be solo onsite, alternating with the other NP.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active Nurse Practitioner (FNP/ANP) license in state of California
  • Current prescription authority
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a provider
  • Previous experience in Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, or Family Practice

What You’ll Be Doing:

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your experience with a trusted, well-respected organization

job.title: Machine Operator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for Machine Operators for a rubber compounding facility in Elkton, MD.  You will support the batch process for rubber compounding involving weighing, mixing, and forming.  Physicals and drug screens are required in order to be eligible. 

Shift:  Rotating 12hr shifts, 6am - 6pm or 6pm -6am following a 2/3/2 rotation
Location: Elkton, MD

Responsibilities:
  • Process includes handling chemicals, polymers, and finished products like sheets and pellets. 
  • Rubber and Chemicals are staged in weigh up areas using a fork truck and a hand dolly respectively.
  • Rubber and Chemicals are weighed per work to make batches.
  • Rubber is weighed in pounds.
  • Chemicals are weighed in grams. Air Hoods are required for weighing some chemicals.
  • Operating mixers
  • Batches are discharged from the mixer and transported by sled to be formed in to Sheets or Pellets.
  • Sheets are cooled through a Ross Cooler, manually wrapped, weighed, placed on a conveyor and aut01naticaIly boxed.
  • They are manually taped and then are palletized using a box lifter.
  • Pellets are piped through the floor, cooled, screened, blended, and packed in 1 1 lb. bags or 27 lb. bags via a packing station. This is a manned station.
Requirements:
  • Must be able to sit, stand, walk, crouch, lift, and climb. 
  • Must be able to pass a drug screening and physical 
  • Position will require you to wear a supplied air hood, pulmonary physical test will be performed.

job.title: Research Associate I – Vector Engineering
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a motivated, hands-on Research Associate I to join our biotechnology client's Vector Engineering team in South San Francisco, CA.

This opportunity is ideal for an early-career scientist with demonstrated mammalian cell culture experience who can contribute quickly to established laboratory workflows supporting adeno-associated viral (AAV) vector production and therapeutic discovery programs.

Location: South San Francisco, CA
Job Type: 3–6 Month Contract
Pay Rate: $28–$38/hr DOE
Schedule: Full-Time, Onsite, Monday–Friday

Position Overview

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on mammalian cell culture experience, strong laboratory fundamentals, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to execute established protocols with limited training.

The Vector Engineering team supports AAV production for research and drug discovery. This position requires someone who is comfortable performing recurring laboratory procedures, maintaining accurate documentation, and contributing to a fast-paced research environment.

Candidates with experience in HEK293 cell culture, larger-scale mammalian cell culture systems, and transfection workflows are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the production of adeno-associated viral (AAV) vectors for research and drug discovery programs.
  • Independently perform routine mammalian cell culture activities, including media preparation, cell maintenance, monitoring, and passaging.
  • Support mammalian cell culture expansion and scale-up activities.
  • Execute established transfection, viral vector harvesting, and purification workflows following appropriate training on company-specific procedures.
  • Perform accurate serological pipetting, serial dilutions, reagent preparation, and sample handling.
  • Follow established laboratory protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs) with accuracy and consistency.
  • Maintain detailed laboratory documentation, experimental records, and sample traceability.
  • Support laboratory inventory management, reagent preparation, and equipment organization.
  • Collaborate with scientists and research associates to troubleshoot experimental challenges and improve laboratory workflows.
  • Manage multiple laboratory responsibilities while maintaining productivity, quality, and attention to detail.

Required Qualifications
  • Educational background in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Demonstrated hands-on mammalian cell culture experience through academic research or biotechnology industry work.
  • Ability to independently perform routine cell culture activities using aseptic techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with serological pipetting and accurate serial dilutions.
  • Strong laboratory fundamentals and ability to follow established protocols with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent attention to detail, laboratory documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute recurring laboratory procedures accurately and efficiently.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a research team.
  • Ability to work onsite in South San Francisco five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience culturing HEK293 or related mammalian cell lines.
  • Experience with larger-scale mammalian cell culture systems, including T225 flasks, cell factories, or suspension cultures.
  • Experience performing mammalian cell transfections.
  • Exposure to AAV production, lentiviral vectors, or gene therapy research.
  • Experience with viral vector harvesting or purification workflows.
  • Familiarity with protein purification techniques such as FPLC, TFF, depth filtration, or ultracentrifugation.
  • Experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western blotting, or SDS-PAGE.
  • Previous experience in a biotechnology startup or fast-paced research laboratory.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique?
  • Contribute directly to AAV vector production supporting innovative therapeutic research.
  • Work alongside experienced scientists in a collaborative biotechnology research environment.
  • Apply and expand existing mammalian cell culture skills while gaining exposure to specialized viral vector production techniques.
  • Develop experience with transfection, vector harvesting, purification, and research-scale production workflows.
  • Join a team that values strong technical execution, initiative, attention to detail, and scientific curiosity.

Contract Details: This is a 3–6 month contract assignment. There is no guaranteed conversion to permanent employment. Future opportunities may be considered depending on business needs.

If you are a detail-oriented Research Associate with hands-on mammalian cell culture experience and an interest in viral vector production, we encourage you to apply.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Fairfield & Redding, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines

  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact

job.description:
Mid-Level Automotive Technician – PM Shift
12:00PM-9:00PM.

Looking for an auto technician to support a self-driving car initiative. This will be focused on general documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general maintenance. The individual should have a general understanding of drivetrains in order to identify and investigate problems.

Scope:
• Solid experience tinkering with vehicles.
• Navigate databases to find repair modules and follow processes/procedures while keeping documentation on results.
• Work with OEM tooling/base car tooling, and have an understanding of how to work with it, read diagnostics, etc.

Required:
• Auto technician experience – Automotive, robotics, aerospace, etc.
• Strong electrical experience as well as strong fabrication abilities.
• Experience working in a shop and maintaining cleanliness, managing inventory, etc.
• Comfortable working in a team environment and leading others. This is NOT a solo position.

• Strong documentation abilities - Creating repair orders stating the diagnosis, the procedures performed, the parts required, etc.

Pluses:
• Autonomous vehicle background.
• Experience with auto mechanics, repair, and maintenance.
• Experience with sensors and calibration.

job.title: Per-Diem Corporate Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Corporate Health Registered Nurse needed for an ongoing per-diem contract opportunity with Yoh’s corporate office client located in Plano & Fort Worth, TX.
*Must be able to cover both locations, depending on the need. Plano is the biggest location so likely will be there more.
 

This job is only on an as-needed basis with the schedule typically made in advance, but we are looking for flexibility to cover call-outs too. Must be able to work 0 to 5 shifts per week between Monday and Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm. Average is a couple of shifts a month. The clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative care for employees of a corporate office.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of Texas
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Prior experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, Corrections, or School Nursing type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Professional, dedicated, friendly, and helpful employee

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Travel health consultation, health coaching, and health education
  • Provide medical testing/biometric screenings such as EKGs, pulmonary function, phlebotomy, blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol, vision and hearing screening and perform limited interpretation of tests
  • Immunizations
  • Respond to emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed (assist First Responders)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • MUST HAVE A FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE between Monday and Friday, 7:30am - 4:30pm - this position is to cover for when full-time staff need time off of work so the schedule is very infrequent
  • BLS certified
  • Computer savvy (including prior EMR use)
  • Passionate about promoting health and wellbeing in the workplace
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time, go up and down multiple flights of stairs, and do a lot of fast-walking

What’s In It For You?

  • Gain experience working at a well-established company with a prestigious reputation
  • Great way to make extra $$$ with a flexible day shift schedule
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

             Must be able to commit to the full 3-month (may extend past 3 months) entirety of the assignment

job.title: Histotechnician II
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Histotechnologist II in Austin, TX. This role will support a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory focused on thyroid FNA specimens and requires strong hands-on histology experience, microtomy skills, and the ability to work independently in a collaborative lab environment. HT/HTL certification is strongly preferred, along with 3–4+ years of histology experience. The Histology Technician II performs routine and non-routine activities involved in the preparation of slides for microscopic examination by pathologists. Core duties include sample management specific to site operations, performing staining procedures, equipment maintenance, sample capture, and/or supporting digital pathology. The role requires proficiency in all aspects of microtomy, ensuring compliance with state and national regulatory standards, and effective collaboration with laboratory teams, pre-analytical staff, and pathologists. Flexibility in scheduling and section assignments is essential to meet laboratory needs.

Title: Histotechnologist II
Location: Austin, TX
Pay Range: $41–$44/hr
Shift: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:30 PM

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Prepares microscopic slides for diagnostic purposes, including processing, embedding, microtomy, and/or mounting of paraffin-embedded samples.
  • Assists in training new personnel and may perform competency assessment.
  • Responsible for specimen reconciling, sample return, sample capture, and ensuring quality throughout the pre-analytical processes; other duties as assigned, (if performed at the specific laboratory location).
  • Performs and quality review of routine H&E staining.
  • Recut blocks as requested by the Pathologist in a manner that meets TAT and quality expectations.
  • Maintains histology equipment per laboratory Standard Operating Procedures and manufacturer recommendations.
  • Files paraffin blocks and microscope slides; pulls slides/ blocks from storage, as requested.
  • Prepares and monitors solutions and reagents for the automated stainers.
  • Participates in projects, research, and validation activities as assigned.
  • Restocks the laboratory to ensure appropriate inventory levels as maintained to meet workload.
  • Maintains equipment and quality records in a manner that meets laboratory and compliance standards; ensures records are accurate and available for audits and review.
  • Must be able to troubleshoot areas of processing, microtomy, staining and equipment.
  • Performs and documents scheduled preventative maintenance.
  • Understands and follows all safety guidelines.
  • Participates in all continuing education programs required to keep certification current, if applicable.
  • Must be able to flex schedule to accommodate workload, including weekend coverage.
  • Respects and maintains the confidentiality of information relative to clients and patients.
  • Compliant with company policies, procedures, safety requirements quality systems, and regulations.
  • May perform other assigned duties as directed by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor's degree preferred
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in a histology laboratory required, including microtomy and H&E staining
  • Knowledge of CLIA, New York, CAP and OSHA regulatory requirements
  • HT(ASCP) or HTL(ASCP) certification
#IND-SPG

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a Quality Control Inspector for a client in Reno, NV. In this hands-on role, we are looking for candidates with experience in quality inspection, and warehouse operations.  Candidates with experience in medical device manufacturing are preferred. This position combines quality inspection with hands-on warehouse support. You’ll inspect incoming materials and work in progress, maintain accurate records, and help keep materials and finished products moving through the operation. If you enjoy detailed work and variety in your day, this role offers exposure to quality, assembly, and inventory activities within a medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite in Reno, NV
Pay: $23-$25/hr
Type: COntract-to-hire

What You’ll Do:
  • Inspect products during manufacturing to support consistent quality.
  • Perform receiving inspections on incoming raw materials.
  • Capture inspection results and maintain accurate quality control records.
  • Help develop and improve quality control processes.
  • Learn assembly processes and provide production support as needed.
  • Keep purchase orders and related records organized and accessible.
  • Maintain an organized warehouse and control raw material storage and handling.
  • Prepare, package, and ship finished products.
  • Complete inventory counts and keep inventory records accurate.
  • Follow quality system requirements and good documentation practices throughout daily work.

Experience That Can Help You Succeed:
  • Background in medical device manufacturing.
  • Must have experience with and knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems.
  • Experience inspecting incoming materials, in-process products, and finished goods.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints.
  • Familiarity with precision inspection tools, including calipers, micrometers, and microscopes.
  • Experience recognizing and documenting nonconforming materials or products.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory control and warehouse activities.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing records and accurate production documentation.
  • Experience using ERP, electronic quality management, or similar business systems.
  • English/Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.

job.title: Certified Athletic Trainer
job.description:
Certified Athletic Trainer needed for a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with Yoh's occupational health clinic client located in Blue Springs, MS. Start as soon as possible. New graduates are encouraged to apply!

This position is located at a manufacturing company with an onsite clinic that provides occupational, primary, and preventive care services for employees. The Athletic Trainer will support approximately 10-15 patients through routine wellness and injury-prevention touchpoints. You will work alongside the clinical team to provide injury prevention, first aid, general wellness services, and health promotion. This role also includes non-appointment-based activities on the production floor, evaluating the physical demands of job tasks, and leading group fitness, stretching, and educational classes.

Schedule:
Monday-Friday, 6:00 AM-2:30 PM
(Second opening available: 2:30 PM-11:00 PM)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) - BOC Certified
  • Current Mississippi Athletic Trainer License
  • Experience in occupational health and safety; knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred
  • Experience with ergonomics preferred
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement an early intervention program by performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examinations, providing first aid in accordance with OSHA standards, and educating employees on injury prevention
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies
  • Lead group and individual training sessions focused on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs
  • Collaborate with onsite medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation
  • Participate in meetings and task forces
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited Athletic Training Education Program
  • Active BLS/CPR certification (hands-on courses only)
  • Current annual TB screening (PPD or QuantiFERON Gold test)
  • Passion for promoting health and well-being in the workplace
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
What's In It for You?:
  • Excellent work-life balance with predictable hours and no weekends or holidays
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment where you can make a real difference in keeping workers safe, healthy, and productive
  • Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company that prioritizes collaboration

--> Shifts are Monday-Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm.
--> Job is anticipating to be an ongoing contract position. Potential for longevity!

  • Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT)
  • At least one year of medical front office experience as well as blood draw experience

job.title: Engineering Technician
job.description:
Engineering Technician  
 
Engineering technicians are responsible for partnering closely with their engineering counterparts to design and build test assets including vehicles and benches. The team is responsible for leading the integration of sensors and computers for next generation automated driving systems into the development vehicle and test bench platforms.

What you’ll do:
- Build harnesses for vehicles and benches
- Build subassemblies for use on vehicles and test benches
- Perform vehicle teardowns to prepare for upfit with development hardware installation
- Perform vehicle modifications such as drilling added holes and cutting openings in fascia
- Assemble development hardware onto vehicles
- Build rack mounted bench setups with development hardware
- Work with engineering counterparts on hand-off of new test assets and troubleshooting any issues

What you'll need to succeed:
- Associate’s degree with two years of employment experience or a High School Diploma or GED equivalent with four years of employment experience is required.
- Expertise as a vehicle, mechanical, or electrical technician
- Electrical and mechanical skills for vehicle and bench builds
- Strong attention to detail. Follow all steps of detailed instruction docs and ensure repeatable end product.
- Willingness and mindset to ask critical questions and provide feedback to the engineering teams
- Puts safety first, taking proactive steps to minimize risk in all work and ensure any concerns are resolved
- Continuous improvement mindset developing and implementing ideas to improve the work environment and processes
- Teamwork and strong cross-functional communication skills are essential

Nice to have (optional):
- History working closely with engineering teams
- Experience building harnesses

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, ADAS/AV
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer, ADAS/AV

About You
You are a strong systems thinker and software engineer who enjoys designing, developing and solving complex problems across large-scale ADAS software platforms. You are comfortable working across components, platform, validation, simulation, and infrastructure teams to improve software quality, reliability, and release readiness.
You take ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, use data and engineering judgments to identify systemic issues, and drive improvements through software, automation, tooling, and process enhancements. You have a solid foundation in software development and system integration, along with a passion for building scalable solutions that improve engineering efficiency and product quality.
You thrive in a fast paced, collaborative environment and enjoy working across organizational boundaries to solve problems that span multiple software components and teams. You are motivated by building reliable software platforms, improving developer productivity, and enabling high quality releases throughout the software development lifecycle.
If you are passionate about ADAS software, platform engineering, and creating scalable solutions that improve software reliability from development through production, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain platform software, engineering tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that improve software quality, scalability, and developer productivity.
  • Drive software quality, reliability, and release readiness across the ADAS platform through software development, automation, validation, and data-driven engineering practices.
  • Define and evolve test and validation strategies across unit, integration, system, simulation, and vehicle-level testing.
  • Identify gaps in software quality, validation coverage, and platform capabilities, and develop solutions to address them.
  • Develop and integrate automated validation, qualification, and reliability checks into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
  • Analyze software defects, integration issues, and field/customer problems to identify root causes and drive long-term corrective actions.
  • Analyze dependencies across software components and identify risks that may impact system integration, performance, reliability, and release quality.
  • Define and track software quality metrics, reliability KPIs, and release readiness indicators to drive continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with software, architecture, validation, simulation, infrastructure, and release engineering teams to improve end-to-end software quality and development efficiency.
  • Support software integration across multiple ECUs, middleware components, and vehicle platforms.
  • Apply V-Model principles and modern software engineering practices to improve traceability from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, validation, and release.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and development workflows based on lessons learned, test results, and operational data.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development, automotive software, platform engineering, or software reliability.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, Python, and scripting languages such as Bash.
  • Experience designing, developing, integrating, and qualifying production-quality software for complex embedded systems on Linux/QNX/RTOS Platforms.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, component interfaces, dependency management, debugging, root-cause analysis, and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience analyzing dependencies and interactions across software components, identifying integration risks, and preventing system-level regressions.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

job.title: Electronic/Electro-Mechanical Assembler
job.description:
Yoh is hiring Electronic/Electro-Mechanical Assemblers for a contract opportunity with our client L3Harris located in Henrietta, NY.
Payrate $18.50 - $24.98



Job Summary: We are seeking Electronic/Electro-Mechanical Assembler to perform a variety of assembly operations, including both manual and automated tasks. The role involves interpreting technical specifications and documents, and following established methods for wiring, component installation, hand soldering, and cable harnessing.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform electronic and electro-mechanical assembly operations.
  • Interpret and comprehend technical specifications, terms, and documents.
  • Follow methods and sequences for wiring, component installation, hand soldering, and cable harnessing.
  • Identify and resolve straightforward problems and issues.
  • Work under general supervision with moderate peer review.
  • Work on smaller, less structured tasks.
  • Must be able to stand the entire shift

Education & Experience:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or 2 years post-Secondary/associate’s degree with 0 to 2 years of related experience.
  • All offers are contingent to passing all pre-employment screenings/ drug testing this includes testing negative for marijuana.
 
Shifts & Payrates
 
  • 1st Shift: Monday – Thursday 5am- 3:30pm@ $18.50
  • 2nd Shift: Monday –Thursday 3:30pm –2am @ $ 20.35
  • 3rd Shift: Friday, Saturday & Sunday 6am -6:30pm @ $23.13
  • 4th Shift: Friday, Saturday & Sunday 6pm-6:30am @ $ 24.98
  • Must attend a 2 week Training Program Mon-Fri from 7am-3:30pm 



Patty Martin/ patricia.martin@yoh.com

job.title: NE Administrative Operations & Support Manager
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Administrative Operations & Support Manager opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
They will be required to assist in making sure that Yoh employees enter their time as required.
Have knowledge of HR process and procedures and work with Yoh HR and Employee Relations.

job.title: VP - Business Operations & Strategy
job.description:
VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 5-8+ years in management consulting, strategy & transformation, or high-intensity business environments
  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and lead initiatives end-to-end
  • Experience with M&A integration, multi-unit operations, or platform environments is advantageous
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capabilities
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools for strategic work is a plus
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Prior exposure to hospitality, travel, or private equity sectors
  • Fluency in deploying innovative operating models and process improvements
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with disciplined execution
Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or similar qualification is highly preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years in strategy, management consulting, or operational leadership roles
  • Experience driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives
Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to travel approximately 25-35% to support integration and strategic initiatives
  • Passion for building and scaling innovative platforms with high ownership and impact mindset
If you’re ready to lead transformative change at an exciting, fast-growing company and want to make a meaningful impact in the travel and hospitality industry, we invite you to apply now. Embark on a career journey that combines strategic vision with operational excellence—your next big opportunity awaits!

job.title: Fraud Operations Manager
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Senior Manager, Fraud Operations to join our Financial Technology client in the Mountain View/Palo Alto area of California.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports initially. The ideal candidate brings deep fraud expertise and is comfortable building a program while personally managing investigations and daily casework.

Title: Senior Manager, Fraud Operations
Compensation: $160,000–$180,000 annual base salary, depending on experience and qualifications
Type: Full-Time / Direct Hire, Exempt
Location: Mountain View/Palo Alto area, CA
Work Arrangement: Onsite with limited hybrid flexibility; not remote
Industry: Financial Technology / Banking and Payments
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k)
Reports To: Chief Compliance Officer

Responsibilities
  • Establish fraud prevention and investigation processes for consumer and business deposit accounts.
  • Review alerts, investigate suspicious activity, and prepare documented referrals in coordination with the BSA Officer and sponsor-bank partners.
  • Adjust detection rules and thresholds using loss trends, false positives, and customer impact to guide improvements.
  • Oversee disputes, chargebacks, claims, and recovery efforts, including applicable deadlines, provisional credits, and customer communications.
  • Develop procedures, quality controls, and executive reporting; support audits, examinations, and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate across business and technology teams to improve fraud tools and workflows, support fraud-related due diligence, and address urgent escalations.
Qualifications
  • 10+ years of direct fraud experience across strategy, detection, and investigations within financial services or technology.
  • Strong understanding of consumer and business account fraud, including payment fraud, account takeover, identity manipulation, first-party fraud, and scams.
  • Practical experience configuring fraud detection systems, developing rules, adjusting thresholds, and managing investigation cases.
  • Knowledge of BSA/AML, OFAC sanctions, Regulation E, NACHA, UCC Article 4A, and card-network requirements.
  • Experience coordinating with bank partners or BSA teams and supporting audits or regulatory reviews.
  • Ability to work independently in a startup environment, establish new processes, and communicate findings and recommendations to executives.
  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Mandarin or Cantonese proficiency
Preferred: Experience building a fintech fraud function within a sponsor-bank model; CFE, CAMS, CFCS, or comparable certification; international payments experience; SQL or business intelligence skills; and team leadership experience.

Interested in learning more? Please apply with your updated resume.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available during the hiring process and employment. Employment is subject to a job-related background review conducted in accordance with applicable law, including applicable fair-chance requirements.

job.title: Nurse Practitioner-Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract Job opportunity with one of Yoh’s prodigious clients located in Macungie, PA.

Hours:  Monday -Friday 12 pm-8 pm & 6:30 am-2:30 (varying schedule)

What You’ll Do:
  • Provide on-site services forty (40) hours per week.
  • Triage and treat, as appropriate, work-related and non-work-related injuries and illnesses.
  • Dispense over the counter and prescription medications in accordance with pre-established standing orders to employees with work-related and non-work-related injuries/illnesses
  • Provide on-site specimen/lab collection for employees presenting lab orders from their PCP.
  • Perform urine drug screening and breath alcohol testing in accordance with
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purpose of reducing illness and absenteeism.
  • Coordinate second opinions for employees absent due to workers’ compensation or disability
  • Assist, coordinate and plan monthly health education seminars and general wellness events.
  • Provide onsite patient education regarding illnesses/injuries, medication, treatments, stretching etc.
  • Provide referrals for employees who need the attention of a primary care physician or specialist in adherence with company protocols.
  • Work collaboratively with patients and their PCP/Specialist to facilitate early diagnosis and management of acute and chronic health problems.
  • Perform on-site physical assessments (DOT, return to work, work-related injuries)
 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Successful completion of an accredited Nurse Practitioner program.
  • Current licensure and certification by the Pennsylvania Board of Nursing or Physicians.
  • National Board Certification.
  • At least 2 years of adult medicine experience.
  • Strong clinical evaluation, patient education, and case management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in Occupational Medicine, Workers’ Compensation, or DOT exams.
  • Certifications such as DOT Medical Examiner, Urine Drug Screen Collector, or Breath Alcohol Technician.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nursing.
  • Previous experience in occupational health settings or corporate health clinics.

job.title: Licensed Psychologist
job.description:
Licensed Psychologist needed for a full-time, DIRECT HIRE opportunity with Yoh’s non-profit client located in San Jose, CA. We have multiple openings available with a choice of part-time or full-time hours!! Additional openings available in Salinas, CA.

Work at a company that is committed to specializing in supporting individuals with developmental disabilities (and their families). Provide psychological assessments, behavioral consultations, and clinical support as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active Psychologist license in state of California
  • At least two years of experience with developmental disabilities or behavioral health
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical documentation skills
  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, techniques, and materials of psychology in serving the developmentally disabled

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Evaluate cognitive and adaptive functioning, develop behavior support plans, and offer guidance to clients, families, and staff to promote independence and quality of life
  • Assist in matters related to psychology, specifically to the provision of comprehensive services to people with developmental disabilities
  • Participate as teacher/consultant to personnel involved in the development and delivery of services to people with developmental disabilities
  • Assist in the development of new programs where need arises and in the ongoing evaluation of programs for the developmentally disabled within the region
  • Perform other related duties as assigned (ie conservatorship petitions and competency to stand trial evaluations, and diverse plans)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Ability to work 8am to 5pm shifts between Monday and Friday
  • Doctorate in Clinical or Educational Psychology
  • Use of an automobile, possession of a valid driver's license, and automobile liability insurance for the minimum amount prescribed by law or the ability to provide independent transportation

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with flexible schedule options (Monday through Friday highly desired!)
  • Telecommute opportunity available within first 6 months!
  • Work with a well-established, mission-driven non-profit known for quality focused care
  • Meaningful work and great for someone passionate about person-centered care, advocacy, and community impact
  • Excellent benefit packages including FREE medical coverage along with free dental and vision insurance for dependents, longevity Bonus incentive, CalPERS pension plan plus 403(b) retirement plan, 5 days of paid education leave per fiscal year, generous amount of PTO, and more!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care places health care professionals on jobs nationwide, including occupational/employee health and case management/managed care services at well-known Fortune 500 companies! Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest openings!

job.title: Fleet Compliance Documentation Management
job.description:
Fleet Compliance and Materials Coordinator
The AV Compliance Fleet team is seeking a highly organized and reliable specialist to support vehicle registration, compliance documentation, materials coordination, and fleet operations in Mountain View. This six-month assignment requires work from the Mountain View office five days per week, with frequent travel to the Industry Business Center and FedEx locations.

Scope:
• Prepare and assemble vehicle registration packets and supporting documentation.
• Transport registration materials to the Industry Business Center for processing.
• Retrieve completed documents, permits, and license plates.
• Log, organize, and track all materials and registration activity.
• Package and ship completed materials to designated offices.
• Maintain accurate records, trackers, and status updates.
• Coordinate deadlines and follow-ups across fleet, compliance, and operations teams.
• Support additional documentation, materials coordination, and fleet compliance activities.
• Use Google Workspace tools, including Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Docs.
• Safeguard all documents, permits, license plates, and related materials.
• Travel frequently between Mountain View, the Industry Business Center, and FedEx locations.

Required:
• Experience in project coordination, materials coordination, compliance, fleet operations, document control, or a related field.
• Exceptional organization, attention to detail, reliability, and trustworthiness.
• Experience managing documents, deadlines, trackers, and multiple priorities.
• Proficiency with Google Workspace.
• Strong communication and follow-up skills.
• Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
• Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally.
• Ability to work 30–40 hours per week for six months.

Pluses:
• Vehicle registration, DMV, fleet compliance, or permit experience.
• Experience with shipping, FedEx, inventory, or materials intake.
• Experience working with government agencies or external processing centers.
• Automotive, autonomous vehicle, transportation, or mobility industry experience.
• Prior senior materials coordination, operations coordination, or project support experience.

job.title: Licensed Mental Health Clinician
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Licensed Mental Health Clinician for a contract assignment with a respected client located in Newark, NJ. The Clinician will deliver comprehensive behavioral health services to students, including intake assessments, individual and group therapy, crisis response services, and evaluations to assess mental health risks and support student well-being.

**NJ Applicable Licenses: LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or Licensed Psychologist

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 month contract with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $40-62/hr DOE

  • Diagnoses and assesses counseling and treatment needs and conducts crisis assessments, interventions, and management for distressed students

  • Requires knowledge and experience of psychotherapy, the ability to operate within systems, and the ability to develop a database of viable and appropriate mental health resources for various levels of care (e.g. outpatient, inpatient, intensive outpatient, etc)
  • Provides ethical and responsible treatment of students by prioritizing completing administrative tasks, including intake assessments, treatment plan reviews, progress notes, crisis notes, and discharge summaries
  • Engages with the campus community including providing outreach, consultation, and educational services as requested.

  • Master’s Degree in mental health discipline plus two (2) years post Master’s experience in the mental health field including delivering psychotherapeutic services to the identified population, or a Doctorate Degree.

job.description:
Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s Primary Care located in Windsor, WI. This clinic provides care to patients ages 2+. Clinical knowledge and experience in primary care, acute care, and occupational health are expected with an ability to provide comprehensive, patient-centered care across a variety of healthcare needs. Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills as well as exceptional customer service is a top priority, with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, respectful, and positive patient experience.
 
Schedule: Mon, Tues 6:30a-4:30p, Wed, Thurs 11a-7p, Fri 8a-12p
Duration: 1/4/27-5/5/27 with training in mid December (PTO coverage)
Pay: $55-70/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Educates and coaches nursing staff on best nursing practices.
  • May require other duties as assigned.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • All nurse practitioner licenses/certificates to practice
  • Current national certification (ANCC or AANP required)
  • Master Degree in Science of Nursing (if Master Degree in Science certificate does not state Nursing on it then a copy of transcripts is required)
  • BLS certification
  • Some experience in urgent care, primary care, emergency, occupational health or related is required
What’s In It For You?
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities.
  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll
 
APPLY NOW!
Recruiter: Laura Mopas

job.title: Assembler
job.description:
Assembler

Join a dynamic team dedicated to precision and excellence as an Assembler, where your skills contribute directly to the safety and reliability of aircraft instruments used worldwide. In this role, you’ll work on the assembly and final testing of innovative avionics and aircraft components, ensuring each product meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Your meticulous attention to detail and mechanical aptitude will play a vital part in keeping pilots and passengers safely flying.

Required Skills:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of two years’ electronics education, training, or equivalent experience
  • At least one year of hands-on assembly experience with avionic equipment such as pressure gauges, batteries, and inverters
  • Proficiency with hand tools and electronic testing equipment
  • Solid understanding of advanced analog and digital electronics
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven mindset
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
Nice to Have Skills:

  • PCB soldering proficiency (training available if needed)
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED, supplemented by at least two years of electronics training or equivalent work experience
  • One or more years specifically in avionic assembly
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks with high precision
  • Good eye-hand coordination and dexterity
  • Physical ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs occasionally
  • Comfort with handling small objects and using fine tools like screwdrivers, tweezers, and wire cutters
If you’re passionate about contributing to high-quality aerospace manufacturing and thrive in a detail-oriented environment, we want to hear from you! Take the next step in your career—apply today and help keep the world flying safe!
