job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer
12 month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Plano, TX (Hybrid – Local candidates only)
 
Position Overview
This role will focus on CI/CD enablement, site reliability engineering, observability, incident management, and operational readiness for critical technology platforms.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines, along with a solid understanding of production operations, monitoring, incident response, and software development practices.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, enhance, and support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and related DevOps tools.
  • Improve deployment automation, release processes, and engineering workflows.
  • Support site reliability engineering initiatives focused on system availability, performance, and resilience.
  • Develop and maintain observability solutions, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards.
  • Help ensure applications and platforms are prepared for on-call support and production operations.
  • Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and service restoration.
  • Support the Technology Operations Center (TOC) during production incidents and operational events.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, infrastructure teams, and other technology partners.
  • Contribute to automation and process improvements that increase operational efficiency.
  • Use software engineering principles to troubleshoot issues and improve tools and platforms.
  • Work within an IDE and demonstrate familiarity with modern software development workflows.
  • Document procedures, technical solutions, operational standards, and lessons learned.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Strong experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins.
  • Experience with SRE practices and production reliability.
  • Experience with observability tools, monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance analysis.
  • Experience supporting on-call readiness and production operations.
  • Experience with incident management and troubleshooting in enterprise environments.
  • Some programming or scripting experience.
  • Familiarity with software development tools and integrated development environments (IDEs).
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting large-scale financial services or enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience with Technology Operations Centers or similar production support organizations.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, cloud platforms, or containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with release management, change management, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Experience participating in post-incident reviews and implementing corrective actions.

job.title: Program Director – EPMO
job.description:
Unlock the power to shape strategic impact and drive enterprise success as our Program Director – EPMO. Join a dynamic team during a pivotal growth phase, partnering with senior leadership to elevate execution standards and deliver measurable results that matter.

Overview
As Program Director – EPMO, you will lead critical enterprise programs, translating strategic priorities into actionable, cross-functional initiatives.  This role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise-wide delivery excellence, shape governance practices, and partner with top leaders in a remote setting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business owners to develop visibility into enterprise initiatives, tracking progress, risks, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
  • Lead the execution of complex, cross-functional programs from concept through delivery, ensuring milestones and KPIs are met.
  • Identify and resolve execution barriers proactively, promoting continuous improvement and outcome-based delivery.
  • Drive governance and reporting routines, facilitating reviews, decision-making meetings, and maintaining transparency into program health.
  • Support the evolution of the EPMO's capabilities, processes, and tools to sustain high standards of execution discipline.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in program, transformation, or enterprise business operations.
  • Proven record leading large, complex initiatives with measurable business impact.
  • Strong ability to influence senior leaders and align diverse teams toward common goals.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and executive communication skills.
  • Proficiency with program management tools and reporting practices.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent; advanced certification or degrees preferred.
Bring your strategic expertise and drive transformative outcomes—apply now to make a meaningful impact.

job.title: Multi Family AHP Analyst
job.description:
Are you an affordable housing professional with experience in LIHTC and multifamily real estate? We are seeking an experienced Multi-Family AHP Analyst for a long-term hybrid contract opportunity in Irving, TX. This role offers the chance to apply your financial analysis, affordable housing, and compliance expertise while supporting the evaluation, funding, and ongoing monitoring of multifamily affordable housing projects.

For immediate consideration send resumes to:
Melissa W. Werner, Principal Recruiter, Yoh Staffing, melissa.werner@yoh.com

BASIC PURPOSE
Responsibilities include the evaluation, underwriting, selection and compliance of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) applications; technical assistance to member institutions and community organizations concerning the Affordable Housing Program as well as the Community Investment Program; review, analyze and process requests for grant funds from member institutions and community organizations and assist in preparation of departmental marketing materials. Ensure compliance of AHP projects to the program rules and regulations. Hi

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Analyze AHP Rental and Owner-Occupied disbursement requests to ensure all required documentation is in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies and procedures. Make approval/denial recommendations for funding to AHP General Fund Manager.
  • Participates in the analysis, review, and selection of Affordable General Fund Housing program applications. 
  • Provide technical assistance to member institutions, non-profit organizations and community/government leaders on the features and uses of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Interacts with other analysts on complex issues regarding applications, modifications, fundings and monitoring.
  • Analyze complex multi-family rental project disbursements to ensure project is viable for funding, as assigned. 
  • Review and approve HELP, SNAP and AHP owner-occupied disbursements request when designated.
  • Perform the compliance review of AHP rental projects to ensure that AHP compliance requirements are being met. (Income targeting and rent compliance)
  • Provide the management team with updates and status reports on project completion/modification, as assigned. Make recommendations concerning the continued viability of said projects.
  • Analyze and review project status reports and other information to ensure that projects are in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies. 
  • Up to 10% travel required to participate in various speaking engagements and promotional appearances (local, state-wide, regional, or national).
  • Develop a working knowledge of the Bank's other products and services, especially those offered by the Community Investment Department.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of local, state, and national programs that are involved in financing affordable housing development; provide assistance and update policies and procedures to ensure effective administration of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Perform user acceptance and validation testing and maintenance of internal systems and applications.  Ensure implementation is in compliance with department internal controls, policies and procedures, FHFA regulations and Bank policy.
  • Participate in the planning and organizing of the AHP workshops and webinars.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc activities in support of the operational needs of the department. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  •  
JOB  REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Public Policy, Urban Planning. A master’s in public administration preferred.
  • 4-6 years financial analysis and credit underwriting experience associated with commercial real estate/multi-family properties, housing development, commercial finance or other demonstrated affordable housing experience. 
  • Completion of major corporate bank credit training or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Acrobat and Word.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel and/or make presentations at Bank and industry functions, workshop, conferences, etc.
  • Grow America (fka the National Development Council) or other comparable professional housing certification preferred.

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (ANP/FNP) or Physician Assistant (PA-C) license in state of Wisconsin
  • Minimum of (3) years' experience at a provider level
  • Previous experience in: Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Orthopedics, Family Practice, or Critical Care type setting
  • Must be confident with drawing blood

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Medical surveillance: hearing conservation (audiometry exams), spirometry, drug testing, phlebotomy, etc.
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty) and coordinate treatment planning
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Provide onsite testing for strep pharyngitis, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia
  • Work collaboratively to recognize environmental hazards and/or stresses in or from the workplace that may cause sickness, impaired health, or discomfort among the workers; create preventative measures that ensure the health and safety of employees
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purposes of reducing illness and absenteeism
  • Provide proactive and mobile engagement with the workforce from a prevention standpoint; seek out interactions with employees and build relationships
  • Respond to medical emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Nationally Certified (ANCC or AANP) or NCCP
  • Current BLS
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing certified (CAOHC/COHC)
  • Certified Drug Test Collector/Certified DOT Specimen Collector
  • Computer skills with previous experience using EMR and MS Office products
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interview, teach and counsel patients and interact with multidisciplinary team members (EHS, HR, Medical Director)
  • Must be able to meet the physical demands of onsite work needs; ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds, frequent standing, walking, sitting, squatting

job.title: Materials Coordinator - SF/PM Monday - Friday
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - SF: Monday - Friday. 2PM-10PM.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements, and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive parts specialist, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Experienced in positions such as – parts advisor, parts specialist, inventory technician, materials handlers, parts coordinator, etc.
• Experience with a DMS (Dealer Management System) – CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, etc. (SAP experience would be great but not required).
• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

Estimated Max Rate: $30/hr+. Depends on work experience

job.title: Athletic Trainer (Licensed)
job.description:
Athletic Trainer needed for a permanent opportunity with Yoh’s automobile client located in Georgetown, KY at their Occupational Health clinic. Accepting new grads-ATs with extensive experience!
 
This clinic focuses on the prevention aspect of injuries versus the acute care following an injury. The AT will be responsible for 10-15 open cases as well as non-patient appointment-based activities on the production floor examining the physical demands of jobs.  The AT may also be leading group-based fitness, stretching, or educational classes.
 
Schedule: 2nd shift 2:30p-11p
Type: Direct hire, permanent placement to start ASAP
Salary: $30-40/hr with flexibility depending on experience

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement early intervention program consisting of performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examination, providing first aid per OSHA standards and education on injury prevention  
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies  
  • Lead group and individual training on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs  
  • Collaborate with on-site medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures  
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner  
  • Maintains patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date record  
  • Participate in meetings and task forces  
  • Other duties as assigned  
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited professional Athletic Training education program
  • Current BOC Certified Athletic Trainer
  • Current certification with hands-on training in AHA, ARC or equivalent Basic Life Support for health care providers is required; Advanced Cardiac Life Support may also be required based on contract scope of services
  • Certification and experience in Ergonomics preferred
  • Experience in Occupational Health and Safety; Knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred

job.title: Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant  needed for contract work opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Winchester, VA.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
Hours: 9am-1 pm  Monday-Friday

What You’ll Be Doing:
Dress code is either scrubs or business casual with lab coat.

Essential Functions: 
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Educates and coaches nursing staff on best nursing practices.
  • May require other duties as assigned.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • At least three years of clinical experience as a Nurse Practitioner in ambulatory care, occupational health, family practice, or emergency department setting.
  • Advanced Degree from an Accredited Physician Assistant Program of Study. Active and unrestricted Physician Assistant license in the appropriate state.
  • All nurse practitioner licenses/certificates to practice
  • State Prescriptive Authority (if applicable)

  • Current national certification (ANCC or AANP required)

Total on-line courses will not be accepted. Course must also meet the American Heart Association (AHA) standards but need not be an AHA certificate.

job.title: Equipment Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring an Equipment Maintenance Technician for our biopharmaceutical customer in the Greater Philadelphia Region.  You will be a critical member responsible for performing preventative maintenance, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of GMP manufacturing equipment, laboratory equipment, facility systems, and supporting utilities. This hands-on role ensures equipment reliability, regulatory compliance, and operational readiness to support clinical and commercial manufacturing operations.

Location: Bristol, PA 
Pay: $80-105k DOE
Duration: FTE
Shift: M-F days with some weekend availability as needed
 

Responsibilities:
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control systems line diagrams and prints 
  • Familiarity with servicing of equipment consisting of boilers, chillers, air compressors, deionized water generation, HVAC, piping distribution systems, generators, GMP suite maintenance, and building maintenance/upkeep 
  • Support the daily Facilities and Engineering work flow through escorting and supervising contractors/vendors, performing equipment moves, handling equipment deliveries, transferring equipment/materials between offsite storage, and other tasks as assigned 
  • Perform corrective maintenance and emergency repairs to minimize equipment downtime. 
  • Follow Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and cGMP requirements when documenting maintenance activities. 
  • Support equipment purchases such as uncrating, moving, installing, and connecting required plant utilities to the point of use 
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and process equipment failures. 
  • Work may include systems repairs/modifications encompassing HVAC, VFD’s, piping/plumbing, lighting, flooring, drywall, grounds, painting, and other areas that are not noted 
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are performed safely and in accordance with OSHA, environmental, and company safety requirements. 
  • Support shutdown activities, equipment relocations, facility projects, and capital improvement initiatives. 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to support manufacturing and facility operations outside normal business hours. 
  • Maintain F&E owned areas and ability to perform work in accordance with site expectations and pharmaceutical industry standards 

Qualifications:
  • 1-3 years minimum experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, research, or equivalent highly regulated environment. 
  • Supported maintenance activities within utility areas, labs, and classified cleanrooms with following gowning procedures and safety protocols 
  • Supporting electrical/mechanical/facility installation projects 
  • Experience with BMS/EMS systems 
  • Experience using CMMS systems such as Blue Mountain, Maximo, Qualer, or equivalent 
  • Strong electrical and mechanical capabilities/aptitude 
  • Work collaboratively and productively across multiple site departments 
  • Associate degree in Mechanical Technology, Electrical technology, Mechatronics, or related technical discipline

job.description:
SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER - HYBRID IN SAN MATEO OR SAN DIEGO

*CANDIDATES MUST BE ABLE TO WORK DIRECTLY ON A W2 WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP. NO C2C!!
  • 6 month contract 
  • $100-120/hr on W2 
Why PlayStation?
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, PlayStation™Now, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.
 
About The Role:
PlayStation Global Program Management Office drives delivery of highly impactful program solutions worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager with a strong player-focused mindset and a proven track record of delivering software and driving results that support player needs, business goals, and organizational priorities. This role will be responsible for driving programs and projects from inception through deployment over a worldwide scale. The candidate will successfully partner with a globally distributed cross-functional team (product engineering, product management, business operations, marketing, consumer support, legal, finance) to ensure product and operational readiness for market delivery.
 
You will bring your expertise to deliver complex programs by demonstrating excellent planning, execution, partner, risk and dependency management skills. You will be hands on to tackle challenges, an advocate and the biggest supporter for the program organization.
 
What You'll Do:
  • Own and drive end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic and complex cross-regional, cross-functional initiatives with multi-level dependencies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop full program plans including timelines, dependencies, risk factors, success criteria, and outcomes, while keeping them energized and focused on delivering priority programs
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Senior Leadership to drive programs strategically
  • Understand strategy, objectives, priority and goals to translate into tactical execution plans
  • Identify, understand, visualize and manage upstream/downstream dependencies
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles proactively and effectively
  • Ensure clear communication for status reporting, issues and challenges to leadership, relevant partners, and team members
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to optimize productivity and processes for the organization
  • Bring clarity, calm and process to ambiguous, stressful and/or sophisticated situations
  • Build a strong cohesive program team and create a fun and collaborative environment that cultivates creativity, innovation, learning and inclusivity
  • Drive software development programs that involve integrating server and client engineering work from inception to delivery to internal / external customers
 
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of program management experience with software development and delivery at scale
  • Bachelor’s degree, technical education and/or work experience in technical domain
  • Consistent track record of managing schedules, scope, budgets, dependency, issues/risks, communications, quality/testing plans, and release plans of complex programs
  • Shown technical proficiency and an ability to understand technology, designs, challenges and risks
  • Proven understanding of Software Development Lifecycle, Design/System Thinking, Agile frameworks, preferably Scrum and Kanban, and Program Management Methodologies to implement the right practice for the programs
  • Experience in leading complex, business-critical programs with dependencies across multiple teams to include Product Management, User Experience, Legal, Marketing and other business teams
  • Experience creating and delivering executive-level summary reports and presentations
  • Excellent listening, written, and verbal communication skills across all levels
  • Strong decision-making skill, conflict resolution and navigating through the organization
  • Experience in initiating and driving process improvements
  • Experience with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, Google Drive, and Microsoft Teams, etc)
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and multicultural working environments
  • Experience in a high transaction network based services, video gaming industry or social media
  • Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: video gaming, accounts platform, trust & safety, account management, process implementation, mobile, and/or web development
  • Understanding of Japanese language and culture

job.title: Senior Azure .NET Developer
job.description:
Senior Azure .NET Developer
irving, TX (Hybrid)
Direct Hire

Position Summary
As an experienced Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and modern application architecture, with deep expertise in .NET, Azure technologies, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Beyond technical execution, this role calls for someone who takes full ownership and accountability for outcomes — running toward problems, especially in production, rather than waiting to be asked. You will understand enterprise requirements end-to-end and think several steps ahead to design solutions that stand the test of time. You will act as a hands-on architect and the team's go-to technical resource, reasoning through trade-offs with data and bringing well-communicated recommendations to the Senior Management and architecture team.
What This Role Requires
  • Hands-On Ownership: Personally designs, builds, reviews, troubleshoots, and supports critical components — this is a hands-on technical lead role, not a coordination-only architect position.
  • Decision-Ready Judgment: Frames problems with supporting data, weighs tradeoffs, and brings a clear recommended path with business and technical impact — not just options.
  • Go-To Resource: The person developers and stakeholders bring hard technical questions to — across Azure and C#/.NET — and trust to give a clear, confident answer.
  • Constructive Challenge: Pushes back constructively on weak assumptions and shortcuts, balancing delivery urgency with long-term maintainability.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes beyond code complete: requirements clarity, dependencies, test readiness, release planning, observability, rollback, documentation, and hypercare.
  • Force Multiplier: Builds reusable patterns, standards, templates, and runbooks, and develops secondary ownership so critical knowledge is never a single point of failure.
  • AI-Forward: Actively explores, adopts, and introduces AI-driven SDLC practices — then drives their adoption across the team, validating all AI-generated output through rigorous human review and testing.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Requirements & End-to-End Ownership
  • Understand requirements in full enterprise context — source-of-truth decisions, upstream/downstream systems, business rules, data ownership, security, and support impact.
  • Lead technical discovery into solution designs, technical stories, acceptance criteria, dependency and data mappings, exception scenarios, estimates, risks, and implementation plans.
  • Own delivery from design through testing, deployment, production validation, support transition, and continuous improvement — escalating risks early with options and recommendations.
  • Assess scope changes for architecture, schedule, testing, data, dependency, and operational impact before committing.
Architecture & Technical Direction
  • Own Azure and C#/.NET architecture, implementation, and engineering standards, aligning key architecture decisions with the Senior Manager and architecture team.
  • Design cloud-native, API-led, event-driven, and data-integration solutions; document decisions, alternatives, and tradeoffs in language suited to developers, leadership, and business partners.
  • Evaluate scalability, security, resiliency, performance, observability, maintainability, cost, and supportability before implementation.
  • Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and feedback; establish patterns for error handling, retries, idempotency, and reusable integration components.
Hands-On Engineering
  • Build industry-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, engineered to meet sub-150ms API response targets.
  • Must have strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps/AKS, API Management, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure DevOps.
  • Apply strong practices for asynchronous processing, concurrency, dependency injection, authentication/authorization, data modeling, API contracts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter recovery.
  • Front-end contribution (React.js, Next.js) as needed is a plus, not required — primary depth stays in backend and integration engineering.
Performance, Data & Cost Engineering
  • Diagnose end-to-end performance using correlated telemetry across edge, API, compute, messaging, database, and batch layers.
  • Use workload evidence — latency, throughput, error/retry rates, CPU/memory, Cosmos DB RU consumption and partitioning — to guide decisions rather than guesswork.
  • Tune Cosmos DB partitioning, throughput, and indexing; balance real-time and batch workloads without defaulting to capacity increases.
  • Evaluate Azure cost and capacity tradeoffs, and recommend savings without weakening reliability.
DevSecOps & Release Engineering
  • Champion automated unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance testing with meaningful coverage as part of CI/CD quality gates.
  • Build and improve Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or equivalent) for repeatable application and platform deployments.
  • Embed secure engineering practices: managed identity, secrets management, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
Observability, Reliability & Production Support
  • Design structured logging, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, metrics, and alerts that minimize noise and speed root-cause analysis.
  • Define production-readiness criteria, runbooks, failure modes, and post-deployment validation.
  • DR Champion: Own disaster recovery strategy end-to-end — RPO/RTO targets, failover, backup/restore, recovery automation, and periodic DR testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigation with urgency, converting lessons learned into durable engineering improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, remaining available to support production issues as needed.
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Be a front-runner in adopting approved AI-assisted practices across the SDLC — planning, coding, testing, documentation, review, and troubleshooting.
  • Validate all AI-generated output through human review, automated testing, and security controls.
  • Build reusable prompts, repository instructions, and guardrails that capture team learning and promote consistent, secure AI usage.
  • Track and communicate AI's impact on delivery speed, quality, and incident resolution.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Partner with product, QA, security, infrastructure, data, support, and onshore/offshore engineering teams.
  • Lead with empathy and accountability: listen, explain reasoning, challenge respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • Provide concise, accurate status, risk, and completion updates, keeping delivery status current.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong depth in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure backend/integration services.
  • Proven, end-to-end ownership of production Azure solutions — from requirements and architecture through deployment, observability, and support.
  • Demonstrated expertise with cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-system failure handling.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Cosmos DB, including production troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with automated testing, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and observability tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct design/code reviews, communicate tradeoffs, and lead through ambiguity.
  • Practical, responsible experience using AI development tools, including output validation and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate; Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, high-availability architecture, distributed tracing, and production on-call support.
  • Cosmos DB partitioning/RU optimization, Azure performance engineering, and FinOps practices.
  • Experience standardizing AI-assisted engineering workflows or reusable development automation.
  • Experience in retail, distribution, supply chain, or heavy-duty aftermarket domains.
Success Measures
  • Risks, dependencies, and non-functional requirements are surfaced before development and QA.
  • Solutions reach production with automated tests, observability, documented support ownership, and validated rollback/recovery.
  • Technical debt is prevented where practical, or explicitly documented and bounded when intentionally accepted.
  • Develops clean designs, and reusable engineering assets grow over time.
  • AI-assisted development shows measurable improvement while maintaining human validation and quality.

job.title: Client Service Associate
job.description:
Financial Client Service Associate
Position Summary:
We are seeking a Client Service Associate to join a professional financial services team and provide day-to-day support to advisors and their clients. This individual will help manage client requests, maintain account information, coordinate meetings, and assist with the administrative and operational needs of the office.

The successful candidate will be organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a client-facing environment. Strong communication skills and a high degree of professionalism are essential.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients by responding to questions, requests, and account-related needs via phone, email, and in-person interactions.
  • Assist financial advisors with daily scheduling, including coordinating appointments, preparing materials, organizing client meetings, and completing post-meeting follow-up.
  • Handle a variety of account servicing activities, including new account setup, account transfers, beneficiary updates, required minimum distributions, address changes, and other client maintenance requests.
  • Keep client information and documentation current and accurate within internal CRM and account systems.
  • Follow established operational and regulatory procedures, including applicable FINRA and SEC requirements, while maintaining strict confidentiality of client and account information.
  • Communicate with third-party custodians, investment providers, financial institutions, and other external partners to facilitate transactions and resolve account-related issues.
  • Assist with general branch administration, including preparing documents, coordinating mail and correspondence, supporting client events and educational sessions, and assisting with newsletters or digital communications.
  • Contribute to a positive office environment by identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance client service, and support the broader team.
Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for someone who takes ownership, works well with others, and genuinely enjoys helping people. The ideal candidate is comfortable in a fast-paced environment, approaches challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset, and consistently follows through on commitments.

Strong candidates will demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn. We value individuals who take pride in their work, look for ways to improve the client experience, and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications:
  • Ability to work on-site Monday through Friday.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively navigate CRM and other business systems.
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities while working independently and as part of a team.
  • Professional demeanor with a high level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Degree or educational background in finance, accounting, business, or a related field is a plus.
  • Previous experience in financial services, wealth management, banking, or a client-facing administrative environment is beneficial.

job.title: ERP Transformation Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365
job.description:
ERP Transformation Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365 This is a long-term opportunity for an ERP professional interested in influencing a significant technology transformation while developing an ongoing role within the organization. Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid environment and committing to the full implementation lifecycle.

Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Salary: $110,000-$135,000 Annually, Based on Experience
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, Tuesday–Thursday
Location: North Dallas Texas (Richardson TX)

POSITION OVERVIEW An established organization is seeking an experienced ERP Transformation Lead to serve as a key internal resource during a major Microsoft Dynamics ERP implementation. This position will bridge business operations, technology teams, and an external implementation partner to ensure the new platform supports organizational requirements, improves operational efficiency, and delivers long-term business value.
  • The ideal candidate brings strong functional expertise in Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365, with the ability to evaluate business processes, guide system decisions, challenge implementation recommendations, and represent internal stakeholder interests throughout the transformation.
  • The ERP initiative is scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027, with an anticipated implementation timeline of 18–24 months. This individual will play an integral role throughout the project lifecycle and transition into an ongoing ERP support and optimization function following deployment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Serve as the primary functional liaison between internal business departments, IT leadership, and the third-party ERP implementation team.
  • Evaluate current operational workflows and translate business objectives into system requirements, configuration recommendations, and implementation priorities.
  • Facilitate discussions with stakeholders to identify process inefficiencies, application limitations, and opportunities to leverage standard Microsoft Dynamics functionality.
  • Provide functional guidance across ERP modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Operations.
  • Assess proposed system designs, integrations, and customization requests to ensure solutions align with business goals and minimize unnecessary complexity.
  • Influence ERP-related decisions by recommending process improvements, resolving functional challenges, and balancing operational requirements with platform capabilities.
  • Coordinate data conversion activities, including legacy system mapping, data integrity reviews, cleansing strategies, and reconciliation of financial and operational information.
  • Develop testing strategies, coordinate cross-functional validation efforts, and oversee System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to establish appropriate system access, role-based permissions, security controls, and compliance procedures.
  • Support organizational readiness through training materials, knowledge transfer, process documentation, and end-user adoption initiatives.
  • Participate in deployment planning, issue resolution, post-implementation stabilization, and ongoing system enhancements.
    Provide continued functional support and contribute to future ERP improvements following completion of the initial implementation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Strong hands-on functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, or comparable Microsoft Dynamics ERP environments.
  • Experience participating in ERP implementations, enterprise system conversions, or large-scale business application modernization projects.
  • Working knowledge of finance, accounting, inventory, supply chain, or warehouse-related ERP processes.
  • Ability to evaluate functional requirements, conduct process assessments, and translate business needs into effective system solutions.
  • Experience collaborating with external implementation consultants, systems integrators, and internal business stakeholders.
  • Understanding of ERP testing methodologies, data migration activities, configuration management, and system deployment processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify operational gaps, assess technical recommendations, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

This role supports front-office trading and sales teams, back-office operations, investment banking, compliance, and other critical business functions. The ideal candidate will have strong desktop support experience within financial services and a customer-first mindset.
This position requires a professional, polished individual who can effectively support executives, traders, and business users while managing technical issues, cyber vulnerabilities, and end-user technology incidents.

job.title: Lead Systems Analyst with Investment Management - MDM - Remote
job.description:
Lead Systems Analyst Master Data Management

Role Summary

We are seeking a Lead Systems Analyst with strong master data management experience to analyze business needs, define practical system and data solutions, and guide delivery across investment-data and reference-data environments. Financial-services experience is required.

Responsibilities

Elicit, challenge, document, and prioritize requirements for MDM, reference data, EDM, and related investment-data capabilities.

Analyze processes, data flows, entities, attributes, ownership, stewardship, and integration points.

Translate business needs into functional specifications, source-to-target mappings, data rules, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Support MDM analysis and design, including master-data creation, matching, quality, governance, and distribution.

Partner with developers, data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders through build, QA, UAT, defect resolution, and release readiness; communicate clearly and surface risks early.

Required Qualifications

Lead-level experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise data platforms.

Investment Management experience - Investment management, asset management, custodial, performance, IBOR, portfolio, security, or reference-data experience; MDM solution design, data quality, lineage, stewardship, governance, and integration experience; or experience with investment-data organizations, and custodians. 

Experience working in an OCIO would be a +

Hands-on experience with an MDM, client master, product master, reference-data, or data-governance platform. Informatica MDM, Salesforce, or EDM is valuable.  Markit EDM is a big + 

Requirements elicitation, process and data analysis, data modeling, mappings, SQL, testing, and stakeholder-management experience.

Ability to explain technical topics clearly, ask strong questions, handle ambiguity patiently, and convert needs into actionable delivery work.

 

Success Measures

The successful candidate will improve requirements quality, clarify data ownership and definitions, reduce rework, and deliver reliable master and reference data to downstream consumers. This is a substantive hands-on systems-analysis role, not a high-level-only architecture position.

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst III
job.description:
Quality Assurance Analyst III

Job Details:

Duration: 24 months contract W2
Location: Hybrid 2x a week onsite in Audubon PA
Pay Rate: $56.34-$69.72 hourly W2

** Client is not able to do sponsorship of visa or C2C** 




Responsibilities
 
The Quality Analyst will be responsible for test planning, test monitoring and control, test analysis and design, test implementation and test execution, evaluating exit criteria and reporting, and test closure.
 
The Quality Analyst will be directly involved in hands-on, technical work including test data provisioning and test data management. Specific duties include the following.
 
  • Test planning: define the overall strategic and tactical objectives for testing software changes at different test levels. Work with developers, project managers and business customers to define the strategy to be used, such as risk-based testing. Test levels include component testing, integration testing, system testing and acceptance testing. Test types include functional testing, non-functional testing, structural ("white-box") testing, confirmation testing and regression testing.
 
  • Test monitoring and control: continuously compare test progress with the plan, adjust the plan and testing activities as necessary, and provide status reports.
 
  • Test analysis and design: transform testing objectives into test conditions and test cases. The test basis includes documented requirements, system architecture, behavior and structure of the software, existing data and data flows. Using structural ("white-box") test techniques, among others, design tests, or provide input into test design by identifying specific test conditions and high-level test cases.
 
  • Test implementation and test execution: develop and prioritize test procedures, set up the test environment and test data, and execute tests. Test changes to the database components of the system under test. Testable components include views, procedures and functions, data conversion and migration programs. Support business customers and others in acceptance testing. Includes identifying database model changes in higher environments (Production and Stage), and making those changes in the lower environments (Test and Development).
 
  • Evaluating exit criteria and reporting, and test closure: asses test execution against the objectives defined in the test plan. Specific tasks and deliverables are defined at the team or project level.
 
  • Identify the necessary test data to support test conditions and test cases as they are defined. Includes data to force error and boundary conditions. Analyze input data, including electronic files, message traffic and variations of user input.
 
  • Provide expected test results, and/or repeatable methods of generating expected test results, based on currently existing data. Includes preparing database queries and guides for testers to use.
 
  • Provide tools and methods to compare expected and actual test results. Includes bi-directional comparisons of database data with electronic files, message streams, and front-end displays.
 
  • Provide high-quality, realistic, fit for purpose and referentially intact test data. Capture end-to-end business processes and the associated data for testing. Subset production data: extract subsets of production data from multiple sources to meet test cases and/or to supply input values for data-driven testing. Create realistic test data sets small enough to support rapid test runs but large enough to accurately reflect the variety of production data.
  • Provide test data management. Script the setup of data in the application database to put it in a state that allows a specific set of test cases to be run against it. Script the creation of data files and message streams which require changing variables (usually date or timestamp related) in order to test applications which process them. Script database cleanups.
 
  • Ensure compliance with Client Software Testing standards and policies
 
 
Required Skills
  • 7+ years of experience as a quality assurance analyst or tester
  • Strong customer and business focus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with user-centered design and usability testing

job.title: Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance to join our insurance and mobility client. This is a foundational role responsible for defining the organization’s commercial auto strategy and determining how it should participate in emerging mobility markets, including autonomous vehicles, connected fleets, rideshare, and delivery platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial auto product expertise, a thoughtful perspective on the future of mobility, and the executive presence to develop and sell a new product vision from the ground up.

Title: Commercial Auto Product Manager, Emerging Mobility
Compensation: $194,300–$259,100 base salary, depending on experience, plus 20% target incentive
Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Location: Costa Mesa, CA or Dallas, TX
Industry: Insurance / Mobility Technology

This role is expected to be onsite most days in the Costa Mesa office. Relocation assistance may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Fully remote work is not currently planned, although limited flexibility may be explored for an outstanding candidate.

Position Overview The organization does not currently offer commercial auto insurance products and is beginning to define its strategy in this space. This person will serve as the initial product leader for the initiative, helping the business understand the opportunity, evaluate potential paths forward, and build the foundation for a future commercial auto and emerging mobility product organization.

The initial focus will be on light commercial auto and mobility segments that align with the organization’s existing operational and underwriting capabilities. This is not a heavy trucking role. The position will initially be heavily focused on strategy, market analysis, product vision, business cases, and executive alignment before transitioning into broader product development and team-building responsibilities.

Over time, the role is expected to transition from the emerging mobility strategy team into the broader insurance product management organization, potentially within 12 to 36 months as the product vision and operating model take shape.

Key Responsibilities Commercial Auto and Mobility Strategy
  • Define the organization’s long-term commercial auto and emerging mobility product strategy.

  • Evaluate opportunities across light commercial fleets, connected vehicles, autonomous vehicles, rideshare, delivery, and other evolving mobility models.

  • Explain the key differences between personal auto and commercial auto products, including risk, pricing, underwriting, coverage, claims, and operational considerations.

  • Develop a clear point of view on how autonomous and connected mobility will impact commercial insurance.

  • Monitor emerging mobility trends, competitors, OEM activity, insurance innovation, technology providers, and regulatory developments.

  • Identify where the organization can create a differentiated position in the market.

Business Case and Product Vision
  • Develop a practical roadmap for moving from the current state, with no commercial auto product, to a scalable product offering.

  • Evaluate potential paths, including building the capability internally, acquiring or partnering with an existing organization, or choosing not to enter specific market segments.

  • Analyze the investment, talent, technology, regulatory, operational, and risk requirements associated with each path.

  • Prepare recommendations and business cases for executive leadership.

  • Sell the product vision to senior executives and create alignment around the recommended strategy.

  • Define the capabilities, resources, partnerships, and organizational structure required to execute the strategy.

Product Design and Insurance Expertise
  • Provide expertise on commercial auto product structure, coverage design, underwriting, rating, pricing, and risk selection.

  • Partner with actuarial teams to evaluate pricing methodologies, risk models, exposure data, loss trends, and portfolio economics.

  • Help determine which commercial auto risks and vehicle types align with the organization’s existing capabilities.

  • Identify future coverage needs created by autonomous systems, connected vehicles, fleet operations, and changing liability models.

  • Establish the foundation for product governance, regulatory review, underwriting guidelines, and operational processes.

  • Support the development of product requirements and implementation plans as the strategy advances.

Team and Capability Development
  • Define the roles and capabilities needed to build a future commercial auto product team.

  • Recommend the organizational structure and talent profile required for execution.

  • Help recruit and build the team responsible for launching and managing the product.

  • Establish relationships across insurance product management, actuarial, underwriting, claims, legal, compliance, technology, operations, and marketing.

  • Transition from primarily strategic work into product development and execution as the initiative progresses.

Partnership and Market Development
  • Evaluate potential relationships with OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, mobility platforms, fleet operators, telematics providers, data companies, and insurance technology partners.

  • Assess embedded insurance and partnership-based distribution opportunities.

  • Represent the organization in relevant insurance, mobility, and technology discussions.

  • Develop external market perspective and bring new insights to internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, finance, economics, management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Significant experience developing or managing commercial auto insurance products.

  • Strong understanding of the differences between personal auto and commercial auto insurance.

  • Experience with commercial auto pricing, underwriting, actuarial models, risk selection, coverage structures, or portfolio performance.

  • Experience developing product strategy, business cases, market-entry plans, or new insurance capabilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an environment where the product, process, and team are still being built.

  • Strong understanding of emerging mobility, autonomous vehicles, connected vehicles, telematics, rideshare, delivery, or commercial fleet trends.

  • Ability to clearly explain how changes in mobility and vehicle technology may affect insurance products, pricing, underwriting, liability, and claims.

  • Proven ability to present recommendations and influence senior executives.

  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.

  • Ability to work onsite most days in Costa Mesa, California, or relocate to the area.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for executive meetings, industry events, and stakeholder discussions.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with autonomous vehicle companies, OEMs, commercial fleet operators, mobility platforms, telematics providers, or embedded insurance programs.

  • Experience with light commercial fleets, delivery vehicles, rideshare, or other emerging commercial mobility segments.

  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, insurtech, mobility company, or transportation technology organization.

  • Experience launching a new insurance product or building a new insurance capability from the ground up.

  • Experience evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquisition strategies.

  • Experience with E&S, specialty, non-standard, or other complex insurance products.

  • Experience with state insurance filings, regulatory approvals, product governance, or compliance.

  • CPCU, AINS, ARM, or another insurance designation.

  • Experience building and leading a product management or insurance strategy team.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Build the commercial auto strategy from the ground up.

  • Define how a major insurance organization approaches emerging mobility.

  • Work directly with senior executives and influence a significant new business direction.

  • Shape the product vision, operating model, partnerships, and future team.

  • Help determine whether the organization should build, buy, or partner to enter the market.

  • Join at the earliest stage of a long-term commercial auto and autonomous mobility initiative.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Put your inspection skills and attention to detail to work in medical device manufacturing. Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a Quality Control Inspector for a client in Reno, NV. In this hands-on role, we are looking for candidates with experience in quality inspection, and warehouse operations.  Candidates with experience in medical device manufacturing are preferred. This position combines quality inspection with hands-on warehouse support. You’ll inspect incoming materials and work in progress, maintain accurate records, and help keep materials and finished products moving through the operation. If you enjoy detailed work and variety in your day, this role offers exposure to quality, assembly, and inventory activities within a medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite in Reno, NV

What You’ll Do:
  • Inspect products during manufacturing to support consistent quality.
  • Perform receiving inspections on incoming raw materials.
  • Capture inspection results and maintain accurate quality control records.
  • Help develop and improve quality control processes.
  • Learn assembly processes and provide production support as needed.
  • Keep purchase orders and related records organized and accessible.
  • Maintain an organized warehouse and control raw material storage and handling.
  • Prepare, package, and ship finished products.
  • Complete inventory counts and keep inventory records accurate.
  • Follow quality system requirements and good documentation practices throughout daily work.

Experience That Can Help You Succeed:
  • Background in medical device manufacturing.
  • Must have experience with and knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems.
  • Experience inspecting incoming materials, in-process products, and finished goods.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints.
  • Familiarity with precision inspection tools, including calipers, micrometers, and microscopes.
  • Experience recognizing and documenting nonconforming materials or products.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory control and warehouse activities.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing records and accurate production documentation.
  • Experience using ERP, electronic quality management, or similar business systems.
  • English/Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.

job.title: Technical Program Manager / Agile Delivery Lead
job.description:
Technical Program Manager / Agile Delivery Lead
12 + month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager or Agile Delivery Lead to support the Enterprise Business Systems team. This role will lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives supporting business applications and FinTech-related capabilities.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise software delivery, stakeholder management, Agile methodologies, and technical program leadership. Must have demonstrated experience leading large or complex technical projects, coordinating multiple teams, and driving successful delivery.
This individual must be comfortable moving between technical details and high-level business objectives, facilitating technical discussions, representing customer needs, and identifying risks and opportunities before they impact delivery.
 
Responsibilities
  • Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from kickoff through delivery and operational handoff.
  • Serve as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead, facilitating ceremonies and promoting effective Agile practices.
  • Coordinate work across engineering, product, business systems, infrastructure, and other stakeholder teams.
  • Define project scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans.
  • Develop, own, and maintain team roadmaps aligned with business and technology objectives.
  • Manage risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Partner with technical teams to support sound architecture, integration, scalability, and operational-readiness decisions.
  • Facilitate technical discussions while ensuring business and customer requirements remain central to decision-making.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership.
  • Prepare and deliver clear program updates, presentations, status reports, and executive communications.
  • Promote transparency regarding progress, risks, tradeoffs, and delivery expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, team performance, and delivery practices.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Proactively identify issues, remove roadblocks, and drive decisions to maintain momentum.
  • Represent multiple perspectives and challenge assumptions to improve program outcomes.
 
Requirements
  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management, Agile delivery, project management, software delivery, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, or highly cross-functional technology initiatives.
  • Experience supporting enterprise business applications, FinTech, financial services, or similar environments preferred.
  • Strong hands-on experience with NetSuite.
  • Experience leading projects through the full delivery lifecycle, from planning and kickoff through implementation and release.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and software development lifecycles.
  • Experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or equivalent delivery leadership role.
  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple teams, manage dependencies, and drive accountability.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across organizational levels.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and solutions-focused.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, participate in architecture and engineering discussions, and translate complex information for business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • PMP, CSM, SAFe, or other relevant Agile or project management certification.
  • Experience managing enterprise business systems or NetSuite implementations and integrations.
  • Experience with roadmap development, release planning, dependency management, and executive reporting.
  • Experience driving process improvement and continuous delivery improvements.
  • FinTech, payments, accounting, ERP, or financial systems experience.
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
The successful candidate is a hands-on delivery leader who can organize complex work, create clarity across teams, communicate effectively with executives, and proactively address risks. They are comfortable operating at both the strategic and tactical levels and are not limited by job title—the client will consider strong Agile Delivery Leads, Scrum Masters, or Technical Project Managers with comparable experience leading complex technical programs.

job.title: VP Cash Processing/Funds Transfer Manager - Lake Mary or Pittsburg
job.description:
VP, Cash Processing/Funds Transfer Manager

We are seeking an experienced Trade Finance Operations Manager to lead high-performing teams supporting global trade finance operations. This role is responsible for overseeing complex trade finance transactions, driving operational excellence, managing risk and controls, and leading strategic transformation initiatives.

Job Details:

Duration: Permanent Full Time Employee
Location: 4x a weel onsite in Pittsburgh PA or Lake Mary FL
Pay Rate: $98,000-$140,000- Depending on Experience


** Client is not able to do sponsorship of visa now or in the future/C2C**


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead multiple Trade Finance Operations teams supporting international clients and transactions across global markets.
  • Oversee the execution and processing of trade finance products while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Drive process improvements, workflow optimization, and technology-driven operational enhancements.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on complex trade finance transactions and operational issues.
  • Manage multiple projects and transformation initiatives simultaneously while ensuring business objectives are achieved.
  • Participate in risk and control governance activities and support efforts to identify and mitigate operational risks.
  • Collaborate with product, relationship management, legal, compliance, and risk teams to develop client solutions and strategic initiatives.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex operational and transaction issues while mentoring and developing team members.
  • Lead recruitment, coaching, performance management, and career development activities for operations staff.
  • Develop training materials, process documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Structure and support Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit, and Guarantees in partnership with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver technical training and guidance related to documentary credits, document examination, and trade finance best practices.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Trade Finance operations.
  • Previous experience managing or leading teams within a trade finance environment.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Letters of Credit (LCs)
    • Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
    • Bank Guarantees
    • Document Examination
    • Documentary Credits
  • Thorough understanding of:
    • UCP 600
    • URDG
    • ISP98
  • Experience managing complex transaction workflows and supporting client-facing trade finance solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Professional certifications such as:
    • CDCS (Certified Documentary Credit Specialist)
    • CSDG (Certified Specialist in Demand Guarantees)
    • Other recognized trade finance certifications
  • Experience leading operational transformation, automation, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of international banking regulations and trade compliance requirements.
Additional Preferred Experience
  • Strong understanding of Sanctions Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Trade Compliance programs.
  • Experience working with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
  • Proven ability to manage operational risk while maintaining high service standards.
  • Experience creating training programs and developing operational procedures.

This role focuses on providing security guidance, risk assessments, threat modeling, and security architecture recommendations across a diverse technology landscape that includes on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and SaaS environments.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on large-scale transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption and modernization efforts, while partnering with business and technology teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the project lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities
  • Provide security guidance during the planning, design, development, and implementation of technology solutions.
  • Conduct Threat Risk Assessments (TRAs) and threat modeling activities for applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise initiatives.
  • Review and assess security controls to ensure alignment with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform security advisory reviews for complex applications, platforms, and network environments.
  • Analyze security risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Support cloud initiatives by providing quality assurance reviews of threat assessments and security architecture designs.
  • Collaborate with technology, infrastructure, development, and business teams to implement secure-by-design principles.
  • Evaluate existing security solutions and recommend enhancements to address emerging threats and evolving business needs.
  • Review vulnerability reports, validate security controls, and assess remediation plans.
  • Provide guidance on security policies, standards, and best practices.
  • Support security posture reviews and ensure appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained.
  • Conduct industry research and benchmarking to identify emerging threats, trends, and mitigation strategies.
  • Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and provide ongoing security consultation.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience performing security assessments for applications, infrastructure, and network environments.
  • 3+ years of experience conducting Threat Risk Assessments and threat modeling across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and SaaS environments.
  • 2+ years of experience in security architecture, security engineering, software development, or hands-on implementation of security solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience reviewing vulnerability reports, validating control effectiveness, and assessing server hardening requirements.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. regulatory requirements and security compliance practices.
  • Experience identifying security risks and providing practical remediation recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of application security controls, compensating controls, and security best practices.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, or similar.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards including:
    • NIST 800-53
    • ISO 27001 / ISO 27002
    • ISO 27017 / ISO 27018
    • PCI DSS
    • CIS Controls
Desired Skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and professional experience will be considered.

job.description:
Business Analyst- Liquidity Reporting

We’re seeking a contractor to support FR 2052a liquidity reporting execution, including governance and control documentation across technology and report ownership (attestations, issues, change management)

Job Details

Contract Duration: 12 months
Possibility of extension and conversion to FTE
Location: Hybrid 3x a week in NYC
Number of Positions: 2
Pay Rate: $50-$60 hourly W2

Key Responsibilities
  • Run the FR 2052a production process, including source-to-report mapping, key calculations, and material assumptions
  • Maintain version control and produce audit-ready evidence and documentation
  • Create and maintain business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specs, process flows, and data mapping
